description: Treelet to 6 m tall. Young branches densely hairy to velutinous. Leaves thin papyraceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic to obovate, 11–25.5 by 4–7.5 cm, ± matt above, (very sparsely) hairy below, (sub)glabrous above, secondary veins 9–15 pairs, ± plane to prominent above; tertiary venation reticulate, (highly) distinct; petioles 5–15 mm long. Flowers solitary (rarely paired), on young growth, pedicels 2–7.5 mm long. Sepals 3–8 by 3.5–7 mm, not reflexed, venation sometimes distinct. Outer petals cream or light yellow, 10–20 by 5–9.5 mm, (very densely) hairy abaxially, glabrous towards base and (densely) hairy towards apex adaxially with glabrous to hairy basal region facing apertures between inner petals, venation indistinct. Inner petals cream or light yellow, 6.5–12.5 by 4–8 mm, (very densely) hairy abaxially except glabrous lateral flanges at base, velutinous adaxially. Stamens 65–225, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 16–40, ovaries ± glabrous; stigmas large, funnel-shaped, glabrous or very sparsely hairy. Fruits with persistent sepals, pedicels 4.5–7 mm long. Monocarps red, (ovoid-)ellipsoid, 1.05–1.5 by 0.6–0.85 cm, smooth, glabrous, stipe 4.5–13 mm long. Seeds 1(–2), 9–12 by 6–7.5 mm, ± smooth to slightly rugose, glabrous.

description: Tree to 15 m tall. Young branches glabrous to hairy. description: Evergreen or rarely deciduous shrubs, treelets or trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic to obovate, base attenuate, cuneate, obtuse, or rarely (sub)cordate, symmetrical or seldom slightly asymmetrical, midrib sightly raised, flat, or sunken above, secondary veins inconspicuous to conspicuous, with hairy domatia often present at vein axils below, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, sometimes from axils of fallen leaves, 1(–2)-flowered, rarely plants cauliflorous and then inflorescences > 3-flowered. Flowers hermaphroditic, petals separating early in development. Sepals 3, valvate, free or rarely basally connate, usually shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, whorls equal or subequal, ovate, elliptic to linguiform. Stamens generally more than 40, ± elongated wedge-shaped, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate, covering tops of thecae. Carpels generally more than 10, stigmas ± globose, ellipsoid, obovoid, ellipsoid-ovoid or ellipsoid-cylindrical; ovule 1 per ovary, sub-basal. Receptacle flat to raised with flat-topped or rarely rounded apex. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps red, indehiscent, globose, ellipsoid, obovoid, or cylindrical, glabrous, smooth, stipitate or rarely (sub)sessile); pericarp thin. Seed sub-basally attached, 1 per monocarp, globose, ellipsoid, obovoid to cylindrical, smooth, glabrous, ± brown when dried, perichalazal ring plane or slightly raised, aril absent, endosperm ruminations spiniform.</br></br>A Palaeotropical genus of about 35 species segregated from Polyalthia, distributed from E Africa and Madagascar across tropical Asia and east to islands of the W Pacific; 2 species in Thailand.

description: Tree to 15 m tall. Twigs appressed-tomentose. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic to obovate, 8.2–17.4 by 2–4.2 cm, base cuneate to broadly cuneate, sometimes ± rounded or ± subcordate, generally slightly asymmetrical, apex acute to caudate-acuminate, acumen up to 15 mm long, glabrous above, generally appressed-pilose (sometimes densely so) below, secondary veins 7–10 per side, rather prominent below, domatia absent. Inflorescences 1–2-flowered, pedicels 20–28 mm long, each bearing two bracts on the pedicel lower half, one near the pedicel midpoint, another smaller and placed near the pedicel base next to an articulation. Sepals free, elliptic-ovate, 11–12 mm long, apex acute. Petals ± cream-yellow, carnose; outer petals ovate, 11–12 by 8–9 mm, apex acute and often slightly recurved at anthesis; inner petals ovate, 11–12 by 7 mm, apex acute and often slightly recurved at anthesis. Stamens numerous, 1.8–2.1 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels numerous, ovaries appressed-villous, stigmas ± ellipsoid. Receptacle slightly elevated. Fruit of up to 30 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 30 mm long. Monocarps subglobose, 0.8–0.9 by 0.6 cm, apex usually very short-apiculate, base contracted into a stipe 20–25 mm long. Seed 1, subglobose, 7–8 by ca 5 mm.

description: Tree to 10 m tall. Twigs appressed-puberulous. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic, 12.3–17 by 4.1–5.5 cm, base cuneate, apex acute to acuminate, glabrous on both sides, secondary veins 10–13 per side, distinct below, hairy domatia generally present at axils of secondary veins below. Inflorescences 1-flowered, pedicels 14–22 mm long, each bearing 1–2 bracts at or near the base. Sepals free, ovate-triangular, 2.5–3 mm long, apex acute. Petals yellow, ± subcoriaceous, erect at anthesis; outer petals elliptic, 32–50 by 10–16 mm, apex obtuse; inner petals elliptic, 32–47 by 12–19 mm, apex obtuse. Stamens numerous, 1.2–1.8 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels numerous, ovaries appressed-villous, stigmas ± ellipsoid. Receptacle ± conical. Fruit of up to 38 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 25 mm long. Monocarps ellipsoid(-cylindrical), 1–1.2 by 0.5–0.65 cm, apex usually short-apiculate, base contracted into a stipe 13–18 mm long. Seed 1, ellipsoid to ellipsoid-cylindrical, 9–11 by 4–5.5 mm.

description: Tree to 30 m tall. Young branches densely pubescent. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic, ovate or lanceolate, 6.5–20 by 3.5–10 cm, base obtuse, rounded or slightly cordate, apex acute to short-acuminate, glossy above, sparsely pubescent below, secondary veins (7–)11–19 pairs, without domatia; petioles 4.5–10.5 mm long. Inflorescences with rachides simple, the rachis internodes elongate, > 3-flowered, densely pubescent, pedicels 10–27 mm long. Sepals ovate, 4–6.5 by 4.5–7 mm, densely pubescent abaxially. Outer petals yellow, elliptic to ovate, 14.5–25.5 by 7–11.5 mm, margin undulate with age, densely pubescent abaxially. Inner petals yellow with red stripes apically, ca 9.5 by 4.5–5 mm, sparsely pubescent abaxially, pilose towards apex adaxially. Stamens 1–1.2 mm long. Carpels 36–40, 1.2–1.5 mm long; ovules 6–8. Fruit of up to 25 monocarps on a pedicel 30–40 mm long [Gardner]. Monocarps brownish yellow when mature, globose, 1.6–2.2 by 1.6–2 cm, smooth, without longitudinal ridge, not glaucous, densely pubescent, stipe (28–)36–40 mm long, not glaucous, densely pubescent. Seeds 6–10, 10–14 by 6–8 mm.

description: Tree to 10 m tall. Young branches densely pubescent. Leaves coriaceous, oblong-lanceolate, 10.5–27 by 3.5–8 cm, base acute or obtuse, apex (short) acuminate, glossy above, sparsely pubescent below, secondary veins 10–14 pairs, without domatia; petioles 6.5–11.5 mm long. Inflorescences with rachides simple, the rachis internodes remaining short, < 3-flowered, velutinous, pedicels 12–16.5 mm long. Sepals ovate, 3–3.5 by 3–4.5 mm, densely pubescent abaxially. Outer petals white to yellow, broadly ovate, 16–22.5 by 10.5–19 mm, margin ± undulate with age, densely pubescent abaxially. Inner petals purplish, 11–19 by 6.5–12.5 mm, densely pubescent abaxially, pilose towards apex adaxially. Stamens 0.8–1 mm long. Carpels 8–10, 1.8–2 mm long; ovules 6–8. Fruit of ca 6 monocarps borne on a pedicel 10–16 mm long, densely pubescent. Monocarps pale yellowish green when mature, oblongoid, 2.4–3.8 by 1.4–2.6 cm, smooth, with a longitudinal ridge, glaucous, sparsely pubescent, stipe 9–13 mm long, glaucous, sparsely pubescent. Seeds ca 8, ca 9 by 6 mm.

description: Tree to 10 m tall. Young branches densely pubescent. Leaves coriaceous, ovate to lanceolate, 11–15 by 5–6.5 cm, base obtuse or slightly cordate, apex acute to short-acuminate, matt above, sparsely pubescent below, secondary veins 11–13 pairs, without domatia; petioles 4.5–6.5 mm long. Inflorescences with rachides simple, the rachis internodes remaining short, < 3-flowered, densely pubescent, pedicels 10–15.5 mm long. Sepals broadly ovate, 7.5–10.5 by 7.5–11 mm, densely pubescent abaxially. Outer petals cream-white, ovate, 37.5–40 by 22–29.5 mm, margin not undulate with age, densely pubescent abaxially. Inner petals cream-white and purple, 28–32 by 22–24.5 mm, sparsely pubescent abaxially, sparsely pubescent towards apex adaxially. Stamens 2–2.2 mm long. Carpels ca 10, 2.4–2.6 mm long; ovules 16–18. Fruit of 8–15 monocarps borne on a pedicel ca 11 by 2.5–8 mm. Monocarps light green when mature, obovoid, 2.5–3 by 1.8–2.3 cm, smooth or slightly wrinkled, with a longitudinal groove, finely pubescent, apex rounded or truncate, sometimes slightly indented, stipe gradual, 15–30 mm long. Seeds 4–6, ovoid to obovoid, ca 10 by 6–7 mm.

description: Evergreen trees. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic-oblong to obovate, base cuneate to obtuse, symmetrical, midrib sunken above, secondary veins brochidodromous, forming a conspicuous intramarginal vein, tertiary venation percurrent. Inflorescences leaf-opposed or internodal, usually on leafless branches, 1–3-flowered. Flowers hermaphroditic, ellipsoid or ovoid in bud. Sepals 3, valvate, connate at base, shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, elliptic, ovate, obovate or oblong, subequal, spreading at anthesis, short-clawed at the base. Stamens numerous, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 1–5, stigmas peltate or disc-shaped, lobed and slightly concave; ovules ca 10 per ovary, lateral, biseriate. Receptacle concave beneath the carpels. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, cylindrical, broadly ellipsoid, or globose, minutely pubescent, verrucose, sessile; pericarp thick, leathery, stony, or fleshy. Seeds attached laterally in 2 rows, ca 10 per monocarp, oblong, compressed, wrinkled, glabrous, dark brown, perichalazal ring raised into a distinct rib, aril absent, endosperm ruminations spiniform.</br></br>Four species, occurring in Peninsular Malaysia, Singapore, Sumatra, and Borneo; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Tree 15–30 m tall, crown conical with dense branching; bark blackish brown, smooth or shallowly cracked. Twigs pubescent to glabrescent. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic-oblong to obovate, 12–25 by 4–10 cm, base cuneate to obtuse, apex attenuate to acuminate, secondary veins 10–15 pairs, prominent below, tertiary venation percurrent; petioles ca 6 mm long. Inflorescences 1–3-flowered, pedicels ca 10 mm long. Sepals 1/2-connate, often spreading to slightly reflexed, ovate, ca 10 mm long, apex acute, puberulous on both surfaces. Petals greenish yellow, turning golden yellow to orange with age, erect to spreading, elliptic to obovate, sparsely pubescent on both surfaces except the base, which is densely pubescent outside and nearly glabrous inside; outer petals 40–60 by 20–40 mm; inner petals 38–58 by 18–38 mm. Stamens oblong, 1–2 mm long. Carpels 3–5, commonly 3, oblongoid-ellipsoid, appressed-pubescent. Fruit of up to 3 (–5) monocarps borne on a stout woody pedicel ca 10 mm long. Monocarps rusty brown, broadly ellipsoid to globose, 4–8 by 3–6 cm, verrucose, covered with velvety rusty brown hairs; pericarp ca 5 mm thick. Seeds ca 10 per monocarp, in 2 rows, oblong, compressed, 30–40 by 10–20 mm, dark brown, rough.

description: Evergreen or sometimes deciduous trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves thinly chartaceous to coriaceous, pellucid dots present, oblong to elliptic, lanceolate, or oblanceolate, symmetrical at base, midrib slightly raised, plane, or sunken above, secondary veins more or less parallel, eucamptodromous or rarely brochidodromous, tertiary venation weakly to strongly percurrent or rarely reticulate. Inflorescences axillary or rarely supra-axillary, 1–many-flowered plants sometimes cauliflorous. Flowers hermaphroditic, ovoid to subglobose in bud. Sepals 3, valvate or imbricate, free, shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free (in Thai species), linear, oblong, elliptic, lanceolate or ovate, erect or spreading, bases of inner petals in several species incurved over the stamens and sometimes with a short claw. Stamens numerous, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate or slightly convex. Carpels 4–numerous, stigmas subglobose, obovoid, clavate or oblongoid, lower to higher than the anther connective apices; ovule 1, basal. Receptacle cushion-shaped, conical or convex, with a truncate or shallowly concave apex. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, fusiform, asymmetrically ellipsoid, ellipsoid, subglobose, sub-ovoid or oblongoid, glabrous, sparsely hairy, or tomentose, glaucous in some species, smooth or rugose, stipitate or rarely sessile; pericarp thin to thick, membranous or leathery when dried. Seed attached basally, 1 per monocarp, oblongoid, or ellipsoid, smooth, glabrous, brown and often shiny, perichalazal ring deeply sunken, aril absent, endosperm ruminations lamellate.</br></br>Comprising about 70 species, the genus is distributed across tropical and subtropical Asia to N Australia; 21 are recorded for Thailand. Two species groups occur, one with thin petals spreading at anthesis and red to purple monocarps, and the other, which includes the former genus Enicosanthum, with thick erect petals and green to yellow monocarps; the adnate bract on the pedicel is shared by both groups.

description: Tree up to 15 m tall, bark slightly rough, brown. Twigs glabrous with slightly conspicuous lenticels. Leaves thinly coriaceous, symmetrically narrowly elliptic to broadly elliptic, (6‒)8.5‒13(‒17) by (3‒)4‒5.5(‒8.5) cm, base obtuse to broadly cuneate, apex acuminate with acumen 4‒10 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces except for veins pubescent on both surfaces, midrib grooved above, secondary veins fairly straight, 7‒9 per side, tertiary venation percurrent; petioles 4‒7 mm long, shallowly grooved above. Inflorescences in fascicles on woody tubercles of trunk, 7–15-flowered, pedicels 25‒40 mm long, 1‒1.2 mm thick, puberulous or pubescent, each bearing an adnate ovate bract 2‒3 by 1.5‒2.5 mm between the base and the midpoint; buds ovoid. Sepals imbricate, thinly coriaceous, broadly ovate, 2‒3 by 3‒4 mm, apex acute, pubescent outside and glabrous inside. Petals valvate from base to apices, erect, green to yellow, coriaceous, oblanceolate, base with short claw slightly incurved over the stamens, 4‒6 mm long, apex acute, pubescent on both sides; outer petals 25‒30 by 8‒10 mm; inner petals 23‒27 by 6‒8 mm. Stamens cuneate, 1.2‒1.5 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 35‒50 per flower, 2‒2.2 mm long, stigmas higher than anther connective apices, capitate or obovoid, 0.4‒0.6 mm long, pubescent. Receptacle cushion-shaped, 4–5 mm in diam., 1.2‒1.5 mm thick, hairy. Fruit of ca 6 monocarps borne on a pedicel 30‒55 by 3‒4 mm. Monocarps ellipsoid to lanceoloid, 2‒2.5 by 1.2‒1.4 cm, surface wrinkled when dried, glabrous, apex blunt or obtuse, stipe 3‒5 mm long, 3‒4 mm thick. Seed not examined.

description: Tree up to 10 m tall, bark nearly smooth, brown. Twigs densely brown-pubescent with slightly conspicuous lenticels. Leaves chartaceous, asymmetrically elliptic or lanceolate, 11‒15 by 2.8‒4.5 cm, base cuneate or obtuse, apex acute to acuminate, the acumen 5‒10 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces except pubescent at base of midrib, midrib grooved above, secondary veins fairly straight, (10‒)12‒16(‒18) per side, tertiary venation weakly percurrent; petioles 5‒8 mm long, shallowly grooved above. Inflorescences usually on woody tubercles of leafless twigs but occasionally forming fascicles in leaf axils, 2‒3-flowered, pedicels 30‒45 mm long, 0.4–0.5 mm thick, pubescent, each bearing an adnate lanceolate bract ca 1.5 by 1.5 mm between the base and the midpoint; buds ovoid. Sepals valvate, free, chartaceous, ovate, 1.5‒2 by 1.5‒2 mm, apex acute, pubescent outside. Petals valvate at the apices, spreading, yellowish green, thinly coriaceous, linear to elliptic-linear, apex acute, puberulous outside and glabrous inside; outer petals 20‒25 by 2‒2.5 mm; inner petals 15‒20 by 1.5‒2 mm with a slightly curved short claw near the base. Stamens oblong or slightly cuneate, 0.8‒1 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 8‒15 per flower, 1‒1.2 mm long, ovaries cylindrical, stigmas level with or slightly higher than anther connective apices, subglobose, pubescent. Receptacle cushion-shaped, 3–4 mm in diam., 0.8‒1 mm thick, pubescent. Fruit [ex Sinclair 1955] with monocarps “6‒12, oblong, obtuse at apex, glabrous, black when dry, 2 cm. long and 8 mm.‒1 cm. broad (may be slightly immature); stalks 2.5 cm. long.”

description: Tree up to 20 m tall, bark grey. Twigs pubescent with conspicuous lenticels. Leaves chartaceous, symmetrically or asymmetrically oblong, elliptic or oblanceolate, 11.5‒17.5 by 3.5‒7 cm, base slightly asymmetrically or symmetrically obtuse or broadly cuneate, apex acuminate, the acumen 5‒15 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces except for leaf base and veins, which are puberulous to pubescent when young and glabrous when mature, midrib grooved above, secondary veins slightly curved, (8‒9)‒10 per side, tertiary venation percurrent; petioles 6‒10 mm long, shallowly grooved above. Inflorescences in fascicles on woody tubercles of trunk, 7‒15(‒25)-flowered, pedicels 35‒45 mm long, 2‒2.2 mm thick, glabrescent, each bearing an adnate scalelike bract ca 0.5 by 2‒2.5 mm between the base and the midpoint, pubescent outside and glabrous inside; buds ovoid. Sepals valvate, free, thinly coriaceous, broadly ovate, 3‒4 by 6‒8 mm, apex acute, glabrescent outside and glabrous inside. Petals valvate from base to apex when young, erect to spreading, creamy white to yellowish green, thickly coriaceous, apex acute, puberulous; outer petals elliptic, 30‒38 by 14‒16 mm, base with claw 7‒10 mm long incurved over the stamens; inner petals oblanceolate, 28‒35 by 11‒13 mm, base with claw 5‒7 mm long incurved over the stamens, apex incurved. Stamens creamy white at anthesis, oblong or slightly cuneate, 2.2‒2.5 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels numerous, 2.7‒3 mm long, stigmas higher than anther connective apices, capitate or obovoid, 0.5‒0.6 mm, pubescent. Receptacle cushion-shaped, 6–7 mm in diam., 1‒1.2 mm thick, pubescent. Fruit of 4‒13 monocarps. Monocarps yellow to orange, fusiform, 4‒6 by 1.8‒2.2 cm, surface wrinkled when dried, glabrous, apex blunt, stipe 14‒16 mm long, 2.2‒2.5 mm thick. Seeds unknown.

description: Tree up to 8 m tall, bark smooth, brown to black. Twigs golden brown-tomentose with conspicuous lenticels. Leaves chartaceous, symmetrically elliptic, 13‒17 by 4‒6 cm, base obtuse to slightly cuneate, apex acute to acuminate, the acumen 7‒10 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces except for the pubescent midrib, midrib flat above, secondary veins fairly straight, 12‒14 per side, tertiary venation percurrent; petioles 8‒12 mm long, shallowly grooved above. Inflorescences from axils of leafy twigs, 1(‒2)-flowered, pedicels 8‒12 mm long, 1.2‒1.5 mm thick, golden brown-tomentose, each bearing two ovate bracts 2.5‒3 mm long at the base; buds ovoid. Sepals imbricate, free, coriaceous, ovate, 8‒10 by 8‒10 mm, apex blunt to broadly acute, tomentose outside. Petals valvate from the base to the apices, erect, greyish white, ovate, apex broadly acute, golden brown-tomentose on both sides, outer petals 25‒27 by 13‒15 mm, inner petals 22‒25 by 5‒7 mm. Stamens cuneate or oblong, 2.8–3.2 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 8–10 per flower, 2.8–3.2 mm long, stigmas higher than the anther connective apices, clavate, ca 0.6 mm long, tomentose. Receptacle conical, 4–5 mm in diam., 1.5‒1.8 mm thick, tomentose. Fruit of up to 10 monocarps borne on a pedicel 10‒15 mm long, 1.5‒2 mm thick. Monocarps greyish white, subglobose to subovoid, 1.5‒2 by 1.2‒1.5 cm, with a longitudinal groove, golden brown-tomentose, apex rounded (blunt when young), base rounded, stipe 4‒6 mm long, 1.5‒2 mm thick; pericarp ca 1 mm thick. Seeds sub-oblongoid or ellipsoid, 13‒16 by 10‒13 mm, smooth, brown, often shiny.

description: Tree up to 18 m tall, bark slightly rough, greyish brown to dark brown. Twigs golden brown-tomentose, with conspicuous lenticels. Leaves thinly coriaceous, asymmetrically oblanceolate or obovate, 12‒18(–20) by 3.5‒6.5 cm, base rounded, asymmetrically rounded, truncate, cuneate, or subcordate, apex acute to acuminate, the acumen 4‒8 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces except for pubescence along veins, midrib shallowly grooved above, secondary veins fairly straight, 12‒16(‒18) per side, tertiary venation percurrent; petioles 5‒8 mm long, flat above, golden brown-tomentose. Inflorescences axillary on leafy twigs, 1-flowered, peduncle 2–4 mm long, pedicels 4‒7 mm long, 2–2.5 mm thick, golden brown-tomentose, each bearing 2 ovate bracts, 3‒4 by 4–5 mm at the base; buds subglobose. Sepals imbricate, free, coriaceous, ovate, 4‒6(‒7) by 5‒7(‒8) mm, apex acute, golden brown-tomentose outside. Petals valvate from near the base to the apices, greenish or greyish white to pale yellow, coriaceous, oblong, curved outward from midpoint to apex, surface verrucose outside, apex acute, longitudinal veins slightly conspicuous, golden brown-tomentose on both sides; outer petals 25‒40 by 10‒12 mm; inner petals 20‒35 by 8‒10 mm, base incurved over the stamens. Stamens cuneate, 2.5–3 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels up to 5 per flower, 2.7–3 mm long, stigmas level with anther connective apices, capitate, 0.4–0.6 mm in diam., tomentose. Receptacle conical, 3.5–4.5 mm in diam., 3.5–4 mm thick, pubescent. Fruits of up to 5 monocarps borne on a pedicel 6‒12 mm long, 2.2–2.4 mm thick. Monocarps green to dark green when mature, ovoid, 2.2‒2.5 by 1‒1.2 cm, tomentose, apex with a beak 5–7 mm long, base rounded, stipe 3‒5 mm long, 1.5‒2 mm thick; pericarp ca 1 mm thick. Seed subglobose, 16‒18 by 8‒10 mm, brown to red-brown, smooth, often shiny.

description: Evergreen trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves chartaceous to coriaceous, densely covered with minute papillae below, giving a whitened appearance, base cuneate to rounded, symmetrical, midrib sunken above, secondary veins indistinct, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, 1–10-flowered, often forming tubercles, plants sometimes cauliflorous or ramiflorous. Flowers hermaphroditic, ovoid to narrowly ovoid in bud. Sepals 3, valvate, free, shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, subequal in size, (narrowly) oblong to strap-like, or oblong-ovate, flat, occasionally with a slight constriction toward base. Stamens numerous, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate to slightly convex. Carpels many, oblong, glabrous to tomentose or densely puberulent, stigmas globose or slightly elongate; ovule 1 (rarely 2) per ovary, basal or sub-basal. Receptacle terete, hemispherical. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, ellipsoid or globose, glabrous, smooth, stipitate; pericarp thin. Seeds attached basally or sub-basally, 1(–2) per monocarp, ellipsoid or globose, smooth, glabrous, brown, perichalazal ring raised or slightly sunken, aril absent, endosperm ruminations spiniform or sometimes formed into narrow triangular plates.</br></br>A tropical Asian genus of about 6 species, distinct from other Polyalthia segregates in the fine indistinct secondary veins and whitened lower surface of the leaves; 2 species are reported for Thailand.

description: Tree up to 35 m tall; bark whitish or pale greyish brown, smooth, often encircled by raised, transverse rings, knee roots present on plants growing in swamp forest. Twigs whitish or pale greyish brown, smooth; shoot tip glabrous. Leaves subcoriaceous to coriaceous, elliptic, oblong-elliptic or (narrowly) obovate, 9–20 by 3–7 cm, base cuneate to rounded, apex acute to acuminate, the acumen up to 10 mm long, glossy green and glabrous above, whitened from dense papillae below, secondary veins indistinct, 15–30 per side; petioles 6–15 mm long, glabrous. Inflorescences axillary, 2–10-flowered, or plants cauliflorous or ramiflorous, pedicels 12–30 mm long, reddish green to maroon, glabrous, each bearing a single, minute, triangular, caducous bract below the pedicel midpoint; buds ovoid. Sepals light green or reddish, ovate-triangular, 2–2.5 mm long, acute, outside pubescent, inside glabrous. Petals greenish yellow to yellow, apex obtuse, both sides finely pubescent; outer petals (narrowly) oblong to strap-like, 10–20 by 3–5 mm; inner petals (narrowly) oblong to oblong-ovate, 10–17 by 2.5–4 mm. Stamens numerous, (broadly) obovate, oblong or obconical, ca 1 mm long, anther connective apex truncate to slightly convex. Carpels 8–10, ca 15 mm long, oblong, glabrous to slightly pubescent, ovule 1 per carpel. Fruit with pedicel 15–25 mm long. Monocarps 2–12 per fruit, reddish, purplish or blackish when mature, globose, ca 15 mm in diam., glossy, glabrous, stipe up to 15 mm long; pericarp fleshy, not adhering to seed when dried. Seeds globose, 11–15 mm in diam., slightly striate, brown, ring encircling seed visible but slightly sunken, endosperm ruminations spiniform, sometimes formed into narrow triangular plates.

description: Tree up to 30 m tall; bark whitish or pale yellowish, smooth. Twigs whitish or pale yellow, smooth; shoot tip glabrous. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic to narrowly elliptic, 6–11 by 2–3.5 cm, base cuneate, sometimes asymmetrical, apex acuminate, the acumen up to 12 mm long, glossy green and glabrous above, whitened from dense papillae below, secondary veins indistinct, 15–30 per side; petioles 6–10 mm long, glabrous. Inflorescences axillary or also borne on branches below leaves, tubercles absent or poorly developed, 1-flowered, peduncle much reduced, up to 1.8 mm long, pedicels 1–7.5 mm long, bract caducous, minute, triangular, attached below pedicel midpoint; buds ovoid. Sepals light green, triangular, 0.7–1.2 mm long, acute, outside densely tomentose, inside glabrous. Petals greenish yellow to yellow, apex obtuse, both sides finely pubescent; outer petals (narrowly) oblong to strap-like, 4–11 by 1–2.4 mm; inner petals (narrowly) oblong to strap-like, 4–12 by 0.8–1.9 mm. Stamens numerous, (broadly) obovate, oblong or obconical, 0.7–1.1 mm long, anther connective apex truncate to slightly convex. Carpels 3–9, 0.5–1.2 mm long, oblong, glabrous or slightly pubescent to densely pubescent, ovule 1 per carpel. Fruit with pedicel 10–15 mm long. Monocarps 1–5 per fruit, green and becoming reddish, purplish or blackish when mature, ellipsoid, ca 11–20 by 9–14 mm, glossy, glabrous, stipe 2–5 mm long; pericarp thin. Seed ellipsoid, 12–16 by 9–11 mm, slightly striate, pale brown, ring encircling seed visible and raised, endosperm ruminations needle-like, very fine.

description: Evergreen trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves thinly coriaceous, linear or narrowly oblong, cuneate and symmetrical at base, apex acute or acuminate, midrib impressed above, secondary veins brochidodromous, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences internodal, supra-axillary or leaf-opposed, sometimes arising from leafless twigs, 1–3-flowered. Flowers hermaphroditic, discoid in bud. Sepals 3, valvate, connate at base, shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, curved inward over the stamens and carpels, fleshy, broadly elliptic or oblong, apex acute or blunt, outer petals slightly smaller than inner petals. Stamens numerous, anthers aseptate, filament conspicuous, anther connective apex truncate or slightly convex. Carpels numerous, stigmas capitate, higher than anther connective apex, ovule 1 per ovary, basal. Receptacle cushion-shaped. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, oblongoid to oblongoid-ellipsoid, smooth, glabrous, stipitate; pericarp thin, membranous when dried. Seed attached basally, 1 per monocarp, oblongoid, smooth, glabrous, brown, shiny, perichalazal ring sunken, aril absent, endosperm ruminations spiniform.</br></br>A tropical Asian genus of 5 species, all with short thick concave petals; 1 species is reported for Thailand.

description: Treelet to 4 m tall, bark smooth. Twigs glabrous. Leaves chartaceous, narrowly elliptic to oblong, 11.5–18(–25) by 2.2–4(–5.5) cm, base cuneate, apex acute to acuminate, the acumen 6–10 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 10–13 per side, indistinct below; petioles 3‒5 mm long, 1.8‒2 mm thick. Inflorescences 1–3-flowered, pedicels (3–)5‒7 mm long, each bearing 1 triangular bract at the base. Sepals triangular, 2–3 mm long, acute. Petals inwardly curved, green at anthesis, ovate, apex acute; outer petals 5–7 by 4‒5 mm; inner petals 6–8 by 5‒6 mm. Stamens numerous, oblong, 2.8–3 mm long, anther connective apex truncate or slightly convex. Carpels numerous, 0.8‒1.2 mm long, ovaries appressed-villous, stigmas more or less capitate, more expanded toward the apex. Fruit of up to 36 monocarps borne on a pedicel 8‒15 mm long. Monocarps red, oblongoid to oblongoid-ellipsoid, 15–20 by 8–10 mm, slightly wrinkled when dried, apex obtuse, apiculate, base contracted into a stipe 15–19 mm long. Seed oblong, 11–13 by 6–7 mm, slightly rugose when dried.

description: Evergreen trees or occasionally shrubs, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves chartaceous, rarely subcoriaceous, elliptic to oblong, occasionally ovate or lanceolate, cuneate to rounded and symmetrical at the base, midrib plane or sunken above, secondary veins weakly brochidodromous, tertiary venation frequently percurrent. Inflorescences axillary or from axils of fallen leaves, 1–3-flowered, plants sometimes cauliflorous. Flowers hermaphroditic, conical to ovoid in bud but petals usually separating early in the bud stage. Sepals 3, imbricate or valvate at base, free or connate at base, much shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, often with the inner petals remaining loosely pressed together at anthesis, linear to ovate, occasionally elliptic or oblong, the inner petals slightly shorter and narrower than the outer, with a conspicuous glabrous patch of warty or corrugated tissue toward the base on the inner surface. Stamens numerous, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate, sometimes sunken in the centre, obliquely elongated on stamens bordering the carpels. Carpels 1–17, stigmas globose to obovoid; ovules 3–16, attached laterally in 1–2 rows. Receptacle flat or slightly convex. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, oblongoid, ovoid, or cylindrical, occasionally ellipsoid or pyriform, slightly to strongly torulose, smooth or verrucose, usually pubescent, sessile or stipitate; pericarp thick or thin, membranous, woody or leathery when dried. Seeds attached laterally in 1–2 rows, up to 12 per monocarp, semicircular or elliptic in lateral view, usually flattened, smooth or slightly pitted, glabrous, perichalazal ring slightly sunken or raised, aril absent, endosperm ruminations lamellate or spiniform.</br></br>A genus of about 35 species distributed across tropical Asia, N Australia and the W Pacific, characterised by a warty to corrugated base on the inner petals; 8 species occur in Thailand.

description: Tree up to 20 m tall; bark dark brown, greyish brown or reddish brown, smooth to slightly rough. Twigs puberulent, soon glabrate. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic, oblong-elliptic, ovate, or oblanceolate, 7.5–20.3 by 2.5–6.3 cm, base cuneate to rounded, apex acuminate to caudate, the acumen 9–26 mm long, glabrous or with a few hairs on the secondary veins below, secondary veins arcuate, 7–11 per side, tertiary venation weakly percurrent; petioles 2.5–3 mm long. Inflorescences from axils of fallen leaves, 1(–2)-flowered, rarely plants cauliflorous, extended rachis absent, pedicels 5–7 mm long, 1–1.2 mm thick, pubescent, with 2–4 bracts on proximal half of pedicel; buds ovoid, slightly 3-angled in cross-section, apex acute. Sepals connate or slightly imbricate at base, reflexed, triangular, 3–4 mm long, acute. Petals pale tan-coloured to orange-brown, ovate to lanceolate, apex acute to obtuse; outer petals spreading at anthesis, 7–17 by 4.5–6.5 mm, finely pubescent on outer surface; inner petals erect to slightly spreading at anthesis, 6–11 by 4.5–5.3 mm, with a pale pink corrugated patch present on lower 1/2 of inner surface. Stamens cuneate to clavate, ca 0.7 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 5–14, stigmas obconical, ca 0.8 mm long. Fruit of up to 14 monocarps borne on a pedicel ca 8 mm long. Monocarps green to brown, oblongoid, ovoid, or pyriform, not torulose or rarely weakly torulose, 2.4–4.4 by 1.9–2.5 cm, verrucose, velvety black to orange-brown-tomentose (hairs matted), apex obtuse, sometimes apiculate, base contracted into a stipe 9–18 by 4–6 mm, sometimes with a distal abscission ring along which the seed-containing portion breaks irregularly; pericarp ca 2 mm thick. Seeds in two rows, up to 10 per monocarp, flattened-ellipsoid, 13–15 by 10–13 mm, ring encircling seed slightly sunken.

description: Tree to 10 m tall; bark brown. Twigs with a mixture of long appressed hairs and short erect hairs, eventually glabrate. Leaves chartaceous, narrowly to broadly elliptic, 5.9–11 by 1.6–4 cm, base cuneate, apex narrowly acuminate, the acumen 9–11 mm long, glabrous except for short erect hairs on the midrib above, sparsely appressed-hirsute below, secondary veins arcuate, brochidodromous, 6–9 per side, tertiary venation indistinctly percurrent; petioles 2–6 mm long. Inflorescences axillary, 1-flowered, extended rachis absent, pedicels 2–4 mm long, with 1–2 small bracts near the base; buds ovoid, petals separating early. Sepals valvate, free, broadly ovate, 2.5–5 mm long, obtuse to acute. Petals yellowish orange; outer petals linear-lanceolate to lanceolate, 15–20 by 4–6 mm, subacute, pubescent on outer surface; inner petals lanceolate, ca 18 by 5 mm, with a light pink corrugated patch on the proximal 1/3 of inner surface, obtuse. Stamens cuneate, 1.5–2.5 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 5–9, stigmas globose. Fruit of up to 4 monocarps borne on a pedicel ca 4 mm long. Monocarps green, cylindrical, slightly torulose, 1–2.7 by 0.7–0.9 cm, densely appressed-hirsute, apex often with a beak 4–8 mm long, base contracted into a stipe 3–5 mm long; pericarp thin. Seeds in a single row, up to 5 per monocarp, subglobose, ca 7 mm in diam., ring encircling seed raised.

description: Shrub or tree to 6 m tall. Twigs densely pubescent with persistent erect brown hairs. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic to oblong, 14.2–27.5 by 4.2–11.2 cm, base rounded, apex acuminate, the acumen 8–17 mm long, glabrous above, densely pubescent with erect hairs below, secondary veins more or less parallel, 11–16 per side, tertiary venation distinctly percurrent; petioles 4–7 mm long. Inflorescences borne on rachides 7.8–15 cm long emerging from the trunk, often near the base, branched, only a single flower maturing at a time at the end of each branch; pedicels 15–30 mm long, 1.2–1.3 mm thick, pubescent with erect hairs, with 2–5 lanceolate bracts up to 4.5 mm long attached along the proximal half of the axis; buds long-conical, apex obtuse. Sepals free or connate at base, lanceolate, 8–12 by 3.5–4 mm, caudate. Petals pale green, becoming red in vivo, linear-lanceolate, long-attenuate; outer petals slightly spreading at anthesis, at least 15–21 by 3.5–4.5 mm, ca 1 mm wide at midpoint, crisped-pubescent on outer surface; inner petals erect at anthesis, with small gaps between the bases, ca 17 by 4.5 mm, with a corrugated patch on proximal 1/8 of inner surface. Stamens many, narrowly cuneate, 1.5–2.5 mm long, anther connective apex truncate, slightly sunken in the middle, papillate. Carpels 5–6, stigmas globose, sparsely pubescent. Fruit of up to 6 monocarps borne on a pedicel ca 30 mm long. Monocarps irregularly oblong, weakly to strongly torulose, 3.4–3.9 by 1.3–1.7 cm, densely pubescent with erect brown hairs, apex rostrate, the beak 3–7 mm long, base rounded, sessile or contracted into a stipe 1–3 by 3 mm; pericarp thin. Seeds in a single row, up to 6 per monocarp, elliptic or semicircular in lateral view, flattened, 9–14 by 7–10 mm, ring encircling seed raised.

description: Tree up to 10 tall; trunk with stilt roots and aerial roots at the base to a height of 1 m, bark medium grey-brown, smooth. Twigs glabrate. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 18–22.8 by 6–8.9 cm, base rounded to broadly cuneate, apex acuminate to caudate, the acumen 13–15 mm long, glabrous above, soon glabrate or with a few hairs below, secondary veins more or less parallel, 12–14 per side, tertiary venation weakly percurrent; petioles 6–8 mm long. Inflorescences borne on rachides emerging from the lower part of the trunk and plunging downward into the soil, the flowers arising from the inflorescence axis up to 3 m from the trunk, branching, with only a single flower maturing at a time at each shoot tip, pedicels 8.5–18 mm long, 0.8–1 mm thick, initially appressed-pubescent but soon glabrate, with 2–4 ovate bracts 2–4.5 mm long scattered along the axis; buds ovoid, apex acute, petals separating well before maturity. Sepals free, ovate, 3.5–4 by ca 3 mm, acute to slightly acuminate. Petals pink to red, lanceolate; outer petals spreading at anthesis, 12–20 by 4.5–7 mm, acute to attenuate-acute, crisped-pubescent on outer surface; inner petals erect at anthesis, 8.5–15 by 5–6 mm, acute to obtuse, with a corrugated patch on proximal 1/3 of inner surface. Stamens cuneate, 1.4–1.7 mm long, anther connective apex truncate, pubescent. Carpels ca 2, stigmas ovoid to globose, ca 1 mm long. Fruit and seeds unknown.

description: Tree up to 8 m tall. Twigs sparsely pubescent, soon glabrate. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 13.5–24 by 4.8–9.8 cm, base rounded to broadly cuneate, apex narrowly acuminate, acumen 6–10 mm long, glabrous above, with a few hairs on the midrib and secondary veins below, secondary veins slightly arcuate, 8–11 per side, tertiary venation weakly percurrent; petioles 5–8 mm long. Inflorescences axillary or from axils of fallen leaves, 1-flowered, or rarely plants cauliflorous, extended rachis absent, pedicels 5–9 mm long, bearing 2 small bracts on proximal half of pedicel; buds not seen. Sepals connate at base, broadly ovate, 2.5–4 mm long, apex obtuse, recurved. Petals cream-coloured, obtuse; outer petals obovate, elliptic, or broadly lanceolate, 19–22 by 12–15 mm, sericeous on outer surface, inner petals broadly lanceolate, 17–18 by 7–9 mm, with a corrugated patch on proximal 1/4 of inner surface. Stamens ca 80, obconical to broadly clavate, 1–1.5 mm long, anther connective apex truncate, papillate. Carpels 3–4, stigmas obovoid, ca 1.3 mm long, densely pubescent. Fruit a single monocarp borne on a pedicel 8–10 mm long. Monocarps oblongoid, not torulose, 2.7–5.5 by 2.3–3.2 cm, wrinkled or smooth, pubescent with fine matted brown hairs, apex rounded, sessile; pericarp leathery. Seeds in two rows, ca 12 per monocarp, 12–17 mm long.

description: Tree up to 15 m tall; bark brownish white, brown-grey, or grey, smooth. Twigs densely pubescent with erect short brown hairs, eventually glabrate. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic, elliptic-oblong, or lanceolate-oblong, 25.6–34.5 by 5.7–9.8 cm, base cuneate to nearly rounded, apex acuminate, the acumen 12–26 mm long, glabrous above, sparsely pubescent with erect acicular hairs below, secondary veins ascending and parallel, 16–19 per side, tertiary venation distinctly percurrent; petioles 8–10 mm long. Inflorescences from axils of fallen leaves, 2–3-flowered, or plants sometimes cauliflorous, extended rachis absent, pedicels 4–7 mm long, pubescent, with 2 ovate bracts 2–4 mm long on proximal half of pedicel; buds lanceolate, but petals separating early. Sepals free or connate at base, ovate, 4–7 mm long, acute. Petals cream-coloured to light yellow, somewhat spreading at anthesis, linear, attenuate, acute, sericeous on outer surface; outer petals 29–35 by 5–6 mm; inner petals 26–27 by 4.5–5 mm, with a pink to purple corrugated patch on proximal 1/8 of inner surface. Stamens cuneate, ca 1 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 4–6, stigmas clavate, pubescent. Fruit of up to 6 monocarps borne on a pedicel 11–15 mm long. Monocarps ovoid to oblongoid, 2–4.9 by 1.8–3.1 cm, slightly torulose or not torulose, rugose, densely covered with short erect brown hairs, apex rounded, sessile; pericarp ca 2.7 mm thick. Seeds in two rows, up to 11 per monocarp, semicircular in lateral view, slightly flattened, ca 22 mm by 11 mm, ring encircling seed slightly sunken.

description: Tree up to 20 m tall; bark pale grey, smooth. Twigs glabrous. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic-oblong, 7.5–17 by 4–5.5(–6.2) cm, base cuneate to broadly cuneate, apex broadly blunt-acuminate, the acumen 6–9 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins arcuate, 11–13 per side, tertiary venation reticulate; petioles 4–6 mm long. Inflorescences axillary, 1-flowered, extended rachis absent, pedicels (2–)5–10 mm long, with 3 small bracts proximal to the midpoint; buds ovoid, apex obtuse, petals separating early in bud. Sepals connate at base, broadly ovate, 2.5–5 mm long, rounded, apiculate. Petals orange-red to red at anthesis; outer petals ovate-lanceolate to oblong, 19–23 by 2.5–9 mm, obtuse, finely pubescent on outer surface; inner petals broadly lanceolate, 15–19 by 4.5–5 mm, with a corrugated patch on proximal 1/2 of inner surface, acute to obtuse. Stamens cuneate, 1–2 mm long, anther connective apex truncate, sometimes sunken in the centre. Carpels 3–12, stigmas clavate, ca 1.5 mm long. Fruit of up to 15 monocarps borne on a pedicel 7.5–10 mm long. Monocarps green to whitish green, cylindrical, slightly torulose, 2–2.8 by 0.8–0.9 cm, glabrous, apex obtuse to rounded, base contracted into a thick stipe 1.5–3 mm long; pericarp orange when fresh, thin, membranous. Seeds in two interdigitated rows, up to 8 per monocarp, broadly elliptic in lateral view, flattened, ca 9 by 7–8 mm, ring encircling seed sunken into a groove.

description: Shrub or tree up to 12.5(–15 m) tall; bark grey to brown-grey, smooth. Twigs puberulent, soon glabrate. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic, ovate, or sometimes oblong-elliptic, 9.8–22 by 4.5–9 cm, base broadly cuneate to rounded, apex acuminate, the acumen 7–15 mm long, pubescent along midrib on both surfaces but otherwise glabrate, secondary veins slightly arcuate, 7–15 per side, tertiary venation distinctly percurrent; petioles 5–9 mm long. Inflorescences axillary, 1-flowered, extended rachis absent, pedicels ca 3 mm long, with 2 small bracts; petals separating early in bud. Sepals free to minutely connate, broadly ovate, ca 5 mm long, acute to attenuate. Petals cream-coloured to pale brownish yellow, acute to obtuse; outer petals linear to linear-lanceolate, 13–17 by 2.5–3.5 mm, finely pubescent on outer surface; inner petals lanceolate, 9–10 by 3–3.5 mm, with a pink-red, purple, or brown corrugated patch on proximal 1/2 of inner surface. Stamens clavate, ca 1 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 3–5, stigmas globose, ca 0.5 mm long. Fruit of up to 4 monocarps borne on a pedicel 3–5 mm long. Monocarps green, purplish, brown, or blackish yellow, oblongoid to ellipsoid, not torulose, 2.2–5.4 by 2.2–2.8 cm, grey- or brown-tomentose (hairs matted), apex rounded, sessile or rarely base contracted into a stipe up to 3 mm long; pericarp ca 3.5 mm thick, woody when dried. Seeds in two rows, 11–15 per monocarp, semicircular in lateral view, flattened, 15–20 by 10–11 mm, ring encircling seed raised as a ridge.

description: Evergreen trees, with distichous primary branching; buttresses small or absent. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves coriaceous to subcoriaceous, usually oblong or elliptic-lanceolate, base attenuate, obtuse, or cuneate and symmetrical, midrib sunken to slightly raised above, secondary veins prominent on both surfaces, brochidodromous, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, 2–9-flowered, plants often ramiflorous. Flowers hermaphroditic, ovoid in bud. Sepals 3, valvate, free to short-connate at base, much shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3(–4), valvate, free, (narrowly) elliptic, (narrowly) ovate to (narrowly) oblong, inner petals shorter than outer petals, elliptic to ovate. Stamens 9–18, arranged in 2 or 3 whorls, sometimes staminodial, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate. Carpel 1, with a groove running from stigma to base, stigma flat to capitate or horseshoe-shaped; ovules 2 per ovary, lateral, uniseriate. Receptacle slightly concave or elevated, hairy. Fruit a single indehiscent monocarp, globose, ellipsoid, or obovoid, glaucous, smooth when young and becoming verrucose when mature, stipitate or sessile; pericarp thick, woody when dried. Seed(s) attached laterally in 1 row, (1–)2, ellipsoid, flattened on one side, smooth, glabrous, brown to black, seed coat thick and woody, perichalazal ring slightly raised, aril absent, endosperm ruminations lamellate.</br></br>About 5 tropical Asian species; 2 species are known from Thailand. The hard seeds, up to 50 mm long, are among the largest in the family.

description: Tree ca 18 m tall. Twigs nearly glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic, 5.5–8.1 by 2.3–3.6 cm, base cuneate, apex acute, acuminate, or obtuse-rounded, rarely retuse, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins ca 12 per side; petioles 5–8 mm long. Inflorescences axillary from the axils of fallen leaves, in fascicles of up to 6 flowers, peduncle inconspicuous, bracts few, ovate-elliptic; pedicels ca 6.5 mm long, lacking bracts. Sepals ca 1/5-connate at base, erect to slightly spreading, broadly triangular-ovate, ca 1.1 mm long, broadly acute, densely and minutely pubescent outside. Petals in two whorls of 3, bright green, coriaceous; outer petals elliptic, ca 4.2 by 2.8 mm, obtuse; inner petals obovate, ca 4 by 2.2 mm, acute to obtuse. Stamens 14–18 per flower, broadly clavate, ca 0.6 mm long. Carpel ca 1 mm long, ovaries glabrous, stigma flat. Receptacle slightly elevated, tomentose-villous with appressed and erect hairs between stamens. Fruit [ex Sinclair 1955] subglobose, 3.7–5 cm in diam., with waxy bloom, sessile. Seeds [ex Sinclair 1955] 2, oblong, sub-compressed, 20–50 mm long.

description: Tree 12–40 m tall. Twigs brown to dark brown, glabrous, lenticellate. Leaves coriaceous, oblong to elliptic-lanceolate, 6–17 by 2.5–3.5 cm, base attenuate to obtuse, apex attenuate to acuminate, margin often wavy, secondary veins 8–10 per side; petioles 5–10 mm long. Inflorescences axillary or from axils of fallen leaves, fascicled, (1–)2–4(–9) flowered, peduncle inconspicuous, pedicels 5–15 mm long with a minute bract at base. Sepals free, often reflexed, ovate, ca 3 by 2 mm, mucronate. Petals in two whorls of 3(–4), greenish yellow; outer petals lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, sometimes linear, 12–15 by 2–3 mm; inner petals ovate to oblong, 5–6 by 2–3 mm. Stamens (9–)12(–16), broadly clavate, ca 0.8 mm long. Carpel ca 0.2 mm long. Fruit a single monocarp borne on a thickened pedicel 10–20 mm long. Monocarp yellowish green or brownish cream when mature, ovoid to ellipsoid or rarely subglobose, 4–8 cm long, glaucous when immature, sessile; pericarp thick and hard when dried. Seeds 2, flattened-ellipsoid, 30–40 by ca 20 mm, smooth, black.

description:
Evergreen or deciduous shrubs or trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves usually petiolate, sessile in a few species, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, base narrowly to broadly cuneate, obtuse, rounded, subcordate or cordate, symmetrical or asymmetrical, sometimes clasping twigs, midrib flat or slightly sunken, seldom raised, secondary veins inconspicuous to conspicuous, tertiary venation reticulate or reticulate-percurrent. Inflorescences axillary, from axils of fallen leaves or terminal developing to internodal, 1–9-flowered, occasionally a pair of 1-flowered inflorescences arising from the same leaf axil, peduncle present or absent, sometime extending into a short rachis up to 19 mm long. Flowers hermaphroditic or rarely unisexual (staminate in M. thorelii), subglobose, ovoid, ellipsoid or triangular pyramidal in bud, sometimes depressed at the apex, inner petals separating at a late developmental stage. Sepals 3, valvate, free or basally connate, much shorter than inner petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, triangular, ovate, elliptic or linguiform; outer petals similar in size to sepals, inner petals much larger than outer petals, erect, spreading or reflexed, sometimes with conspicuous glandular structures inside, base sometimes ± saccate and occasionally with translucent areas. Stamens 3–232, sometimes staminodial, ± clavate, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex miliusoid (not covering anther thecae), acute to obtuse or rounded, sometimes nearly absent. Carpels 3–80; ovule(s) 1 to 12 per ovary, basal to lateral, uniseriate or biseriate. Receptacle nearly flat to elevated, variable in shape. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, globose, subglobose, ellipsoid, cylindrical or irregular-shaped, glabrous or seldom hairy, smooth to verruculose, apex rounded or apiculate, sessile or stipitate and the stipe often obliquely attached to seed-containing portion; pericarp thin and membranous when dried, in a few species moderately thick and ± woody when dried. Seeds attached basally or laterally in 1–2 rows, up to 9 per monocarp, globose, subglobose, ellipsoid or cylindrical, sometimes flattened, smooth, glabrous, ± brown when dried, perichalazal ring sunken, aril absent, endosperm ruminations lamellate.

An Asian genus of about 60 species, witgh 23 species, 11 of them endemic, Thailand is probably the centre of diversity for the genus. [Coordinator Note: The four species groups delineated by Chaowasku & Kessler (2013) are all illustrated: Fig. 36, Plates XIX: D, Plates XX: B, XXI: F‒G (Miliusa mollis group); Plate XX: A (M. horsfieldii group); Plates XX: C‒D, XXI: C‒D (M. velutina group); Fig. 37, Plates XIX: E‒F, XX: E‒G, XXI: A‒B, E (M. campanulata group)].

description: Shrub or treelet to 8 m tall, evergreen. Twigs puberulous-tomentose. Leaves chartaceous-subcoriaceous, obovate to elliptic, 9.3–26 by 4–11 cm, base cordate, moderately asymmetrical, often ± clasping twigs, apex acuminate to slightly caudate-acuminate, glabrous on upper surface, almost glabrous to puberulous on lower surface, secondary veins 12–18 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, 1–2-flowered, peduncles 1–3 mm long or absent, rachis absent, pedicels 7–18 mm long, each bearing 1–2 bract(s). Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals connate at base, triangular, 1.3–1.5 mm long, apex ± acute. Outer petals triangular, 1.8–2 by 1.5–1.8 mm, apex ± acute. Inner petals greenish cream, chartaceous-subcoriaceous, completely separate, broadly ovate, 5–7.3 by 5–7.5 mm, apex ± acute, both sides of margin somewhat recurved at anthesis, base not saccate but with ± blackish brown glandular structures inside, thickened, between crescent-shaped and semicircular. Stamens 23–35, 0.8–1 mm long, anther connective apex acute-obtuse. Carpels 17–22, ovaries glabrous, stigmas capitate to clavate; ovule 1, basi-lateral. Receptacle hemispherical. Fruit of up to 15 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 18 mm long. Monocarps purplish black, subglobose-ellipsoid, 0.7–0.8 by 0.6–0.7 cm, ± smooth, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 3–5 mm long. Seed 1, subglobose-ellipsoid, 6.5–7.5 by 5.5–6 mm.

description: Shrub or treelet to 8 m tall, evergreen. Twigs glabrous. Leaves rather chartaceous, elliptic to slightly obovate, 7–23 by 2.3–6.3 cm, base cuneate to narrowly cuneate, symmetrical, apex acute, acuminate or caudate-acuminate, glabrous to almost glabrous on upper surface, glabrous on lower surface, secondary veins 8–18 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary or in axils of fallen leaves, sometimes two inflorescences present in the same axil, 1–4-flowered, peduncles 1–3 mm long or absent, rachis ca 2 mm long or absent, pedicels 14–60 mm long, each bearing 1–3 bract(s). Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, triangular to ovate-triangular, 1.5–2 mm long, apex ± acute. Outer petals ovate-triangular to narrowly ovate-triangular, 2–3 by 0.8–1 mm, apex ± acute. Inner petals with discolouration on basal half of inner petals (both sides) remarkably reticulate (much more clearly observed in living plants), chartaceous, usually tightly pressed together along margins from base to ± midpoint, ovate, 9.5–11.5 by 5–7.5 mm, apex acute, base slightly saccate, presence or absence of glandular structures undetermined, translucent window-like structures at base conspicuous (in living plants). Stamens 39–40, 1–1.3 mm long, anther connective apex obtuse to acute. Carpels ca 26, ovaries appressed-puberulous to appressed-villous, stigmas subglobose, ovoid, ovoid-ellipsoid to ellipsoid; ovule(s) 1(–2), basi-lateral, uniseriate when 2 ovules. Receptacle ± hemispherical to ellipsoid cylindrical. Fruit of up to 30 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 60 mm long. Monocarps purplish black, ± subglobose, 0.7–0.9 by 0.6–0.8 cm, ± slightly verruculose, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 10–20 mm long, sometimes attached obliquely to seed-containing portion. Seed(s) 1(–2), ± subglobose, sometimes slightly flattened, 6.5–7.5 by 5.5–7 mm.

description: Treelet to 1.5 m tall, evergreen. Twigs appressed-tomentose. Leaves rather chartaceous, elliptic to obovate-elliptic, 12.2–18 by 3.3–6 cm, base cuneate, symmetrical, apex caudate-acuminate, glabrous on both sides, secondary veins 9–12 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, sometimes two inflorescences present in the same axil, 1-flowered, peduncle and rachis absent, pedicels (11–)14–22(–30) mm long, each bearing 3–4 bracts. Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, ovate, 1.5–2 mm long, apex acute. Outer petals triangular-ovate, 1.5–2 by 1 mm, apex acute. Inner petals light green, with red-purple reticulation toward base, chartaceous, usually tightly pressed together along margins from base to ± midpoint, base slightly saccate, presence or absence of glandular structures undetermined, with translucent window-like structures, elliptic, 15–18 by 7–8.5 mm, apex broadly acute, obtuse, or rounded, with apical half strongly recurved. Stamens 48–50, 1–1.5 mm long, anther connective apex nearly absent. Carpels 49–71, ovaries appressed-puberulous, stigmas horseshoe-shaped; ovule 1, sub-basal. Receptacle ovoid. Fruit of up to 6 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 30 mm long. Monocarps green (immature), subglobose, 0.95–1.1 by 0.9–0.95 cm, smooth, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 11–18 mm long. Seed 1, subglobose, ca 8.5 by 7.5 mm.

description: Shrub or treelet to 4 m tall, evergreen. Twigs ± tomentose. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic to narrowly elliptic, 7.5–17.5 by 2.3–5.5 cm, base cuneate to narrowly cuneate, symmetrical, apex acuminate to caudate-acuminate, glabrous on upper surface, almost glabrous to villous on lower surface, secondary veins 11–18 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary or in axils of fallen leaves, 1–2-flowered, peduncles ca 2 mm long or absent, rachis absent, pedicels 15–60 mm long, each bearing 1–3 bract(s). Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, ovate-triangular to narrowly ovate-triangular, 1.5–3 mm long, apex ± acute. Outer petals narrowly triangular, 4–6 by 0.8–1 mm, apex acute-acuminate. Inner petals yellowish green, with reticulate discolouration on basal half, chartaceous, usually tightly pressed together along margins from base to ± midpoint, ovate, 10–21 by 6–12 mm, apex acute to sub-acute, base moderately saccate, presence or absence of glandular structures undetermined, with translucent window-like structures. Stamens 34–52, 0.8–1.2 mm long, anther connective apex obtuse to rounded. Carpels 32–50, ovaries puberulous-tomentose, sometimes hairs also appressed, stigmas ± ellipsoid to terete; ovule(s) 1(–2), lateral to basi-lateral, uniseriate when 2 ovules. Receptacle short-cylindrical, apex sub-acute to rounded. Fruit of up to 50 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 60 mm long. Monocarps dark purple, subglobose to ellipsoid, 0.7–1.1 by 0.6–0.7 cm, ± slightly verruculose, glabrous, apex sometimes apiculate, base contracted into a stipe 6–12 mm long, often obliquely attached to seed-containing portion. Seed(s) 1(–2), subglobose to ellipsoid, sometimes slightly flattened, 6.5–10 by 5.5–6 mm.

description: Shrub or treelet to 10 m tall, evergreen. Twigs glabrous to almost glabrous. Leaves rather chartaceous, obovate, elliptic or narrowly elliptic, 5–22.5 by 2–8 cm, base broadly to narrowly cuneate, symmetrical, apex acuminate to caudate-acuminate, sometimes ± caudate-acute, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 8–13 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, 1-flowered, peduncle and rachis absent, pedicels 19–52 mm long, each bearing 2–3 bracts. Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, ovate-triangular to broadly ovate-triangular, 1–2 mm long, apex acute. Outer petals ovate-triangular, 1.5–2.5 by 0.7–1.5 mm, apex acute. Inner petals ± yellow, ± pink-red discolouration on basal half of inner petals (more clearly visible inside) not (or very slightly) reticulate (much more clearly visible in living plants), chartaceous, usually tightly pressed together along margins from base to ± midpoint, ovate-elliptic to narrowly ovate-elliptic, 12–16 by 5–8 mm, apex acute-obtuse, base moderately saccate, presence or absence of glandular structures undetermined, window-like structures at base indistinct (in living plants, sometimes absent). Stamens ca 39, ca 1 mm long, anther connective apex obtuse. Carpels ca 19, ovaries appressed-pilose, stigmas ± ellipsoid; ovules 2, lateral, uniseriate. Receptacle hemispherical-subglobose. Fruit of up to 26 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 52 mm long. Monocarps bright red, subglobose to ellipsoid, sometimes irregularly shaped, 0.7–1.3 by 0.6–0.8 cm, ± smooth, glabrous, apex rounded or slightly apiculate, base contracted into a stipe 17–30 mm long. Seed(s) 1(–2), subglobose to ellipsoid, sometimes slightly flattened, 6–9 by 5–7 mm.

description: Shrub (probably), evergreen. Twigs puberulous-tomentose. Leaves rather chartaceous, elliptic, 10.9–13.8 by 2.8–4.1 cm, base cuneate, symmetrical, apex ± caudate-acuminate, glabrous on upper surface, almost glabrous to appressed-puberulous on lower surface, secondary veins 10–11 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, 1–2-flowered, peduncles inconspicuous or absent, rachis absent, pedicels ca 20 mm long, each bearing 1–2 bract(s). Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, narrowly triangular, ca 2.6 mm long, apex acuminate. Outer petals narrowly triangular, 2.5–3 by 0.7 mm, apex acuminate. Inner petals greenish yellow, red at base, chartaceous, usually tightly pressed together along margins from base to ± midpoint, elliptic to slightly ovate, ca 10 by 7 mm, apex obtuse, base slightly saccate, presence or absence of glandular structures undetermined. Stamens ca 22, ca 1 mm long, anther connective apex not observed. Carpels ca 16, ovaries glabrous, stigmas capitate; ovule 1, lateral to sublateral. Receptacle hemispherical to subglobose. Fruit unknown.

description: Shrub or tree to 15 m, semi-deciduous to deciduous. Twigs velvety, hairs sometimes appressed, bud scales present, obvious, covering vegetative buds. Leaves chartaceous, ± subsessile, elliptic, sometimes slightly ovate or slightly obovate, 2.7–9 by 1.7–3.2 cm, base cuneate to rounded, usually slightly asymmetrical, apex acute to slightly acuminate, glabrous on upper surface, glabrous to almost glabrous on lower surface, secondary veins 12–15 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary on new sprouting shoots, 1-flowered, peduncle and rachis absent, pedicels 4–15 mm long, each bearing 2 bracts. Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals slightly connate at base, triangular, ca 1.2 by 1 mm, apex ± acute. Outer petals ovate-triangular, ca 1.9 by 1.1 mm, apex ± acute. Inner petals greenish yellow, chartaceous-subcoriaceous, completely separate, ovate-triangular, 3–3.4 by 2.5–3.1 mm, densely hairy inside (mostly near margin and on apical half), apex ± acute-obtuse, base not saccate but with greenish yellow glandular structures inside, slightly thickened, ± semicircular. Stamens ca 16, ca 0.8 mm long, anther connective apex nearly absent. Carpels 2–5, ovaries glabrous, stigmas ellipsoid; ovule 1, subbasal. Receptacle ovoid-ellipsoid. Fruit of up to 3 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 15 mm long. Monocarps dark purple, subglobose-ellipsoid, ca 1 by 0.8 cm, ± smooth, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 1.5–2 mm long. Seed 1, subglobose-ellipsoid, ca 9 by 7 mm.

description: Shrub or treelet to 4 m tall, evergreen. Twigs tomentose. Leaves rather chartaceous, sessile to almost sessile, elliptic to broadly elliptic, sometimes slightly obovate, 2.4–8 by 1–3.3 cm, base cuneate to broadly cuneate, slightly asymmetrical, apex acute to ± caudate-acuminate, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 10–15 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences borne on mature shoots, axillary or in axils of fallen leaves, 1–3-flowered, peduncles ca 3 mm long or absent, rachis ca 3 mm long or absent, pedicels 5–10 mm long, each bearing 2–3 bracts. Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals connate at base, ovate-triangular to broadly ovate-triangular, 1–1.4 mm long, apex ± acute. Outer petals ovate-triangular, 1.5–1.8 by 1.1–1.4 mm, apex ± acute. Inner petals greenish yellow, chartaceous-subcoriaceous, completely separate, ovate-triangular to broadly ovate-triangular, 2.5–3.5 by 3–3.5 mm, glabrous inside, apex ± obtuse, base not saccate but with greenish yellow glandular structures inside, thickened, between crescent-shaped and semicircular. Stamens (6–)8–13 per flower, ca 0.8 mm long, sometimes ca 3 staminodes present, anther connective apex rounded-obtuse, Carpels 3–8, ovaries glabrous, stigmas ± subglobose; ovule 1, basal. Receptacle nearly flat to ± hemispherical. Fruit of up to 3 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 10 mm long. Monocarps green (immature) slightly ellipsoid, 0.8–1 by 0.6–0.8 cm, ± smooth, verruculose, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 1.5–2 mm long, attached obliquely to seed-containing portion. Seed 1, slightly ellipsoid, 7.5–9.5 by 5.5–7.5 mm.

description: Shrub-like treelet 1–1.5 m tall, evergreen. Twigs tomentose with erect and appressed hairs. Leaves subcoriaceous, ± subsessile, elliptic, sometimes slightly obovate, 7.4–14.6 by 3.8–5.6 cm, base obtuse, apex caudate-acuminate to bluntly acute, glabrous on upper surface, glabrous on lower surface, secondary veins 9–15 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, sometimes two inflorescences present in the same axil, 2–3-flowered, peduncles 1–2.5 mm long, rachis short or absent, pedicels 18–20 mm long, each bearing 1 bract. Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals connate at base, broadly ovate, 1–1.5 mm long, apex ± acute. Outer petals ovate, 2.5–2.8 by 1.5–2 mm, apex ± acute. Inner petals pale to yellowish green, chartaceous-subcoriaceous, completely separate, broadly ovate, 6.5–7.5 by 5.5–8 mm, apex broadly acute, base not saccate, with blackish brown glandular structures inside near base, thickened, between crescent-shaped and semicircular. Stamens 31–33, 0.8–1 mm long, anther connective apex rounded-obtuse. Carpels 6–18, ovaries glabrous, stigmas subglobose; ovule 1, basal. Receptacle ± conical. Fruit of up 11 monocarps, borne on a pedicel to 24 mm long. Monocarps black, ± subglobose, 0.9–1 by 0.85–0.89 cm, smooth, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 1.5–2.5 mm long, often attached obliquely to seed-containing portion. Seed 1, subglobose-ellipsoid, ca 6.5 by 8.5 mm.

description: Shrub, evergreen. Twigs velvety. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic, 11–19 by 4.1–8.1 cm, base cuneate, symmetrical, apex acute-acuminate, glabrous on upper surface, velvety on (= densely hairy) lower surface, secondary veins ca 16 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, 2–4-flowered, peduncles 1–2 mm long, rachis inconspicuous or absent, pedicels 4–5 mm long, each bearing 1–2 bract(s). Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, triangular, 1.5–1.6 mm long, apex ± acute. Outer petals triangular, 1.8–2 by 1.1–1.2 mm, apex ± acute. Inner petals pale green, purple inside at base, chartaceous, usually tightly pressed together along margins from base to ± midpoint, elliptic-oblong, ca 14 by 7 mm, apex acute-obtuse, base slightly saccate. Stamens ca 48, ca 1.3 mm long, anther connective apex rounded. Carpels ca 11, ovaries puberulous, stigmas globose-capitate; ovules 2, lateral, uniseriate. Receptacle slightly ovoid. Fruit unknown.

description: Tree to 28 m tall, deciduous. Twigs tomentose. Leaves rather chartaceous, elliptic, sometimes elliptic-obovate, 5.5–16 by 2–6 cm, base obtuse, sometimes rounded, slightly asymmetrical, apex obtuse, acute or slightly acuminate, puberulous on upper surface, tomentose, sometimes with sparser hairs, on lower surface, secondary veins 8–11 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences terminal developing to internodal (but sometimes appearing as ‘axillary’), 1–2-flowered, peduncles 2–3 mm long or absent, rachis absent, pedicels 6.5–19 mm long, bract not observed (probably absent). Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, linguiform-elliptic, 2.5–6 mm long, reflexed at anthesis, apex ± acute. Outer petals linguiform, 4.5–8 by 1.5–2 mm, reflexed at anthesis, apex ± acute. Inner petals yellow-green, red-tinged on basal half, rather chartaceous, ovate to narrowly ovate, 19–29 by 9–14.5 mm, apex acuminate, acute to bluntly acute, with narrow longitudinal (± linguiform) glandular structures present inside along midvein, red-purple, base conspicuously saccate. Stamens 35–60, 0.6–1 mm long, anther connective apex acute-obtuse. Carpels 22–35, ovaries appressed-villous, stigmas subglobose to ellipsoid; ovules 6–10, lateral, biseriate. Receptacle elongated-hemispherical, sometimes obovoid. Fruit of up to 14 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 24 mm long. Monocarps red-purple, globose, subglobose to irregular-shaped, 1.1–1.9 by 0.95–1.7 cm, ± smooth, almost glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 8–24 mm long. Seeds 2–5, flattened-ellipsoid, 9.5–13 by 7–9 mm.

description: Shrub or treelet to 8 m tall, evergreen. Twigs puberulous-velvety. Leaves rather chartaceous, ± subsessile, elliptic to elliptic-ovate, 3–9 by 1.1–3.5 cm, base cordate to subcordate, moderately asymmetrical, often slightly clasping twigs, apex acute-acuminate, glabrous on upper surface, almost glabrous on lower surface, secondary veins 12–16 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, 1-flowered, peduncle and rachis absent, pedicels 4–8 mm long, each bearing 2–3 bracts. Flowers hermaphroditic; buds pale green. Sepals connate at base, triangular, ca 1.2 mm long, apex ± acute. Outer petals triangular, ca 1.3 by 1 mm, apex ± acute. Inner petals yellow-green, chartaceous-subcoriaceous, completely separate, broadly ovate, 2.2–2.5 by 2.7–3.3 mm, apex broadly acute to acute-obtuse, both sides of margin somewhat recurved at anthesis, base not saccate but with blackish brown glandular structures, thickened, between crescent-shaped and semicircular. Stamens 9–13, ca 0.6 mm long, anther connective apex rounded. Carpels 3–4, ovaries glabrous, stigmas globose; ovule 1, basal. Receptacle subglobose. Fruit of 1 monocarp borne on a pedicel up to 8 mm long, sometimes with 1 or 2 additional underdeveloped monocarp(s). Monocarp dark purple, subglobose, ca 0.8 by 0.6 cm, ± slightly verruculose, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 1–1.5 mm long. Seed 1, subglobose, ca 7 by 5 mm.

description: Shrub or treelet to 8 m tall, evergreen. Twigs villous with erect hairs. Leaves chartaceous, (narrowly) ovate to (narrowly) ovate-elliptic, 2.7–5.3 by 1–2 cm, base subcordate, slightly asymmetrical, sometimes slightly clasping twigs on one side, apex acute to acute-acuminate, seldom obtuse or rounded-obtuse, glabrous on upper surface, tomentose-villous with erect hairs (equivalent to densely hairy) on lower surface, secondary veins 8–10 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary or in axils of fallen leaves, 1–2-flowered, peduncles inconspicuous or absent, rachis absent, pedicels 12–15 mm long, each bearing 1 bract. Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals connate at base, broadly ovate-triangular, 0.8–1 mm long, apex broadly acute. Outer petals ovate to broadly ovate, 1.5 by 1–1.3 mm, apex ± acute. Inner petals greenish white, chartaceous-subcoriaceous, completely separate, broadly ovate, 3 by 3.3–3.5 mm, apex broadly acute, base not saccate, with blackish brown glandular structures inside near base (ca 1 mm higher than base), thickened, ± crescent-shaped. Stamens 11–13, 0.8–1 mm long, anther connective apex nearly absent. Carpels 5–7, ovaries glabrous, stigmas globose; ovule 1, basal. Receptacle depressed hemispherical. Fruit of up to 4 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 22 mm long. Monocarps black, subglobose, ca 0.7 by 0.6 cm, smooth, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 3–3.5 mm long. Seed 1, subglobose, ca 6.5 by 5.5 mm.

description: Shrub or treelet to 6 m tall, evergreen. Twigs villous. Leaves rather chartaceous, sessile, obovate, elliptic, ovate-elliptic, to ovate, 1.8–8.7 by 1.1–3 cm, base cordate to subcordate, moderately asymmetrical, sometimes slightly clasping twigs, apex obtuse, acute or caudate-acuminate, glabrous on upper surface, tomentose-villous on lower surface, secondary veins 9–14 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary or in axils of fallen leaves, 1–3-flowered, peduncles 1–3.5 mm long or absent, rachis short or absent, pedicels 4–10 mm long, each bearing 2–3 bracts. Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals connate at base, ovate-triangular to broadly ovate-triangular, 1.1–1.4 mm long, apex ± acute. Outer petals ovate-triangular, 1.3–1.6 by 1.1–1.5 mm, apex ± acute. Monocarps dark purple, subglobose, 0.7–0.9 by 0.6–0.8 cm, ± smooth, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 2.5–4 mm long, often attached obliquely to seed-containing portion. description: Shrub ca 2 m tall, evergreen. Twigs puberulous, hairs sometimes appressed. Leaves rather chartaceous, sessile to almost sessile, elliptic-oblong to narrowly elliptic-oblong, sometimes slightly obovate, 5–10.1 by 1.8–3.1 cm, base cordate, notably asymmetrical, always distinctly clasping twigs, apex caudate-acuminate, glabrous on upper surface, glabrous to almost glabrous on lower surface, secondary veins 12–14 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, 2-flowered, peduncles inconspicuous, rachis absent, pedicels 12–14 mm long, each bearing 1–2 bract(s). Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals and outer petals ovate-triangular, not clearly observed. Inner petals yellow-green, chartaceous-subcoriaceous, completely separate, broadly ovate, ca 3 by 3.5 mm, apex broadly acute to acute-obtuse, base not saccate but with blackish brown glandular structures, thickened, between crescent-shaped and semicircular. Stamens not counted or measured, anther connective apex ± rounded. Carpels not counted, ovaries glabrous, stigmas ovoid to ovoid-ellipsoid; ovule not observed. Receptacle not observed. Fruit of up to 10 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 14 mm long. Monocarps purple-black, globose to subglobose, 0.6–0.7 by 0.6 cm, ± slightly verruculose, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 5–7 mm long. Seed 1, globose to subglobose, 5–6 by 5 mm.

description: Treelet to 3 m tall, semi-deciduous. Twigs tomentose. Leaves rather chartaceous, elliptic to elliptic-ovate, 4–11.5 by 1.5–5 cm, base cuneate-obtuse, sometimes rounded, often slightly asymmetrical, apex ± acute, glabrous on upper surface, ± puberulous on lower surface, secondary veins 8–14 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences terminal, developing to internodal (but sometimes appearing as ‘axillary’), 1–3-flowered, peduncles 1.5–2.5(–5) mm long or absent, rachis conspicuous or absent, pedicels 5–9 mm long, each bearing 1 bract. Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, triangular to broadly triangular, 0.7–1.3 mm long, apex ± acute. Outer petals triangular to broadly triangular, 1–1.4 by 0.7–1.3 mm, apex ± acute. Inner petals light green, chartaceous-subcoriaceous, completely separate, ovate to broadly ovate, 3–5 by 2–4 mm, apex ± acute, base not saccate, presence or absence of glandular structures undetermined. Stamens 30–40, 1–1.5 mm long, anther connective apex acute. Carpels 10–13, ovaries tomentose-villous, stigmas capitate to clavate; ovules 3–6, lateral, biseriate. Receptacle elongated hemispherical. Fruit of up to 8 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 10 mm long. Monocarps dark purple, ellipsoid, 0.9–1.3 by 0.6–0.8 cm, surface not observed, apex ± apiculate, base contracted into a stipe 2–4 mm long. Seeds 2–4, flattened-ellipsoid, 6–9 by 3–4 mm.

description: Treelet ca 1 m tall, evergreen. Twigs puberulous, hairs sometimes appressed. Leaves rather chartaceous, often somewhat bullate, elliptic, 5.4–10.5 by 2–4.1 cm, base cuneate, sometimes slightly asymmetrical, apex acuminate to caudate-acuminate, glabrous on upper surface, puberulous with appressed hairs on lower surface, secondary veins 8–11 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, 1–2-flowered or a pair of 1-flowered inflorescences arising from the same axil, peduncles inconspicuous or absent, rachis absent, pedicels 5–11 mm long, each bearing 3–5 bracts. Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, triangular, 1.8–2.1 mm long, apex acute. Outer petals triangular-ovate to narrowly triangular-ovate, 2.4–3 by 0.9–1.2 mm, apex acute. Inner petals cream-yellow, with somewhat red venation at base, chartaceous, usually tightly pressed together along margins from base to ± midpoint, elliptic, ca 15 by 9 mm, apex acute-obtuse, base slightly to moderately saccate, presence or absence of glandular structures undetermined, with translucent window-like structures. Stamens 38–39, 1–1.1 mm long, anther connective apex almost absent. Carpels 12–13, ovaries puberulous to sparsely puberulous, stigmas subglobose, ellipsoid, to ellipsoid-obovoid; ovule 1, sub-basal to sub-lateral. Receptacle ± subglobose. Fruit unknown.

description: Tree to 25 m tall, deciduous. Twigs glabrous to almost puberulous. Leaves between chartaceous and subcoriaceous, elliptic to broadly elliptic, 8–22.5 by 5–9.1 cm, base cuneate to broadly cuneate, sometimes between obtuse and rounded, symmetrical, apex acute, broadly acute, cuspidate or caudate-acuminate, sometimes obtuse, glabrous on upper surface, glabrous to ± puberulous on lower surface, secondary veins 10–15 per side, tertiary venation reticulate to reticulate-percurrent. Inflorescences terminal developing to internodal (but sometimes appearing as ‘axillary’), 2–4-flowered, peduncles ca 1 mm long, rachis short or absent, pedicels 10–20 mm long, bract not observed (probably absent). Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, triangular, ca 3 mm long, apex ± acute. Outer petals linguiform, ca 4.5 by 1.2 mm, apex ± acuminate. Inner petals ± greenish yellow, rather chartaceous, completely separate, narrowly ovate-triangular, 19–21 by 8.5–9.5 mm, apex acuminate to acute-acuminate, narrow longitudinal (± linguiform) glandular structures present inside along midvein, brown-purple, base moderately saccate. Stamens 50–80, ca 1 mm long, anther connective apex obtuse. Carpels 9–14, ovaries appressed-villous, stigmas subglobose-ellipsoid to terete; ovules ca 6, lateral, biseriate. Receptacle elongated hemispherical. Fruit of up to 7 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 20 mm long. Monocarps dark purple, globose to subglobose-ellipsoid, sometimes irregularly shaped, 2.4–3.6 by 2.2–3.1 cm, smooth, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 14–21 mm long. Seeds ca 5, flattened-ellipsoid, ca 16 by 10 mm.

description: Shrub to 2 m tall, evergreen. Twigs puberulous to puberulous-velvety. Leaves chartaceous, sessile, narrowly elliptic-oblong, sometimes slightly obovate-oblanceolate, 4.5–11 by 1.2–2.9 cm, base cordate, notably asymmetrical, always distinctly clasping twigs, apex ± acuminate, glabrous on upper surface, glabrous to almost glabrous on lower surface, secondary veins 11–16 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, 1–2-flowered, peduncles ca 2 mm long or absent, rachis absent, pedicels 6–13 mm long, each bearing 1–2 bract(s). Flowers hermaphroditic; buds pink-orange. Sepals connate at base, triangular, ca 1.5 mm long, apex ± acute. Outer petals triangular, ca 1.9 by 1.3 mm, apex ± acute. Inner petals pale pink-orange, chartaceous-subcoriaceous, completely separate, broadly ovate-triangular, 2.3–2.5 by 2.6–3.7 mm, apex acute-obtuse, base not saccate but with blackish brown glandular structures inside, thickened, ± crescent-shaped. Stamens ca 13, ca 0.7 mm long, anther connective apex ± obtuse. Carpels ca 4, ovaries glabrous, stigmas globose to capitate; ovule 1, basal. Receptacle hemispherical. Fruit of up to 3 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 13 mm long. Monocarps dark red, globose, 0.6–0.7 by 0.6–0.7 cm, ± slightly verruculose, glabrous, apex rounded, almost sessile. Seed 1, globose, ca 5 by 5 mm.

description: Shrub or treelet to 6 m tall, evergreen. Twigs puberulous-velvety to velvety. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic to obovate, 5–20 by 2.5–7.3 cm, base slightly subcordate to cordate, slightly to moderately asymmetrical, apex acute to caudate-acuminate, glabrous on upper surface, glabrous to puberulous on lower surface, secondary veins 8–14 per side, tertiary venation reticulate to reticulate-percurrent. Inflorescences axillary, 1–4-flowered, peduncles up to 5 mm long or absent, rachis ca 4 mm long or absent, pedicels 16–50 mm long, each bearing 1–3 bract(s). Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, linguiform, 3–5.3 mm long, apex ± acute. Outer petals linguiform, ca 6 by 1.5 mm, apex ± acute. Inner petals whitish yellow to creamy yellow, nerves red only at base, chartaceous, usually tightly pressed together along margins from base to ± midpoint, elliptic, 18–26 by 11–15 mm, apex acute-obtuse, base moderately saccate, presence or absence of glandular structures undetermined, translucent window-like structures nearly absent. Stamens 25–30, 1.6–1.8 mm long, anther connective apex acute-obtuse to obtuse. Carpels generally 15–50, ovaries glabrous, stigmas capitate to slightly ovoid; ovule(s) 1(–2), basi-lateral, uniseriate when 2 ovules. Receptacle slightly cylindrical. Fruit of up to 50 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 50 mm long. Monocarps red, subglobose to irregular-shaped, 0.7–1.1 by 0.6–0.9 cm, ± verruculose, glabrous, apex apiculate, base contracted into a stipe 15–35 mm long, sometimes attached obliquely to seed-containing portion. Seed(s) 1(–2), globose to subglobose, sometimes slightly flattened, 6–8 by 5–6 mm.
