description: Shrub or treelet to 6 m tall, evergreen. Twigs glabrous to almost glabrous. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic, sometimes ovate or obovate, 17–32 by 5.5–14.3 cm, base cuneate to obtuse, symmetrical, apex broadly acute, acute, to ± caudate-acuminate, glabrous on upper surface, glabrous to almost glabrous on lower surface, secondary veins 7–14 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary or in axils of fallen leaves, 2–9-flowered, peduncles inconspicuous, rachis up to 5 mm long or absent, pedicels 7–22 mm long, each bearing 1 bract. Flowers hermaphroditic or unisexual (plants androdioecious: staminate in one individual and hermaphroditic in another). Sepals free, ovate-triangular to narrowly ovate-triangular, 2–3 mm long, apex acute. Outer petals ovate-triangular to narrowly ovate-triangular, 2–3 by 1–1.5 mm, apex acute. Inner petals yellowish green to ± cream, with reticulate discolouration on basal half, chartaceous, usually tightly pressed together along margins from base to ± midpoint, ovate-elliptic, 10–13 by 5.5–7.5 mm, apex obtuse, base slightly saccate, presence or absence of glandular structures undetermined, translucent window-like structures at base obvious. Stamens 35–100 in staminate flowers, 2–8 in hermaphroditic flowers, 1–1.5 mm long, sometimes a few staminodes present in hermaphroditic flowers, anther connective apex acute. Carpels 44–50 in hermaphoditic flowers, ovaries appressed-puberulous, stigmas terete; ovule(s) 1(–2), basi-lateral, uniseriate when 2 ovules. Receptacle conical to conical-cylindrical in staminate flowers, ± hemispherical in hermaphroditic flowers. Fruit of up to 28 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 22 mm long. Monocarps ± black, subglobose, 0.7–1.1 by 0.6–0.9 cm, ± smooth, glabrous, apex rounded, sometimes slightly apiculate, base contracted into a stipe 9–16 mm long, often obliquely attached to seed-containing portion. Seed(s) 1(–2), subglobose, sometimes slightly flattened, 7.5–9 by 6.5–7 mm.

description: Treelet to 4 m tall, evergreen. Twigs puberulous, hairs sometimes appressed. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic, 4.6–14 by 2–4.8 cm, base cuneate, symmetrical, apex caudate-acuminate, rarely acute, glabrous on upper surface, almost glabrous on lower surface, secondary veins 11–14 per side, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, 1-flowered, peduncle and rachis absent, pedicels 13–19 mm long, each bearing 3 bracts. Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, ovate-triangular, ca 1.5 mm long, apex ± acute. Outer petals ovate, ca 1.7 by 1.2 mm, apex ± acute. Inner petals purplish brown to purplish green, chartaceous, usually tightly pressed together along margins from base to ca 2/3 of inner petal length, ovate, 9–10 by 6 mm, apex rounded-obtuse, strongly recurved and with warty glandular structures inside (ca 1/3 of inner petal length), base slightly saccate, with translucent window-like structures. Stamens ca 20, ca 1 mm long, anther connective apex nearly absent. Carpels ca 12, ovaries appressed-velvety, stigmas subglobose-ellipsoid; ovule 1, lateral. Receptacle slightly ovoid, Fruit of up to 7 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 19 mm long. Monocarps dark purple, subglobose-ellipsoid, ca 0.9 by 0.7 cm, ± slightly verruculose, almost glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe ca 5 mm long, sometimes obliquely attached to seed-containing portion. Seed 1, subglobose-ellipsoid, ca 8 by 6 mm.

description: Tree to 20 m tall, deciduous. Twigs tomentose-villous. Leaves chartaceous-subcoriaceous, broadly ovate to broadly elliptic, sometimes slightly broadly obovate, 8–36 by 6–18 cm, base rounded, sometimes obtuse or subcordate, symmetrical, apex broadly acute, between broadly acute and cuspidate, to rounded, tomentose on upper surface, tomentose-villous on lower surface, secondary veins 8–13 per side, tertiary venation reticulate to reticulate-percurrent. Inflorescences terminal, developing to internodal (but sometimes appearing as ‘axillary’), 2–6-flowered, peduncles 7–25 mm long, rachis 11–19 mm long or absent, pedicels 25–80 mm long, bract not observed, only tufts of hairs usually observed instead. Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, ovate-triangular, sometimes narrowly ovate-triangular, 3.5–5 mm long, apex acute. Outer petals narrowly elliptic to narrowly triangular, 4.5–6.5 by 1–2 mm, apex acute-acuminate. Inner petals yellowish green, subcoriaceous, completely separate and reflexed, ovate, 11–15 by 6.5–8.5 mm, apex acute to acute-obtuse, both sides of margin somewhat recurved at anthesis, base not saccate but thickened and somewhat glandular. Stamens 125–155, 1–1.8 mm long, anther connective apex obtuse to rounded. Carpels 50–85, ovaries appressed-villous, stigmas subglobose to ovoid; ovule(s)(1–)2, lateral to basi-lateral, uniseriate when 2 ovules. Receptacle subglobose to ovoid. Fruit of up to 20 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 107 mm long. Monocarps red, subglobose to subglobose-ellipsoid, 1.4–1.9 by 1.2–1.8 cm, ± smooth, puberulous-tomentose with erect hairs, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 8–17 mm long. Seed(s) 1(–2), ellipsoid or flattened-ellipsoid, 10–14 by 7–10 mm.

description: Evergreen woody climbers, with distichous primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, base cuneate to rounded, midrib slightly sunken above, secondary venation indistinct, brochidodromous, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, sometimes with a vegetative shoot growing out from the same axil, 1–2-flowered. Flowers hermaphroditic, obovoid to ellipsoid and strongly three-angled in bud. Sepals 3, valvate, connate at the base, much smaller than outer petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, fleshy, ovate, ovate-lanceolate, or elliptic, spreading at anthesis, concave at the base, inner petals shorter than the outer petals, forming a dome over the centre of the flower. Stamens numerous, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex capitate. Carpels numerous, stigmas filiform, lanceolate, or oblong; ovules up to 8 per ovary, lateral, biseriate. Receptacle cushion-shaped, truncate at apex. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, globose to ovoid, glabrous, smooth, stipitate; pericarp thin, membranous when dried. Seeds attached laterally, interdigitated to form a single row, up to 5 per monocarp, circular, flattened, pitted, black, shiny, perichalazal ring slightly raised, aril absent, endosperm ruminations spiniform, slightly flattened.</br></br>About 8 tropical Asian species of climbers with strongly three-angled buds; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Woody climber to ca 10 m. Twigs glabrous, or sparsely fine-puberulent and soon glabrate. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, lanceolate, elliptic, or oblong, 7.9–15.3 by 3.2–4.4 cm, base broadly cuneate to rounded, apex obtuse to short-acuminate, the acumen 5–5.5 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 11–17 per side; petioles 10–16 mm long. Inflorescences 1–2-flowered, peduncles 1 mm long, pedicels 10–15 mm long, bearing 2–3 bracts < 1 mm long; buds ovoid. Sepals triangular, coriaceous, 2–3.5 mm long, obtuse to apiculate, often slightly concave, sparsely puberulent. Petals fleshy, yellow to orange, sometimes pink-tinged on the inner surface; outer petals ovate to ovate-elliptic, 12–19 by 7–10 mm, obtuse to acute; inner petals ovate-lanceolate, 4–7 by 2.5–4 mm, acute, with a short tuft of hairs at the apex of the inner concavity. Stamens oblong, 1–1.5 mm long. Carpels ca 10, ovaries glabrous, stigmas lanceolate to oblong, acute to obtuse. Receptacle cushion-shaped, truncate, 1.2–2 mm in diam. Fruit of up to 8 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 13 mm long. Monocarps red, globose to ovoid, 0.8–1.3 by 0.6–1 cm, glabrous, smooth or finely verrucose, apex rounded, stipe 6–9 by 1.2–1.4 mm; pericarp ca 0.5 mm thick. Seeds in a single row, up to 5 per monocarp, flattened-circular, 5.7–6.7 by 5.7–6.3 mm.

description: Evergreen trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves coriaceous (rarely papyraceous), ovate, elliptic or lanceolate, base symmetrical, midrib slightly sunken or plane above, secondary venation brochidodromous, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences terminal or leaf-opposed (later becoming extra-axillary), 1–3-flowered, sometimes elongated and forming a rachis. Flowers hermaphroditic; buds broadly depressed-ovoid. Sepals 3, valvate, ± basally connate, shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, outer petals generally larger than inner, not clawed; inner petals 3, basally clawed, apically connivent over reproductive organs, forming a mitriform dome with 3 lateral apertures, petal glands absent. Stamens numerous, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate, dilated. Carpels few to numerous, stigmas narrowly obconical; ovules lateral, biseriate, 2–18 per ovary. Receptacle cushion-shaped. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, 2–22 per fruit, subglobose, obovoid or oblongoid, pubescent, smooth or rarely warty, sometimes with a longitudinal ridge, sessile or stipitate; pericarp of variable thickness. Seeds attached laterally in 2 rows, 1–14 per monocarp, semi-lenticular (lowermost and uppermost within monocarp) or discoid (others), transversely striate and pitted, glabrous, light brown to dark brown, perichalazal ring shallowly sunken, aril absent, endosperm ruminations spiniform.</br></br>About 50 species of trees with showy, often multi coloured, flowers, distributed throughout tropical and subtropical S & SE Asia and Australia (Queensland); 11 species in Thailand.

description: Shrub or tree to 8 m tall. Young branches sparsely pubescent. Leaves coriaceous, ovate to lanceolate, 6–18 by 3–6.5 cm, base acute or obtuse, apex acute, matt above, sparsely pubescent below, secondary veins 7–11 pairs, without domatia; petioles 2–6 mm long. Inflorescences with rachides simple, the rachis internodes remaining short, < 3-flowered, velutinous, pedicels 10–16 mm long. Sepals deltate, 1.5–2.5 by 2.5–3 mm, sparsely pubescent abaxially. Outer petals white, broadly ovate, 13–21 by 10.5–15.5 mm, margin ± undulate with age, sparsely pubescent abaxially. Inner petals white with pink or purple margins, 9–14.5 by 5.5–11 mm, densely pubescent abaxially, woolly towards apex adaxially. Stamens 0.9–1.4 mm long. Carpels ca 16, 0.9–1.5 mm long; ovules 5–10. Fruit of ca 4 monocarps borne on a pedicel 9.5–14(–17) mm long, sparsely pubescent. Monocarps yellow-green when mature, globose to oblongoid, (1.6–)2.2–3.3(–3.8) by 1–1.8 cm, sometimes reniform, warty, with a longitudinal ridge, not glaucous, sparsely pubescent, stipe 6–15 mm long, not glaucous, sparsely pubescent. Seeds ca 10, 10–12 by 7–9 mm.

description: Treelet to ca 1 m tall. Young branches tomentose. Leaves papyraceous, elliptic to slightly ovate, 4.5–9.5 by 1.5–3 cm, base cuneate to slightly obtuse, apex acute to acuminate, slightly glossy above, puberulous below, secondary veins 9–10 pairs, without domatia; petioles 3–4 mm long. Inflorescences with rachis internodes inconspicuous, 2–3-flowered, tomentose, pedicels 2–2.5 mm long. Sepals broadly ovate, 1–1.5 by ca 2 mm, villous abaxially. Outer petals white, turning cream-yellow, ovate-elliptic, 4.5–5 by ca 3.5 mm, margin not undulate with age, tomentose abaxially. Inner petals white, turning cream-yellow, 5–5.5 by 4–6 mm, tomentose abaxially. Stamens ca 0.7 mm long. Carpels (1–)2–3, 1–1.1 mm long; ovules 2–4. Fruit of 1–3 monocarps borne on a pedicel to 3 mm long, tomentose. Monocarps red when mature, ovoid, 0.95–1 by 0.75–0.8 cm, smooth, without longitudinal ridge, not glaucous, tomentose, sessile. Seed solitary, 7–8 by 6–7 mm.

description: Shrub or tree to 6 m tall. Young branches sparsely pubescent. Leaves coriaceous, ovate to lanceolate, 7.5–17.5 by 2.5–6 cm, base acute or obtuse, apex acute, matt above, sparsely pubescent below, secondary veins 7–11 pairs, without domatia; petioles 3–8.5 mm long. Inner petals yellow marked with pink, 7.5–9.5 by 4.5–6 mm, densely pubescent abaxially, pilose towards apex adaxially. Stamens 1–1.2 mm long. Carpels 12–14, 1.5–1.8 mm long; ovules 6–12. Fruit of 4–9 monocarps borne on a pedicel ca 10 mm long, sparsely pubescent. Monocarps red when mature, oblongoid, 1.4–3 by ca 0.75 cm, smooth, without longitudinal ridge, not glaucous, sparsely pubescent, stipe 3–3.5 mm long, not glaucous, sparsely pubescent. description: Tree to 10 m tall. Young branches densely pubescent. Leaves coriaceous, lanceolate, (8–)10–14 by 3–4.5 cm, base obtuse, apex acute, glossy above, subglabrous to sparsely pubescent below, secondary veins 7–9 pairs, without domatia; petioles 6–8.5 mm long. Inflorescences with rachides simple, the rachis internodes remaining short, < 3-flowered, densely pubescent, pedicels 12–20 mm long. Sepals ovate, 3–4 by 3–3.5 mm, velutinous abaxially. Outer petals white, turning yellow, elliptic to ovate, 18–25 by 11–20 mm, margin not undulate with age, sparsely pubescent abaxially. Inner petals purple, 11–13 by 6.5–8.5 mm, sparsely pubescent abaxially. Stamens 1.5–1.9 mm long. Carpels 7–8, 2–2.5 mm long; ovules 8–10. Fruit of ca 6 monocarps borne on a pedicel ca 13 mm long, sparsely pubescent. Monocarps yellow when mature, obovoid, ca 3.8 by 2.5 cm, smooth, with a longitudinal ridge, sparsely pubescent, stipe 14–18 mm long, sparsely pubescent. Seeds 4–8, ca 12 by 10 mm.

description: Treelet or tree to ca 5 m tall. Young branches glabrous to sparsely pubescent. Leaves coriaceous, ovate to elliptic, 9–13 by 3.5–5 cm, base obtuse to slightly cuneate, apex acute to slightly acuminate, ± matt above, glabrous below, secondary veins 6–8 pairs, without domatia; petioles 3.5–5 mm long. Outer petals cream-coloured (turning yellowish in late-stage flowers), ovate, 11.5–12.5 by 7–8 mm, margin not undulate with age, pubescent abaxially. Inner petals pale pink with whitish margins and near point of apical connivance (turning yellowish in late-stage flowers), ca 9.5 by ca 3 mm, indument unknown. Stamens 0.9–1 mm long. Carpel 1, ca 1.4 mm long; ovules ca 9. Fruit of one monocarp borne on a pedicel ca 6 mm long, indument unknown. description: Tree to ca 6 m tall. Young branches densely pubescent. Leaves coriaceous, lanceolate, (6.5–)11–22 by 4–9 cm, base acute or obtuse, apex acute to short-acuminate, glossy above, sparsely pubescent below, secondary veins 8–11 pairs, without domatia; petioles 4.5–9.5 mm long. description: Tree to 20 m tall. Young branches densely pubescent. Leaves coriaceous, ovate to lanceolate, 5–17.5(–21.5) by 1.5–7.5(–9.5) cm, base obtuse or acute, apex acute to short-acuminate, matt above, subglabrous to sparsely pubescent below, secondary veins 5–13 pairs, sometimes with pocket-like domatia in axils below; petioles 5–14 mm long. Monocarps orange-yellow when mature, obovoid, 1.1–3.2 by 1–2.5 cm, smooth, without longitudinal ridge, glaucous, densely pubescent, stipe 5–22(–31) mm long, glaucous, sparsely pubescent. description: Tree to ca 20 m tall. Young branches densely pubescent. Leaves coriaceous, ovate, lanceolate or rarely oblong, 6.5–21.5 by 3–10 cm, base rounded or slightly cordate, apex acute to short-acuminate, glossy above, densely pubescent below, secondary veins (8–)14–20 pairs, without domatia; petioles 4–12.5 mm long. description: Tree up to 10 m tall, bark brownish grey, furrowed, with knobs. Twigs pubescent with conspicuous lenticels. Leaves chartaceous, asymmetrically oblanceolate or oblong, 10.5‒18 by (3.7–)4.5‒7.5 cm, base asymmetrically cuneate to obtuse, apex acuminate, the acumen 7‒15 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces except for hairs along the midrib and lateral veins, midrib grooved above, secondary veins fairly straight, 10‒12 per side, tertiary venation percurrent; petioles 5‒8 mm long, flat above, pubescent. Inflorescences forming fascicles in axils of leafless twigs and on woody tubercles of trunks, 2‒5-flowered, pedicels 25‒35 mm long, 2‒2.2 mm thick, pubescent, each bearing one adnate ovate bract 1.5‒2 by 1.5‒1.7 mm between the base and the midpoint; buds ovoid. Sepals valvate, free, thinly coriaceous, triangular, 6‒8 by 3‒4 mm, apex acute and recurved, pubescent outside and glabrous inside. Petals imbricate at the apices, incurved, pale pink to red, thinly coriaceous, ovate, apex acute, puberulous outside and glabrous inside, longitudinal veins conspicuous; outer petals 30‒35 by 10‒12 mm, base with claw 4–5 mm long; inner petals 28‒33 by 12‒15 mm, base with claw 5–7 mm long. Stamens cuneate, 1‒1.2 mm, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels numerous, 1.5‒1.8 mm long, pubescent, stigmas higher than anther connective apices, clavate, 0.6‒0.7 mm long, pubescent. Receptacle cushion-shaped, 4‒5 mm in diam., 1.5‒2 mm thick, pubescent. Fruit of up to 25 monocarps borne on a pedicel 30‒55 mm long, 2.5‒3 mm thick. Monocarps red to black when mature, oblongoid, 2.2‒2.5 by 1.2‒1.5 cm, smooth, glabrous, apex and base obtuse, stipe 40‒55 mm long, 2‒2.2 mm thick; pericarp less than 1 mm thick. Seeds oblongoid, 20‒22 by 10‒12 mm, light brown, smooth, slightly shiny.

description: Tree up to 20 m tall, bark smooth, grey to greyish black. Twigs glabrous with conspicuous lenticels. Leaves thinly coriaceous, brittle both fresh and dried, asymmetrically elliptic or oblong, 9.5‒15 by 2.5‒5 cm, base obtuse or cuneate, apex acute or acuminate with acumen 7–10 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces, midrib shallowly grooved above, secondary veins fairly straight, 10‒12 per side, tertiary venation percurrent; petioles 5‒10 mm long, grooved above. Inflorescences fascicled in axils of leafy twigs and on woody tubercles of leafless twigs, 3‒8-flowered, pedicels 2.5‒3 cm long, puberulent, each bearing an adnate ovate bract 3‒4 by 2‒3 mm between the base and the midpoint; buds cushion-shaped. Sepals valvate, free, chartaceous, broadly ovate, 5‒7 by 3‒4 mm, apex obtuse, puberulous outside and glabrous inside. Petals imbricate at the apices, spreading, yellow with red or dark red on both sides at base, thinly coriaceous, oblong, apex acute, glabrous on both sides; outer petals 23‒33 by 6‒8 mm; inner petals 25‒35 by 8‒11 mm. Stamens cuneate, 1.4‒1.6 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels numerous, 1.8‒2 mm long, stigmas higher than the anther connective apices, obovate, 0.8‒1 mm long, pubescent. Receptacle cushion-shaped, 3‒4 mm in diam., 2‒3 mm thick, pubescent. Fruit up to 38 monocarps borne on a pedicel 30‒55 mm long, 4‒5 mm thick. Monocarps orange to dark red when mature, oblongoid, 2.5‒3.5 by 1.4‒1.8 cm, glabrous, apex and base obtuse, stipe 25‒45 mm long, 2‒2.5 mm thick; pericarp ca 1.5 mm thick. Seeds oblong, 23‒32 by 12‒16 mm, brown, smooth, often shiny.

description: Tree up to 25 m tall, bark smooth, light brown. Twigs puberulous and eventually glabrate with conspicuous lenticels. Leaves chartaceous, asymmetrically elliptic or oblanceolate, 14‒30 by 6‒12 cm, base cuneate or obtuse, apex acuminate, the acumen 15‒20 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces, midrib shallowly grooved above, secondary veins straight, 16‒18 per side, tertiary venation percurrent; petioles 5‒10 mm long, shallowly grooved above. Inflorescences of monochasial cymes in the axils of leafy or leafless twigs, 4‒8-flowered, peduncle 3‒5 mm long, 1‒1.5 mm thick, rachis 5‒10 mm long, 1‒1.5 mm thick, pedicels 20‒35 mm long, 0.5‒0.7 mm thick, pubescent, each bearing an adnate broadly ovate bract 1‒1.5 by 1‒1.5 mm at the midpoint; buds ovoid. Sepals valvate, chartaceous, broadly ovate, 5‒6 by 3‒4 mm, apex acute with tips recurved, pubescent outside and glabrous inside. Stamens short-cuneate, 1‒1.2 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels numerous, 1.2‒1.5 mm long, stigmas sunken lower than anther connective apices, obovate, 0.5‒0.7 mm long, pubescent. Receptacle cushion-shaped, 2‒3 mm in diam., 1‒1.5 mm thick, pubescent. Fruit of up to 33 monocarps borne on a pedicel 50‒70 mm long, 3‒4 mm thick. Monocarps yellow to red when mature, oblongoid, 2.5‒3 by 1.4‒1.8 cm, smooth, glabrous, apex obtuse, base broadly cuneate, stipe 30‒45 mm long, 1‒1.2 mm thick; pericarp ca 1 mm thick. Seeds oblongoid, 24‒28 by 12‒17 mm, light brown, smooth, often shiny.

description: Tree up to 25 m tall, bark shallowly and vertically grooved, light grey. Twigs glabrous with conspicuous lenticels. Leaves chartaceous, asymmetrically elliptic, 20‒37(‒40) by (6‒)8‒15 cm, base obtuse, apex acuminate, the acumen 1.5‒2 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces, midrib shallowly grooved above, secondary veins straight, 18‒20 per side, tertiary venation percurrent; petioles 15‒20 mm long, shallowly grooved above. Inflorescences forming fascicles in axils of leafless twigs, 4‒8-flowered, pedicels (15–)20‒30 mm long, 0.4‒0.5 mm thick, pubescent, each bearing an adnate ovate bract 2‒3 by 2‒3 mm, apex obtuse; buds ovoid. Sepals valvate, free, chartaceous, triangular, 4‒8 by 4‒6 mm, apex acute with tips recurved, pubescent on both sides. Petals valvate at the apices, spreading, green to pale yellow, thinly coriaceous, oblong, apex acute, puberulous on both sides; outer petals 13‒30 by 3‒5 mm; inner petals 15‒35 by 5‒7 mm. Stamens short-cuneate, 0.8‒1 mm long, anther connective apex truncate to slightly convex. Carpels numerous, 0.8‒1 mm long, stigmas level with or sunken lower than the anther connective apices, obovate, 0.3‒0.5 mm, pubescent. Receptacle cushion-shaped, 3‒4.5 mm in diam., 1.8‒2.2 mm thick, pubescent. Fruit of up to 24 monocarps borne on a pedicel 25‒40(‒50) mm long, 3‒4 mm thick. Monocarps yellow to red when mature, ellipsoid to oblongoid, 2.8‒3.3 by 1.5‒2 cm, smooth, glabrous, apex and base obtuse, stipe 30‒45 mm long, 1.5‒2.5 mm thick; pericarp ca 0.5 mm thick. Seeds oblongoid, 24‒28 by 14‒18 mm, light brown, smooth, often shiny.

description: Evergreen trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of intermixed stellate and simple hairs. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, base obtuse, cuneate, or broadly cuneate, symmetrical, midrib slightly sunken above, secondary veins rather conspicuous, tertiary venation percurrent. Inflorescences axillary or from axils of fallen leaves, 1–few-flowered. Flowers hermaphroditic, subglobose to ovoid in bud, petals separating at a late developmental stage. Sepals 3, valvate, free, shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, ± carnose; outer petals elliptic to elliptic-ovate; inner petals ovate to (broadly) ovate-elliptic, slightly smaller than the outer whorl, often apically thickened. Stamens 12–40, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 4–12, stigmas subglobose-ellipsoid to ellipsoid-cylindrical; ovule 1(–2) per ovary, basal. Receptacle more or less flat. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, ellipsoid to ellipsoid-ovoid, hairy, nearly smooth, sessile; pericarp rather thick. Seed basally attached, 1 per monocarp, ellipsoid to ellipsoid-ovoid, rather smooth, glabrous or hairy, ± brown when dried, perichalazal ring sunken, aril absent, endosperm ruminations lamellate.</br></br>A tropical Asian genus of about 8 species. Two species are known from Thailand; the stellate indument and tree habit are shared only with Drepananthus in the Thai flora.

description: Tree to 15 m tall. Twigs tomentose. Leaves rather chartaceous, elliptic, 10.2–32.3 by 3.3–10.1 cm, base (broadly) cuneate, apex generally narrowly acuminate, sparsely appressed-puberulous above, indument mostly on basal half near midrib, sparsely stellate-hairy below, secondary veins 15–21 per side, rather distinct below. Inflorescences 1-flowered, pedicels (3–)5–6(–8) mm long, each bearing ca 2 bracts. Sepals broadly triangular, ca 2.1 mm long. Petals ± yellowish green; outer petals ovate-elliptic, 5.2 by 2.8–3 mm; inner petals ovate, 4–5 by 2.5 mm, apically thickened. Stamens 12–15, ca 1.4 mm long. Carpels 4–6, ovaries appressed-tomentose. Fruit of up to 3 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 8 mm long with sepals persistent. Monocarps pale green (submature), ellipsoid, 3.1–3.3 by 2–2.5 cm, sparsely pubescent, apex rounded. Seed ellipsoid, 26–28 by 16–21 mm.

description: Tree to 11 m tall. Twigs densely velvety-villous. Leaves rather chartaceous, elliptic, (9.5–)13–21.5 by (4–)4.7–9.1 cm, base broadly cuneate to obtuse, apex caudate-acuminate, almost glabrous above, densely stellate-hairy below, secondary veins 17–18 per side, rather distinct below. Inflorescences 1-flowered, flowers nearly sessile (pedicels ± 1 mm long, each with usually 2 bracts). Sepals (broadly) ovate-triangular, ca 7.5 mm long. Petals ± yellowish green; outer petals elliptic, 11.5–13.5 by 6.5–8 mm; inner petals (broadly) ovate-elliptic, 8.5–10 by 7.5–8.5 mm, apically thickened. Stamens 16–20(–22), 1.6–1.7 mm long. Carpels 5–8, ovaries densely villous. Receptacle ± flat. Fruit of up to 5 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 5 mm long. Monocarps brown, ellipsoid-ovoid, 6.5–7 by 5.2–5.5 cm, covered with velvety dark brown hairs, apex rounded. Seed ellipsoid to ellipsoid-ovoid, ca 50 by 34–35 mm.

description: Evergreen shrubs, treelets, or trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, base cuneate, broadly cuneate, obtuse, or rounded, seldom cordate or subcordate, symmetrical to slightly asymmetrical, midrib ± sunken, secondary veins inconspicuous to conspicuous, tertiary venation reticulate, reticulate-percurrent or percurrent. Inflorescences axillary, sometimes from axils of fallen leaves, or terminal developing to supra-axillary or internodal, 1–5-flowered, pedunculate, pedicels sometimes borne on an elongated rachis. Flowers hermaphroditic, subglobose, ovoid, or ± triangular-pyramidal, sometimes depressed at the apex, in bud. Sepals 3, valvate, free or basally connate, shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, outer petals ca twice as large as sepals, usually more or less ovate, separating at a middle developmental stage, inner petals divided into blade and claw, blade ± rhombic, ± trullate, or ± subcircular, nectary glands usually present adaxially, blades generally connivent at anthesis, sometimes tips ± separated at anthesis, claw short to long. Stamens 3, 6, 9, or 12, ± clavate, outermost sometimes staminodial, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex miliusoid (not covering anther thecae), nearly lacking. Carpels 3, 6, 9, or 12, rarely 11 or 14, stigmas ± curved-terete, ellipsoid, subglobose, or globose; ovule(s) 1–10 per ovary, basi-lateral or lateral, uniseriate when multiple ovules. Receptacle slightly elevated, hairy, apex rounded to flat-topped. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, ellipsoid, ellipsoid-cylindrical, cylindrical, or globose, rarely short-oblongoid, sometimes moniliform, glabrous or hairy, smooth, subsessile or stipitate; pericarp thin. Seeds attached sub-basally or laterally in 1 row, up to 6 per monocarp, ellipsoid, cylindrical or globose, sometimes flattened on one side when globose, smooth or shallowly pitted, often transversely wrinkled when dried, glabrous, ± brown when dried, perichalazal ring nearly plane to sunken, aril absent, endosperm ruminations spiniform.</br></br>An Asian genus of about 60 species; 2 subgenera, Orophea and Sphaerocarpon Kessler, are recognised, both represented among the 8 species occurring in Thailand. The name Orophea refers to the “roof” formed by the inner petals. Leonardía & Kessler (2001) reported O. malayana Kessler to occur in Peninsular Thailand, but our re-investigations do not support this.

description: Tree to 10 m tall. Twigs tomentose with erect and appressed hairs. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic to slightly obovate, 9.3–24 by 3.3–9.5 cm, base obtuse, rounded or slightly subcordate, symmetrical, apex caudate-acuminate, the acumen 11–32 mm long, puberulous with erect and appressed hairs on both surfaces, secondary veins 8–13 per side, rather distinct below, tertiary venation percurrent. Inflorescences terminal, developing to supra-axillary or internodal, 1–4-flowered, peduncle 4.5–13 mm long when present, rachis up to 10 mm long when present, pedicels 11–23 mm long, each bearing a single bract near midpoint. Flowers ovoid in bud. Sepals free, ovate-triangular, 5–7 mm long, apex ± acuminate. Outer petals yellowish green, ± chartaceous, ovate, elliptic, broadly ovate or broadly elliptic, 10–16 by 8–10 mm, apex acute to acuminate. Inner petals yellowish green, ± red-pink toward apex, coriaceous, ± rhombic to ± broadly elliptic, 12–15 by 4–4.5 mm, blades connivent at anthesis, apex acute-acuminate, claw 8.5–11.5 mm long, nectary gland one, covering ± 80 percent of blade, ± red-pink, ± subcircular, raised and sunken in the middle. Stamens ca 1.8 mm long, fertile stamens 6, staminodes 6, anther connective apex obtuse. Carpels 6, ovaries villous with appressed hairs, stigmas ± curved-terete; ovule 1, basi-lateral. Fruit of up to 2 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 23 mm long. Monocarps orange, ellipsoid-cylindrical, ca 2.2 by 0.7 cm, puberulous with erect and appressed hairs, apex apiculate, base contracted into a stout stipe ca 3 mm long. Seed 1, ellipsoid-cylindrical, ca 20 by 6.5 mm, surface not observed.

description: Tree to 12 m tall. Twigs tomentose-villous with appressed hairs, Leaves chartaceous, elliptic, rarely obovate, 3.2–18.1 by 1.4–7.2 cm, base obtuse to rounded, rarely cuneate, symmetrical, apex slightly acute, caudate-acute, or caudate-acuminate, almost glabrous to pilose with erect and appressed hairs on upper surface, almost glabrous to puberulous with erect and appressed hairs on lower surface, secondary veins 6–10 per side, rather distinct below, tertiary venation percurrent. Inflorescences axillary, in axils of fallen leaves or terminal developing to supra-axillary or internodal, 2–4-flowered, peduncles 2–18 mm long, rachis up to 23 mm long when present, pedicels 3–15 mm long, each bearing 1 bract at midpoint. Flowers broadly ovoid in bud. Sepals free, ovate to ovate-triangular, ca 2 mm long, apex acute. Outer petals yellowish green, chartaceous, ovate, sometimes elliptic, 3–5 by 2–3.5 mm, apex usually acute. Inner petals ± pink, yellowish green toward apex, chartaceous, ± trullate and clawed toward base, 5–7.5 by 2–4 mm, blades connivent at anthesis, apex acute to obtuse, claw 2.5–3.5 mm long, nectary glands two, side-by-side, colour unknown, each ± semicircular to ± subcircular, slightly sunken. Stamens ca 1 mm long, fertile stamens 6, staminodes 6, anther connective apex acute. Carpels 6, ovaries tomentose with erect and appressed hairs, stigmas ± curved-terete; ovules ca 5, lateral, uniseriate. Fruit of up to 6 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 15 mm long. Monocarps bright orange, ellipsoid to cylindrical (moniliform), 1.3–3.7 by 0.5–0.9 cm, puberulous with erect and appressed hairs, apex sometimes bluntly apiculate, base contracted into a stout stipe up to 2.5 mm long. Seed(s) 1–2, ellipsoid to cylindrical, 10–14 by 4–8 mm, surface not observed.

description: Shrub or tree to 10 m tall. Twigs subglabrous to puberulous with appressed hairs, Leaves chartaceous, elliptic, rarely obovate, 2.9–13.5 by 1.3–5 cm, base cuneate, sometimes obtuse, symmetrical, apex ± caudate-acuminate, glabrous on upper surface, puberulous with erect and appressed hairs on lower surface, secondary veins 6–9 per side, rather distinct below, tertiary venation percurrent or sometimes percurrent-reticulate. Inflorescences terminal developing to supra-axillary or internodal, 2–4-flowered, peduncles 5–12 mm long, rachis up to 6.5 mm long or absent, pedicels 6–17 mm long, each bearing 1 bract at or just below midpoint. Flowers ± triangular-pyramidal in bud. Sepals free, ovate-triangular, 2–2.5 mm long, apex acute. Outer petals whitish yellow, chartaceous, ovate, 8–12 by 5–8 mm. Inner petals whitish yellow, ± crimson-tinged around glands, subcoriaceous, ± trullate, 12–17.5 by 3–4 mm, blades connivent at anthesis, apex acute, claw 8–12 mm long, nectary glands two side-by-side or one at base of blade, ± crimson-tinged, ± transversely elliptic, slightly sunken, edge slightly raised and sinuate. Stamens 1–1.5 mm long, fertile stamens 6, staminodes 6, anther connective apex not visible above the thecae. Carpels 6, ovaries villous with appressed hairs, stigmas subglobose to ellipsoid; ovules 2–6, lateral, uniseriate. Fruit of up to 6 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 22 mm long. Monocarps red, cylindrical, often moniliform, 2–8 by 0.5–0.7 cm, puberulous with appressed hairs, apex apiculate, beak 5–7 mm long, base contracted into a stout stipe 5–8 mm long. Seed(s) 1–6, cylindrical, 13–16 by 4–6 mm, surface transversely wrinkled when dried.

description: Shrub to 4 m tall. Twigs villous, with shorter hairs intermixed. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic, sometime elliptic-ovate, 4.8–12 by 2–5 cm, base subcordate to cordate, slightly asymmetrical, apex bluntly acute to slightly caudate-acuminate, almost glabrous on upper surface, ± tomentose with appressed hairs on lower surface, secondary veins 8–12 per side, indistinct below, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences terminal, often developing to internodal, 2–3-flowered, peduncles 11–20 mm long, rachis up to 3 mm long when present, pedicels 5–6 mm long, bract not seen (probably absent). Flowers subglobose in bud. Sepals connate to half of sepal length, ovate-triangular, ca 1.6 mm long, apex acute. Outer petals ± red, chartaceous, ovate-triangular, ca 3 by 2–2.5 mm, apex acute-obtuse. Inner petals chartaceous-subcoriaceous, ± subcircular and clawed toward base, ca 7 by 2–2.5 mm, blades connivent at anthesis, white, apex pale yellow, connivent at anthesis, apex obtuse, claw red, ca 4 mm long, nectary glands not visible (probably absent). Stamens 6, length not measured, staminodes absent, anther connective apex not visible above the thecae. Carpels 3–5, ovaries glabrous, stigmas subglobose; ovule(s) 1–2, lateral, uniseriate when 2. Fruit of up to 5 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 7 mm long. Monocarps yellowish green (immature), ca 1 by 1 cm, globose, apex rounded, subsessile, puberulous with erect hairs. Seed not observed.

description: Tree to 9 m tall. Twigs almost glabrous. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic, 8.6–20.6 by 3.5–7.7 cm, base cuneate to obtuse, symmetrical, apex ± caudate-acuminate, seldom acute, glabrous on upper surface, puberulous with appressed hairs on lower surface, secondary veins 6–10 per side, rather distinct below, tertiary venation reticulate or sometimes reticulate-percurrent. Inflorescences axillary or in axils of fallen leaves, sometimes two inflorescences present in the same axil, 1–4-flowered, peduncles 1–8 mm long or absent, rachis up to 5 mm long or absent, pedicels 2.5–3.5 mm long, each bearing 1 bract, usually attached below the midpoint of pedicel. Flowers ± ovoid in bud. Sepals connate at base, ovate-triangular, 1–1.3 mm long, apex acute. Outer petals red-pink, chartaceous-subcoriaceous, ovate, 3.5–5 by 3–3.5 mm, apex acute to acute-obtuse. Inner petals red-pink, subcoriaceous, ± rhombic, 6–8 by 3–4 mm, blades connivent (except tips, ± separated) at anthesis, tip (ca 1/3 of blade) yellow, apex obtuse to acute-obtuse, claw 2.5–4 mm long, nectary gland one near base of blade, colour unknown, ± horseshoe-shaped, slightly sunken. Stamens 12, 0.5–1 mm long, staminodes absent, anther connective apex obtuse-acute. Carpels 12, ovaries puberulous-pilose with appressed hairs, stigmas subglobose to ellipsoid; ovules 2, lateral, uniseriate. Fruit of up to 12 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 4 mm long. Monocarps dark red-purple (nearly black), globose, 0.9–1.5 by 0.85–1.4 cm, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 3–6 mm long. Seed(s) 1–2, globose, sometimes flattened on one side, 9–11 by 8.5–10 mm, smooth.

description: Tree to 8 m tall. Twigs puberulous with erect and appressed hairs. Leaves chartaceous, ovate to elliptic, 4.9–9.5 by 2.1–4.2 cm, base cuneate to obtuse, slightly asymmetrical (usually at the very base), apex acute, glabrous on upper surface, puberulous with appressed hairs on lower surface, secondary veins 6–8 per side, rather indistinct below, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary or terminal, developing to internodal, 2–5-flowered, peduncle 5–15.5(–17.5) mm long, rachis short when present, pedicels 4.5–14 mm long, each bearing a single bract near midpoint. Flowers subglobose-ovoid in bud. Sepals connate at base, broadly ovate-triangular, 1 mm long, apex acute to broadly acute. Outer petals yellowish white, chartaceous, broadly ovate, 2.5–3.7 by 3–4 mm, apex acute to obtuse. Inner petals yellowish white, apex ± yellow, chartaceous-subcoriaceous, ± rhombic, 4.5–7(–8) by 2–3.5 mm, blades connivent but tips sometimes slightly separated at anthesis, apex acute to broadly acute, claw 2–2.5 mm long, nectary glands two, green to yellow and sunken in the middle, each ± curved-linear, ± narrowly elliptic or ± elongated-rhombic. Stamens 6, ca 1 mm long, staminodes absent, anther connective apex broadly acute. Carpels 12, ovaries glabrous to almost glabrous, stigmas globose to subglobose; ovules 2, lateral, uniseriate. Fruit of up to 4 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 14 mm long. Monocarps dark purple, globose, 0.85–1.15 by 0.85–1.05 cm, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 3–7.5 mm long. Seed(s) 1–2, ± globose, sometimes flattened on one side, 7.5 by 4.5–7.5 mm, shallowly pitted.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Tree to 8 m tall. Twigs ± puberulous. Leaves chartaceous-subcoriaceous, elliptic, 6.2–14.3 by 2.4–5 cm, base cuneate to broadly cuneate, symmetrical, apex caudate-acuminate, sometimes ± caudate-acute, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 6–8 per side, rather distinct below, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary or in axils of fallen leaves, 1–2-flowered, peduncles ca 1 mm long when present, pedicels 4–5 mm long, each bearing 1–2 bract(s) near midpoint and/or near base. Flowers more or less ovoid in bud. Sepals slightly connate at base, triangular-ovate, ca 1.5 mm long, apex slightly acuminate. Outer petals with colour unknown, ovate, ca 4.5 by 4 mm, apex acute. Inner petals subcoriaceous, ± rhombic, ca 10 by 2.5 mm, blades connivent (except tips, ± separated), apex acute to obtuse, claw ca 5 mm long, presence of nectary glands not determinable. Stamens 6, length not measured, staminodes absent, anther connective apex not observed. Carpels not observed [dorsally sparsely short-pubescent, scarcely 1.5 mm long, according to Craib, 1922]. Fruit of up to 6 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 6 mm long. Monocarps with colour unknown, immature (size not measured), globose, smooth, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe ca 1.5 mm long. Seeds not observed.

description: Treelet to 2.5 m tall. Twigs glabrous to subglabrous. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic, 8.7–21.5 by 3.5–9 cm, base cuneate to broadly cuneate, symmetrical, apex caudate-acuminate, the acumen usually 15–20 mm long, seldom ± acute, sometimes ± caudate-acute, glabrous on upper surface, glabrous to subglabrous on lower surface, secondary veins 8–10 per side, rather distinct on lower surface, tertiary venation reticulate, seldom reticulate-percurrent. Inflorescences axillary or in axils of fallen leaves, 3–5-flowered, peduncles 3–8 mm long when present, rachis up to 13 mm long, pedicels 10.5–15 mm long, each bearing 1 bract, just above the midpoint. Flowers ± ovoid in bud. Sepals connate at base, broadly ovate-triangular, 1.6–2.1 mm long, apex acute to bluntly acute. Outer petals greenish yellow, chartaceous, broadly ovate, 3–5 by 3–4.5 mm. Inner petals greenish yellow, subcoriaceous, ± elongated rhombic, 11.5–13.5 by 4–5 mm, blades connivent (except tips ± separated) at anthesis, tips (ca 1/3 of blade) yellow, apex obtuse, claw 1.5–2 mm long, nectary glands two in the form of paired slits on the lower half of blade, cream with brown-green edges. Stamens 9, 1–1.5 mm long, staminodes absent, anther connective apex obtuse. Carpels 11 or 14, 1–1.5 mm long, ovaries glabrous, stigmas globose; ovules 2, lateral, uniseriate. Fruit of ca 1 monocarp borne on a pedicel up to ca 17 mm long. Monocarps green (submature), ca 1.4 by 1.4 cm, globose, glabrous, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe ca 3.5 mm long. Seed not observed.

description: Evergreen trees or shrubs, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, often turning black when dried, oblanceolate, oblong-oblanceolate or elliptic, base symmetrical, cuneate, midrib sunken above, secondary veins straight, brochidodromous, tertiary venation percurrent. Inflorescences internodal or rarely terminal, 1–4-flowered, peduncle short with 1–2 persistent triangular bracts; pedicels slender with 1 bract or bract absent. Flowers hermaphroditic, conical in bud. Sepals 3, valvate, connate at base or free, much shorter than inner petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, outer petals sepal-like, much shorter than inner petals, inner petals triangular to triangular-ovate, base broad, saccate. Stamens numerous, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 15–60, stigmas ellipsoid to clavate; ovules 1(–2) per ovary, lateral. Receptacle subglobose, small. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, 1–several, ellipsoid to globose, pubescent, smooth, stipitate; pericarp thin, membranous when dried. Seeds attached laterally, 1(–2) per monocarp, ellipsoid, smooth or wrinkled, glabrous, brown to dark brown, perichalazal ring sunken, aril absent, endosperm ruminations lamellate.</br></br>A tropical Asian genus of about 8 species, with outer petals of the flowers much smaller than the inner; 2 species are known from Thailand.

description: Shrub or tree 4–15 m tall; bark greyish black, moderately smooth. Twigs lenticellate, densely reddish brown-villous when young, later sparsely hairy to subglabrous. Leaves membranous, oblanceolate, oblong-oblanceolate or elliptic, 7–24 by 3–8 cm, base cuneate, apex acuminate or cuspidate, the acumen 8–30 mm long, glabrous to sparsely hairy except with denser hairs on midrib and secondary veins above, pilose below, the hairs densest on midrib and secondary veins, secondary veins 11–15 per side; petioles 5–10 mm long. Inflorescences 1–3-flowered, peduncle 8–20 mm long, bract 1(–2), pedicels 40–60 mm long, each bearing a single bract near midpoint. Sepals brownish green to green, linear-lanceolate to lanceolate, 1.5–4 by 0.5–1.5 mm, acute, hairy on both surfaces. Outer petals brown, linear-lanceolate, 3–7 by 1–2 mm, apex acute, hairy on both surfaces. Inner petals green to yellowish green, ovate, 16–27 by 8–16 mm, with 5–7 prominent veins, apex acute, densely hairy outside, sparsely hairy inside except for glabrous base. Stamens 80–100, wedge-shaped, 1.3–1.8 mm long. Carpels 15–20, ovaries oblongoid, 1.5–2 mm long. Fruit of 3–15 monocarps borne on a pedicel 50–70 mm long. Monocarps ellipsoid-oblongoid or oblongoid, 1.4–1.6 by 0.6–0.8 cm, shiny, smooth, longitudinally grooved on outer surface, sparsely hairy but densest on base and near apex, apex obtuse or with an apiculum up to 0.5 mm long, base contracted into a stipe 14–20 mm long. Seed 1, ellipsoid-oblongoid or oblongoid, 13–15 by 5–8 mm, wrinkled, brown.

description: Tree 8–15 m tall; bark greyish black or blackish brown, moderately smooth. Twigs with dense brown hairs when young, later sparsely hairy to subglabrous, lenticellate. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, oblanceolate, oblong, elliptic, lanceolate or rarely ovate-oblanceolate, 10–24 by 3.5–9 cm, base cuneate, apex acuminate or cuspidate, the acumen 5–25 mm long, glabrous except for short hairs on midrib above, glabrous below except for long appressed hairs on midrib and secondary veins, secondary veins 8–15 per side; petioles 8–15 mm long. Inflorescences 1–3-flowered, peduncle 2–5 mm long, bract 1, pedicels 15–50 mm long, each bearing a single bract near the base. Sepals green to yellowish green, triangular, 0.8–1 by 1–1.5 mm, acute, hairy outside, glabrous inside. Outer petals greenish yellow to yellow, ovate-triangular, 1–1.5 by 1.3–1.5 mm, apex acute, hairy outside, glabrous inside. Inner petals greenish yellow, triangular-ovate, 12–18 by 6–9 mm, apex acute, hairy outside, glabrous except for sparse hairs at apex and on margins inside. Stamens 48–60, wedge-shaped, 1.5–1.8 mm long. Carpels 20–30, ovaries oblongoid, 1.8–2 mm long. Fruit of 1–16 monocarps borne on a pedicel 15–35 mm long. Monocarps black at maturity, ellipsoid-oblongoid or oblongoid, 2–3 by 1–1.3 cm, shiny, smooth, longitudinally grooved on outer surface, sparsely hairy but denser at base and near apex, apex with an apiculum 0.5–1.5 mm long, base contracted into a stipe 15–28 mm long. Seeds 1(–2), ellipsoid-oblongoid or oblongoid, 15–20 by 8–15 mm, wrinkled, brown.

description: Evergreen trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves thinly coriaceous, oblong-lanceolate, base cuneate to rounded, symmetrical, midrib plane or slightly sunken, secondary veins brochidodromous, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary from axils of fallen leaves, few–many-flowered, fasciculate. Flowers hermaphroditic, globose in bud. Sepals 3, valvate, connate into a 3-lobed cup, shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, ovate, outer petals spreading at anthesis, inner petals subequal to or slightly shorter than outer petals, narrowed toward the base but not clawed, cohering into a mitriform cap over the reproductive organs. Stamens 20–35, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex miliusoid, minute and not exceeding the anther thecae. Carpels 1–3, stigmas sessile, capitate, slightly bilobed; ovules 6–10, lateral, biseriate. Receptacle flat or slightly raised, provided with a ring of stiff hairs around the carpels, otherwise glabrous. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, 1–3 per fruit, globose, ovoid, or cylindrical, pubescent to glabrate, finely verrucose, sessile; pericarp up to 5 mm thick, woody when dried. Seeds laterally attached, biseriate.</br></br>A genus of 2 species, one in the Philippines and the other in SE & Peninsular Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, and Java.

description: Tree up to 40 m tall, sometimes with small buttresses. Twigs glabrous. Leaves thinly coriaceous, lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, 5–13 by 1.5–4(–5) cm, base rounded to cuneate, apex acuminate to obtuse, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 8–12 per side; petioles ca 5 mm long. Inflorescences from the axils of fallen leaves, 6–17-flowered, peduncle ca 5 mm long, pedicels 10–12 mm long, bearing 2 bracts, one at the base and the other at the apex just below the sepals. Sepals valvate, connate at base, ovate, 1.5–3 mm long, apex usually acute. Petals pale orange-yellow to cream-coloured; outer petals ovate, ca 5 by 4 mm, sometimes acute at apex, hairy outside; inner petals subequal to outer, but narrowed to ca 2 mm wide at base. Stamens 20–25, broadly clavate. Carpels 2–3, hirsute, stigmas capitate, sometimes slightly bilobed; ovules 6–8. Fruit of 1–3 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 170 mm long and ca 6 mm thick. Monocarps light brown, globose to ovoid, 4–9 by 3–6 cm, pubescent to glabrate, apex rounded, sessile; pericarp ca 5 mm thick. Seeds 6–8, kidney-shaped, 18–26 mm long, 10–18 mm wide, ca 8 mm thick.

description: Evergreen shrubs, treelets or trees, with spiral or distichous primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves chartaceous to thinly coriaceous, oblong, elliptic, lanceolate, oblanceolate or obovate, base asymmetrical and/or cordate, sometimes minutely so, rarely symmetrical, auriculate, rounded, obtuse or cuneate, midrib plane or sunken above, secondary venation simple- or festooned-brochidodromous, or rarely mixed eucamptodromous, slightly conspicuous to conspicuous, tertiary venation reticulate or weakly percurrent. Inflorescences terminal, leaf-opposed, supra-axillary, internodal, or axillary, or on woody tubercles of leafless twigs or trunk, 1‒many-flowered, plants sometimes ramiflorous or cauliflorous; peduncle and rachis absent or rarely present, pedicels with 1(–2) bracts attached between base and midpoint. Flowers hermaphroditic, lanceolate, ovoid, or broadly ovoid in bud. Sepals 3, ovate or lanceolate, valvate or imbricate, base free or connate, shorter than the petals. Petals in two whorls of 3(‒4), separate at base and valvate at apex, erect, incurved, or spreading at anthesis, ovate, lanceolate, oblong-elliptic or linear. Stamens numerous, cuneate to oblong, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate or slightly convex, overhanging the anther thecae. Carpels 1‒40, cylindrical, stigmas globose, subglobose, obovoid, clavate or oblongoid, higher than or equal to anther connective apices; ovules 1‒6, attached laterally, sub-basally, or occasionally basally, uniseriate. Receptacle convex or cushion-shaped, simple, slightly concave or flat at the top, glabrous or hairy. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, globose to oblongoid or ellipsoid, sometimes slightly torulose, surface smooth or slightly puckered and verrucose, glabrous or pubescent, apex rounded, obtuse, apiculate or mucronate, usually stipitate; pericarp thin, membranous when dried or sometimes leathery. Seeds subglobose, plano-convex, subdiscoid or disk-shaped, surface smooth, slightly to deeply wrinkled or pitted, perichalazal ring sunken, aril absent, endosperm ruminations spiniform.</br></br>The genus is distributed throughout tropical Asia to N Australia. Despite the removal of many species to the segregate genera Huberantha, Maasia, Marsypopetalum, and Monoon, about 90 species of shrubs and understorey trees remain; 21 occur in Thailand. The monocarps in the segregate genera have a single basally attached seed; in Polyalthia, the seeds are usually attached laterally, less often basally or sub-basally, and there are often more than one per monocarp.

description: Shrub 1‒5 m tall, with distichous primary branching; bark smooth, blackish brown. Leafy branches densely rusty brown-tomentose, the hairs erect, 2‒4 mm long. Leaves chartaceous, bullate, asymmetrically oblong and slightly falcate, 15‒35 by 3‒8 cm, base asymmetrically cordate, auricles 5‒20 mm long, apex acuminate, acumen 15‒35 mm long, glabrous except for sparse hairs on base of midrib above, glabrescent below; midrib sunken above, secondary veins simple-brochidodromous, curving, 14‒20 per side, tertiary venation weakly percurrent; petioles 3‒5 mm long, densely rusty brown-tomentose below. Inflorescences leaf-opposed or supra-axillary, 1(‒3)-flowered; peduncle and rachis absent, pedicels 8‒20 mm long, 1‒1.2 mm thick, sparsely brown-tomentose, bract attached at pedicel base, deltate, 1‒1.2 by 1‒1.2 mm; buds ovoid. Sepals valvate, chartaceous, ovate, 5‒7 by 2‒4 mm, acute, puberulous outside. Petals erect at anthesis, pale yellow to orangish red, coriaceous, oblong, apex acute; outer petals 35–45 by 5–8 mm; inner petals 30‒40 by 3‒5 mm. Stamens oblong, 1.5‒1.7 by 0.8‒1 mm, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 10‒15, 1.7‒2.3 mm long, ovaries cylindrical, 1–1.2 by 0.4–0.5 mm, pubescent, stigmas clavate, 0.8‒1.2 mm, hairy, higher than anther connective apices; ovules 2, lateral. Receptacle cushion-shaped and flat at the top, 2.5‒3 mm in diam., 1‒1.2 mm thick, glabrous. Fruit of up to 11 red to dark red monocarps borne on a pedicel 20‒30 mm long, 1.2–1.4 mm thick. Monocarps globose to subglobose, 1‒1.3 cm in diam., glabrous, apex rounded, stipe 3‒4 mm long, 1.2–1.4 mm thick. Seeds 2 per monocarp, plano-convex, smooth, pale brown.

description: Shrub 0.2‒0.7 m tall, with spiral primary branching; bark with fine intersecting ridges, blackish brown. Leafy branches rusty brown-pubescent, lenticels slightly conspicuous. Leaves chartaceous, symmetrical, narrowly to broadly elliptic or obovate, 10‒15 by 3.5‒7 cm, base broadly to narrowly symmetrically or asymmetrically cordate, apex obtuse, acute or acuminate, the acumen 5‒10 mm long, glabrous above, sparsely puberulous below; midrib sunken above, secondary veins festooned-brochidodromous, curving, 10‒12 per side, tertiary venation reticulate; petioles 3‒5 mm long, pubescent. Inflorescences internodal, 1(‒2)-flowered; peduncle and rachis absent, pedicels 2‒5 mm long, 0.8‒1 mm thick, brown-pubescent, bract attached at pedicel midpoint, lanceolate, 1.2‒1.5 by 1‒1.2 mm; buds ovoid. Sepals valvate, thinly coriaceous, ovate, 3‒4 by 4‒5 mm long, acute, pubescent outside. Outer petals erect, green to pale yellowish green, coriaceous, ovate, 6‒8 by 4‒5 mm, apex acute; inner petals slightly incurved, yellowish green to yellow, fleshy, obovate, 10‒15 by 8‒10 mm, apex obtuse to acute. Carpels 1‒2, 2.5‒3 mm long, ovaries cylindrical, 2.5‒3 by 0.8‒1 mm, pubescent, stigmas globose, 1‒1.5 mm in diam., pubescent, higher than anther connective apices; ovules 4‒5, lateral. description: Treelet 1‒3 m tall, with spiral primary branching; bark smooth, blackish grey. Leafy branches rusty brown-tomentose, lenticels inconspicuous. Leaves thinly coriaceous, symmetrically elliptic, 13‒22 by 3‒5.5 cm, base asymmetrically cordate, obtuse or oblique, apex acute, glabrous above, puberulous below; midrib plane above, secondary veins mixed eucamptodromous or festooned-brochidodromous, curving, 14‒16 per side, tertiary venation weakly percurrent; petioles 4‒5 mm long, tomentose. Sepals valvate at base and separate at apex, chartaceous, ovate, 3‒4 by 3‒3.5 mm long, acute, sparsely puberulous outside. Petals erect to slightly spreading, pale yellow, thinly coriaceous, lanceolate, apex acute, puberulous outside, glabrous inside; outer petals 14‒17 by 3.5‒5 mm; inner petals 15‒24 by 2.5‒3 mm. Stamens cuneate, 1.6‒1.8 by 0.8‒1 mm, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 20‒25, 1.8‒2 mm long, ovaries cylindrical, 1.4‒1.6 by 0.2‒0.3 mm, pubescent, stigmas oblongoid, 0.4‒0.6 mm long, pubescent, higher than anther connective apices; ovules 2, lateral. Receptacle cushion-shaped, 2.8‒3 mm in diam., 0.8‒1 mm thick, glabrous. Fruit and seed unknown.

description: Tree 2–8 m tall, with spiral primary branching; bark grey. Leafy branches brown-pubescent, lenticels inconspicuous. Leaves chartaceous, symmetrically oblanceolate, 9‒15 by 2.5‒5 cm, base asymmetrically cordate, apex acute to acuminate, acumen 1‒18 mm long, glabrous above, glabrescent below, midrib slightly sunken above, secondary veins festooned-brochidodromous, curving, 10‒14 per side, tertiary venation reticulate; petioles 2‒3 mm long, pubescent. Inflorescences densely fascicled on woody tubercles of leafless twigs and trunk, fascicles up to at least 10-flowered, peduncle rudimentary, rachis absent, pedicels 3‒5(‒7) mm long, 0.8‒1 mm thick, sparsely pubescent, bract attached at pedicel base, narrowly acute, 3‒5 by ca 1 mm; buds lanceolate. Sepals connate at base and erect or slightly spreading at apex, chartaceous, narrowly lanceolate, 6‒12(‒15) by 2‒3.5 mm, acute, tomentose outside. Petals erect or slightly spreading, pink or pale red to dark red, chartaceous, linear with broad base, outer petals slightly larger than inner petals, 50‒100 by 2‒4.5 mm, apex acute. Stamens cuneate, 1‒1.2 by 0.8‒1 mm, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 4‒8, 1.6‒1.8 mm long, ovaries ellipsoid, 1.2‒1.4 by 0.3‒0.4 mm, pubescent, stigmas subglobose, 0.4‒0.6 mm in diam., sparsely puberulous, higher than anther connective apices; ovules 4‒5, lateral. Receptacle cushion-shaped, 2.5‒3 mm in diam., ca 0.5 mm thick, glabrous. Fruit of 2‒5 monocarps borne on a pedicel 2‒6 mm long, 2–4 mm thick. Seeds 1‒5 per monocarp, subdiscoid, 12‒15 mm in diam., 6‒8 mm thick, slightly wrinkled, brown, encircled by a wide deep groove.

description: Shrub 1‒6 m tall, with spiral and densely crowded primary branching; bark lenticellate to corky or shallowly fissured, brown to dark brown. Leafy branches dark brown-puberulous, lenticels conspicuous, leafless branches thinly to thickly corky. Leaves chartaceous, symmetrically oblong to elliptic or oblanceolate, 7‒10 by 2.5‒4.6 cm, base asymmetrically cordate or acute, apex retuse to obtuse or acute, glabrous above, puberulous below; midrib slightly sunken above, secondary veins simple-brochidodromous, curving, 8‒10 per side, tertiary venation reticulate; petioles 2‒4 mm long, glabrous. Inflorescences leaf-opposed to supra-axillary, 1(‒3)-flowered, peduncle and rachis absent, pedicels 20‒35 mm long, 0.5‒0.7 mm thick, puberulous, bract attached at or near pedicel base, linear, 1‒1.5 by ca 0.5 mm; buds ovoid. Sepals separate, chartaceous, ovate, 2‒2.5 by 2.5‒3 mm, acute, puberulous outside. Petals erect or with apex recurved, apex acute; outer petals pale yellowish green to yellow, sometimes dark purple at base, thinly coriaceous, ovate, 6‒8 by 2.5‒3.5 mm; inner petals yellow, sometimes dark purple at base, fleshy, oblanceolate to oblong, 8‒10 by 3‒5 mm. Stamens cuneate, 1.5‒1.8 by 0.8‒1 mm, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 25‒40, 1.5‒2 mm long, ovaries cylindrical, 1‒1.3 by 0.2‒0.3 mm, pubescent, stigmas subglobose or obovoid, 0.4‒0.7 mm long, pubescent, higher than anther connective apices; ovule 1, basal. description: Tree up to 12 m tall, with spiral primary branching; bark smooth, greyish black or greyish brown. Leafy branches glabrous, lenticels conspicuous. Leaves chartaceous, symmetrically or asymmetrically elliptic to slightly oblanceolate, curved inward, 13‒20 by 3.5‒7.5 cm, base asymmetrically cordate, auricles 0.8‒1.2 mm long, apex acuminate, acumen 10‒15 mm long, glabrous above, glabrescent below except for sparsely puberulous midrib; midrib sunken above, secondary veins simple-brochidodromous, curving, 14‒16 per side, tertiary venation reticulate; petioles 1.5‒3 mm long, puberulous. Inflorescences supra-axillary or leaf-opposed, 1‒2-flowered, peduncle and rachis absent, pedicels 7‒10 mm long, 0.8–1 mm thick, puberulous, bract 1, attached from base to apex of pedicel, triangular or lanceolate, 3‒4 by 1.2‒1.5 mm, apex acute, puberulous outside and glabrous inside; buds globose, petals separating early in development. Sepals valvate, thinly coriaceous, ovate, 4‒5 by 3‒4 mm, apex acute to slightly acuminate. Petals erect or slightly spreading, greenish yellow, coriaceous, apex acute, pubescent outside, glabrous inside; outer petals oblong or ovate, 7–8 by 4–5 mm, with a raised rugose border along margin inside; inner petals elliptic, 8‒9 by 3‒4 mm, base incurved, apex erect. Stamens cuneate, 1‒1.2 by 0.8‒1 mm, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 5‒7, 1.5‒1.8 mm long, ovaries cylindrical, 1‒1.2 by ca 0.5 mm, pubescent, stigmas obovoid, 0.5‒0.6 mm, pubescent, higher than anther connective apices; ovules 2, lateral. Receptacle convex, flat on the top, 3‒3.5 mm in diam., 1‒1.2 mm thick, glabrous. Fruit of up to 12 monocarps borne on a pedicel 15‒17 mm long, 1.7‒1.8 mm thick. Monocarps green, subglobose, 1.2‒1.6 by 1.4‒1.6 cm, slightly puckered and verrucose, glabrous, base rounded, apex rounded with apiculum < 1 mm long, stipe 13‒15 mm long, ca 1.5 mm thick, sparsely pubescent. Seeds 1‒2 per monocarp, discoid, 8‒12 mm in diam., densely wrinkled, light brown, slightly shiny.

description: Evergreen small trees or shrubs with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic, oblong, or obovate, base broadly cuneate to rounded and asymmetrical, midrib plane or sunken, secondary veins arcuate, tertiary venation usually percurrent. Inflorescences leaf-opposed, 2–7-flowered, pedicels arising from a short perennial axis. Flowers hermaphroditic, globose to ovoid in bud. Sepals 3, valvate, free, shorter than the petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free or connate in a ring at base, ovate, the inner petals slightly longer than the outer, cucullate and forming a tooth at the apex. Stamens ca 20, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 6–7, stigmas clavate; ovules basal to lateral, uniseriate, 2–4 per ovary [ex Ganesan]. Receptacle flat, 1.3–1.5 mm in diam., often bristly-pubescent. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, globose, smooth or slightly wrinkled, sessile or stipitate; pericarp thin, membranous when dried, often tightly adherent to the seed. Seeds attached laterally, up to 4 per monocarp, globose to ellipsoid, somewhat flattened, pitted, wrinkled, or tuberculate, glabrous, light brown, perichalazal ring raised, aril absent, endosperm ruminations spiniform.</br></br>About 26 tropical Asian species; with petals often 2–3 mm long, the flowers are among the smallest in the Annonaceae; 2 species are reported for Thailand.

description: Shrub or treelet to 4 m tall. Twigs densely erect rusty-pubescent, persistent but eventually glabrate. Leaves chartaceous, often with a granular surface, elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 9.4–16.7 by 4–6.4 cm, base broadly cuneate to obliquely rounded, apex obtuse to acute or acuminate, the acumen 5–32 mm long, glabrous except for the pubescent midrib above, pubescent, densest along midrib, below, secondary veins 7–13 per side, tertiary venation percurrent; petioles 3–5 mm long. Inflorescences leaf-opposed, 2–7-flowered, perennial axis ca 1.5 mm long, pedicels 2–3.8 mm long, bearing a bract ca 1.2 mm long; buds globose. Sepals broadly triangular, coriaceous, 1.5–2.5 mm long, acute to obtuse, pubescent. Petals connate at base, white to yellowish, coriaceous; outer petals ovate, ca 2 mm long, broadly acute; inner petals broadly ovate, 2–3 mm long, obtuse, apex incurved. Stamens cuneate, 0.6–0.8 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 5–7, ovaries ca 0.8 mm long, pubescent, stigmas clavate, 0.4 mm long, puberulent at apex. Fruit of up to 3 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 6 mm long. Monocarps globose to ellipsoid, 1.1–1.2 by 0.8–1.1 cm, smooth or slightly wrinkled, pubescent, apex rounded, stipe 3–6 mm long, 1.3–1.8 mm thick; pericarp thin, tightly adherent to the seed. Seed 1, globose, ca 6 by 5 mm, rugose to bumpy, light brown.

description: Shrub or tree to 10 m tall. Twigs brownish yellow-strigose, eventually glabrate. Leaves chartaceous, often with a granular surface, elliptic to obovate, 4.9–17.6 (–20) by 2.1–6.6 cm, base broadly cuneate to rounded and asymmetrical, apex acuminate, the acumen 9–23 mm long, glabrous except for the strigose midrib above, strigose along midrib and secondary veins below, secondary veins 7–9 per side, tertiary venation percurrent; petioles 1.5–4 mm long. Inflorescences terminal or leaf-opposed, 2–3-flowered, perennial base short, pedicels 2–7 mm long, each bearing a bract ca 1.5 mm long; buds globose. Sepals triangular to ovate, coriaceous, 1.5–2.5 mm long, acute, pubescent. Petals free, green-yellow, cream-coloured, or pale orange, ovate; outer petals ca 2 mm long, acute; inner petals 2–3 mm long, obtuse, apex incurved. Stamens numerous, cuneate, ca 1 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Ovaries ca 0.5 mm long, pubescent. Fruit of up to 6 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 4.5 mm long. Monocarps orange to red, globose, 0.7–0.9 by 0.7–0.8 cm, smooth or slightly wrinkled, glabrate or with a few hairs, apex obtuse, sessile or stipe 0.5–0.8 mm long; pericarp ca 0.1 mm thick. Seed 1, broadly ellipsoid to globose, 7–8 by ca 6 mm, dull tan, pitted.

description: Evergreen trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves papyraceous to coriaceous, elliptic, ovate or obovate (occasionally linear or needle-shaped), base symmetrical, midrib raised, secondary venation brochidodromous, tertiary venation percurrent. Inflorescences axillary, solitary to clustered (up to 30), each with up to ca 18 flowers, sometimes plants ramiflorous or cauliflorous. Flowers staminate, pistillate, or hermaphroditic; buds globose. Sepals 3, valvate, free or ± basally connate, shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, outer petals generally shorter than inner petals, generally not clawed, inner petals basally clawed, apically connivent over reproductive organs, forming a mitriform dome with 3 lateral apertures (rarely with additional apical aperture), with 1–2 adaxial glands (sometimes absent). Stamens 1–45(–90) in bisexual flowers, 18–153 in staminate flowers, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex generally truncate. Carpels 1–30 in hermaphroditic flowers, 1–9 in pistillate flowers, stigmas variable in shape; ovules 1–20, lateral, uniseriate or biseriate. Receptacle shallowly conical, ± flat or narrowly cylindrical (staminate flowers) and depressed-ovoid or ± flat (pistillate flowers). Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, globose or ellipsoid, rarely (ob-)ovoid, glabrous to densely pubescent, smooth or rarely warty, sometimes with a longitudinal ridge, sessile or stipitate; pericarp mostly < 2 mm thick, rarely up to 4 mm thick. Seeds attached laterally in 1–2 rows, 1–20 per monocarp, smooth to rugose, hairy or glabrous, colour variable, perichalazal ring sunken, aril absent, endosperm ruminations spiniform (rarely peg-shaped).</br></br>About 60 species, throughout tropical and subtropical SE Asia to N Australia; 12 occur in Thailand. The connivent inner petals are similar to those of Orophea, but the truncate anther connectives distinguish Pseuduvaria.

description: Tree to 4 m tall. Young branches subglabrous. Leaves papyraceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic, 8.5–15.5 by 2.5–6 cm, base acute to obtuse, apex acuminate, glabrous on both surfaces, margins not ciliate, secondary veins 8–14 pairs; petioles 4–7 mm long, subglabrous. Inflorescences on branches, of up to 7 flowers, peduncles 3.5–8 mm long, pedicels 3–10 mm long, sparsely hairy. Flowers staminate or pistillate on the same or different plants. Sepals broadly ovate, 1–1.3 by 1–1.5 mm. Outer petals cream, broadly ovate, 3–4 by ca 3 mm. Inner petals cream with purple tinge adaxially, clawed-rhombic, 4.5–5.5 by 3–3.5 mm, ca 0.8 mm thick, base of blade acute, very densely hairy adaxially, claw 1.5–2.5 mm long; glands 2, ± round, raised. Staminate flowers with ca 24 stamens. Pistillate flowers with 1–3 carpels; carpels ca 2.5 mm long; ovules ca 5. Fruit of 1–3 monocarps, peduncle ca 13 mm long, pedicel ca 12 mm long. Monocarps with colour unknown, ellipsoid, ca 2.5 by ca 0.8 cm (immature), smooth, densely hairy, apex tapering but without apiculum, sessile. Seeds not seen.

description: Tree to 2 m tall. Young branches subglabrous. description: Tree to 4 m tall. Young branches glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic, 15–21 by 4.5–7 cm, base acute to obtuse, apex acuminate, glabrous on both surfaces, margins not ciliate, secondary veins 10–14 pairs; petioles 5–9 mm long, glabrous. description: Tree to 7 m tall. Young branches hairy. Leaves with texture unknown, elliptic, 8.5–19.5 by 3.5–7 cm, base broadly cuneate, cuneate or obtuse, apex acute to acute-acuminate, glabrous on both surfaces, margins not ciliate, secondary veins 9–15 pairs; petioles 3–5 mm long, hairy. description: Tree to 14 m tall. Young branches densely hairy. Leaves papyraceous to coriaceous, obovate to elliptic, 12–29.5 by 4–11 cm, base cuneate (or acute) to obtuse (or truncate), apex acute (or obtuse) to acuminate, glabrous on both surfaces, margins not ciliate, secondary veins 12–22 pairs; petioles 2–12 mm long, densely hairy. Inflorescences on branches, 1(–3)-flowered, peduncles inconspicuous, pedicels 3–18 mm long, very densely hairy. Flowers staminate or hermaphroditic on same or different plants. Staminate flowers with 55–65(–90) stamens. Hermaphroditic flowers with 3–9 stamens, 11–17 carpels; carpels 1.2–2.1 mm long; ovules 2–5. description: Tree to 9 m tall. Young branches densely hairy. description: Tree to 6 m tall. Young branches subglabrous. Leaves papyraceous to subcoriaceous, (ovate- or obovate-) elliptic, 11–17.5 by 3.5–7 cm, base acute to obtuse, apex acute to acuminate, glabrous on both surfaces, margins not ciliate, secondary veins 10–12 pairs; petioles 4–8 mm long, subglabrous. description: Tree to 6 m tall. Young branches densely hairy, becoming glabrous. Leaves papyraceous to subcoriaceous, (obovate-) elliptic, 12–19 by 5–8 cm, base obtuse, apex acuminate, glabrous to sparsely hairy on both surfaces, margins not ciliate, secondary veins 9–14 pairs; petioles 3–6 mm long, (very) densely hairy. description: Tree to 25 m tall. Young branches densely hairy. Leaves (sub)coriaceous, elliptic to obovate, (10–)14–27(–31) by 3–9(–12) cm, base acute to broadly cuneate or obtuse, apex acuminate, glabrous on both surfaces, margins not ciliate, secondary veins 10–22 pairs; petioles 3–12 mm long, sparsely to very densely hairy. Inflorescences on branches, 5–20-flowered, peduncles inconspicuous, pedicels (7–)12–50 mm long, densely hairy. Flowers staminate or hermaphroditic on same or different plants. Sepals triangular, 1–2 by 1–2.5 mm. Outer petals (orange-) yellow, (ovate-) elliptic, 1.5–4 by 1.5–3.5 mm. Inner petals (orange-) yellow, clawed-cordate, 5–10 by 3–5.5 mm, 0.2–0.5 mm thick, base of blade cordate to subtruncate, glabrous to densely hairy adaxially, claw 2–7 mm long; gland m-shaped, ± flat. Staminate flowers with 31–55(–62) stamens. Hermaphroditic flowers with up to 4 stamens, 4–8 carpels; carpels 1.5–3 mm long; ovules 1–8(–14). Fruit of 1–7 monocarps, peduncle inconspicuous, pedicel (12–)20–45 mm long. Monocarps dull yellow-green to brown, globose (sometimes ellipsoid), 1–2.8 by 0.8–2.3 cm, smooth, densely hairy, apiculum 0.1–0.5 mm long, stipe 3–15 mm long. Seeds 6–7, 10.5–15 by 5.5–8.5 mm.

description: Tree to 40 m tall. Young branches densely hairy. Leaves papyraceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic to obovate, 10–23 by 3–8.5 cm, base acute to broadly cuneate or obtuse, apex acute to acuminate, glabrous on both surfaces, margins not ciliate, secondary veins 10–18 pairs; petioles 4–12 mm long, sparsely to densely hairy. Inflorescences on branches or trunk, 3–8-flowered, peduncles 1.5–4 mm long, pedicels 7–24 mm long, very densely hairy. Flowers staminate or hermaphroditic on same or different plants. Sepals triangular, 0.9–1.5 by 0.8–1.5 mm. Outer petals yellow-green or orange, ovate (rarely elliptic), 1–2.5 by 1–2.5 mm. Inner petals light yellow-green, clawed-rhombic, 4–10 by 2–4 mm, 0.3–0.5 mm thick, base of blade acute, very densely hairy adaxially, claw 3–7.5 mm long; glands absent. Staminate flowers with 30–68 stamens. Hermaphroditic flowers with 4–6 stamens, 5–13 carpels; carpels 1–1.5 mm long; ovules 2–6. Fruit of 1–9 monocarps, peduncle 3–5 mm long, pedicel 12–27 mm long. Monocarps dull yellow-green to brown, globose, 1–2 by 1–2 cm, rugulose to rugose, densely hairy, without apiculum, stipe 6–18 mm long. Seeds 2–6, 10–14 by 5–7.5 mm.

description: Tree to 7 m tall. Young branches very densely hairy. Leaves papyraceous to subcoriaceous, (obovate-) elliptic (rarely ovate), 7.5–26 by 2.5–9.5 cm, base rounded to cordate, apex acute to acuminate, sparsely to densely hairy on both surfaces, margins ciliate, secondary veins 10–18 pairs; petioles absent or up to 5 mm long, very densely hairy. Inflorescences on branches, 1–2-flowered, peduncles 1–3 mm long, pedicels 8–24 mm long, very densely hairy. Flowers staminate or hermaphroditic on same or different plants. Sepals triangular, 0.8–2 by 1–2 mm. Outer petals cream or pale yellow, ovate to elliptic, 2–4 by 2–4 mm. Inner petals red at base of blade and on claw but cream at apex of blade, or pale yellow, clawed-cordate, 5.5–9 by 3.5–6.5 mm, 0.5–1 mm thick, base of blade slightly cordate, densely hairy adaxially, claw 2.5–4 mm long; glands 1–2, mushroom-shaped, raised. Staminate flowers with 60–76 stamens. Hermaphroditic flowers with 0–1(–10) stamens, 3–4(–8) carpels; carpels 1.3–2.4 mm long; ovules 2–8. Fruit of 1–2(–7) monocarps, peduncle ca 4 mm long, pedicel 10–30 mm long. Monocarps yellow-green, globose, 0.6–2.5 by 0.6–2 cm, smooth, very densely hairy, without apiculum, stipe ± absent to 1–4(–8) mm long. Seeds (1–)2–8, 10–13 by 4.5–10.5 mm.

description: Tree to 20 m tall. Young branches densely hairy. Leaves subcoriaceous, (obovate-) elliptic, 15–18.5(–25) by 4–8.5 cm, base broadly cuneate to obtuse, apex acuminate, sparsely hairy above, glabrous below, margins not ciliate, secondary veins 14–18 pairs; petioles 4–11 mm long, very densely hairy. Inflorescences on branches or trunk, 3–6-flowered, peduncles inconspicuous, pedicels 10–30 mm long, very densely hairy. Flowers staminate or hermaphroditic on same plant. Sepals ovate, 1–1.5 by 2–2.5 mm. Outer petals yellow or light green, ovate, 2–3 by 1.5–3 mm. Inner petals yellow or light green, clawed-triangular, 5–8 by 3–5.5 mm, ca 0.5 mm thick, base of blade ± truncate, sparsely hairy adaxially, claw 2.5–5 mm long; glands absent. Staminate flowers with 46–56 stamens. Hermaphroditic flowers with 7–9 stamens, 7–14 carpels; carpels 1.5–2 mm long; ovules 5–6. Fruit of 7–8 monocarps, peduncle inconspicuous, pedicel 20–30 mm long. Monocarps with colour unknown, globose, 1.6–2.2 by 1.6–2.1 cm, rugose, densely hairy, without apiculum, stipe 10–14 mm long. Seeds ca 6, 12.5–17 by 7.5–9.5 mm.

description: Evergreen woody climber with lateral branches wrapping around adjacent supports, with distichous primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves subcoriaceous, base rounded, truncate, or cordate, symmetrical, midrib slightly sunken, secondary veins indistinct, brochidodromous, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary, 1–3-flowered. Flowers hermaphroditic, conical and somewhat three-angled in bud. Sepals 3, valvate, connate to form a flat circular to triangular disc, much smaller than outer petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, fleshy; outer petals linear to lanceolate; inner petals forming a dome over the centre of the flower, much shorter than outer petals. Stamens numerous, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate to capitate. Carpels 5–13, stigmas capitate, multi-lobed; ovules ca 20, lateral, biseriate. Receptacle convex, slightly elevated. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, oblongoid, ellipsoid, or cylindrical, pubescent to glabrate, smooth or verrucose, sometimes tuberculate, short-stipitate; pericarp thick, leathery when dried. Seeds attached laterally in 2 rows, up to 20 per monocarp, flattened-ellipsoid or ellipsoid-oblongoid, smooth, shiny, dark brown, perichalazal ring not evident, arillate ring encircling the micropyle, endosperm ruminations spiniform or flattened pegs.</br></br>A monotypic genus distributed from the Malay Peninsula to Sumatra and Borneo. Pyramidanthe may be confused with Fissistigma, but the axillary inflorescence and small inner petals forming a dome distinguish it.

description: Woody climber. Twigs sparsely and finely pubescent, eventually glabrate. Leaves subcoriaceous to coriaceous, oblong, oblanceolate, ovate or ovate-oblong, (4–)10–19 by (2–)4.5–7.5 cm, base rounded, sometimes nearly truncate or cordate, apex acute to acuminate, the acumen 6–13 mm long, or sometimes retuse, glabrous above, finely pubescent to glabrate below, secondary veins 10–20 per side; petioles 7–18 mm long. Inflorescences 1–3-flowered, peduncle ca 2.5 mm long or absent, pedicels 4–11 mm long, each bearing 1–3 bracts up to 2.5 mm long. Sepals crescent-shaped, coriaceous, 1.5–3.5 mm long, acute to rounded, pubescent outside. Petals fleshy, yellow to yellow-orange; outer petals linear to lanceolate, 31–40 by 5–12 mm, acute, pubescent; inner petals ovate or triangular-ovate, 7.5–10 by 3–5 mm, acute to acuminate, glabrous. Stamens oblong, 1–2.5 mm long. Ovaries oblongoid, ca 3 mm long, tomentose or glabrous. Receptacle 2.2 mm high, 5.3 mm in diam. Fruit of up to 9 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 15 mm long. Monocarps green, oblongoid, ellipsoid or cylindrical, 1.7–4 by 1–2.6 cm, verrucose, sparsely hairy to glabrous, apex rounded or obtuse, occasionally with a broad beak 2 mm long, contracted into a stipe 5–22 mm long, 2.5–4.5 mm thick; pericarp ca 1 mm thick. Seeds in two rows, up to 20 per monocarp, flattened-ellipsoid or ellipsoid-oblongoid, 6–12.5 by 4–7 mm, dark brown.

description: Evergreen trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves (sub)coriaceous, base cuneate or obtuse-rounded, sometimes slightly subcordate, rarely obtuse or broadly cuneate, symmetrical or sometimes slightly asymmetrical, midrib sunken, secondary venation inconspicuous, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary or from axils of fallen leaves, 1–many-flowered, plants sometimes cauliflorous (in Sageraea elliptica). Flowers hermaphroditic or unisexual (staminate and pistillate separate on the same individual), ovoid to very broadly ovoid, subglobose, or transversely ellipsoid in bud, petals separating at a late developmental stage. Sepals 3, slightly imbricate in bud, free or connate, shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, imbricate, free, outer petals ovate, elliptic, oblong, or obovate, inner petals orbicular, elliptic, obovate or ovate, slightly smaller than the outer petals. Stamens 7–21, ± wedge-shaped, thickened and somewhat fleshy, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels one to several, ovaries glabrous, stigmas capitate to cylindrical, sometimes lobed (more or less horseshoe-shaped); ovules 5–12 per ovary, lateral, biseriate. Receptacle flat to hemispheric-obconical. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, subglobose, ellipsoid or obovoid-oblongoid, glabrous, smooth or finely verruculose, usually wrinkled when dried, apex rounded, sessile or short-stipitate; pericarp rather thick, hard when dried. Seeds attached laterally in 2 rows, up to 12 per monocarp, more or less flattened-ellipsoid, smooth, glabrous, more or less brown when dried, perichalazal ring flat, aril absent, endosperm ruminations lamellate.</br></br>A tropical Asian genus of about 9 species; 3 known from Thailand.

description: Tree to 17 m tall. Twigs glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, oblong to elliptic, 16.5–31 by 4.2–9.4 cm, base cuneate, rarely obtuse, apex acute, sometimes acute-acuminate, rarely obtuse, glabrous on both sides, secondary veins 11–14 per side, rather indistinct below. Inflorescences axillary or from axils of fallen leaves, 3–15-flowered, peduncle inconspicuous, pedicels 15–25 mm long, each bearing 2 bracts, one at the base, another near the midpoint. Flowers unisexual, staminate and pistillate flowers on the same individual. Sepals free, sometimes slightly basally connate, broadly ovate, 2.5–4 by 4–5.5 mm, apex rounded. Petals orange-red; outer petals ovate, rarely obovate, 10.5–11 by 9–9.5 mm, apex rounded; inner petals broadly obovate, sometimes broadly elliptic, 8–9.5 by 6–6.5 mm, apex rounded to obtuse-rounded. Stamens 16–21, 2–3.5 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels ca 15, stigmas horseshoe-shaped; ovules 8–9. Receptacle nearly flat. Fruit unknown.
