description: Tree to 20 m tall. Twigs glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic to oblong, 23.5–34.7 by 7.5–9.5 cm, base obtuse-rounded, sometimes slightly subcordate, sometimes slightly asymmetrical, apex acute, glabrous on both sides, secondary veins 10–12 per side, rather indistinct below. Inflorescences axillary, from axils of fallen leaves, 2–6-flowered, plants sometimes cauliflorous, peduncle inconspicuous, pedicels 4–5 mm long, each bearing 4–6 bracts at the base. Flowers unisexual, staminate and pistillate flowers on the same individual. Sepals 1/2-connate, triangular, 2–3 mm long, apex bluntly acute. Petals pale yellow to pink; outer petals ovate-elliptic, ca 7 by 5 mm, apex bluntly acute to slightly obtuse; inner petals elliptic, 5–5.6 by ca 4 mm, apex obtuse to rounded. Stamens 9–12, 2–2.5 mm long. Carpels ca 9, stigmas horseshoe-shaped; ovules 5–10. Receptacle hemispheric-obconical. Fruit of up to 6 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 8 mm long. Monocarps yellowish green, subglobose to ellipsoid, 15–70 by 13–35 mm, smooth to weakly irregularly ridged, wrinkled when dried, (sub)sessile. Seeds up to 10 per monocarp, more or less ellipsoid, inner seeds more flattened, ca 12 by 8 mm.

description: Tree to 10 m. Twigs glabrous. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic-oblong, 9.5–19 by 3.5–5.4 cm, base cuneate, sometimes slightly asymmetrical, apex acute(-acuminate) to obtuse, glabrous on both sides, secondary veins 13–17 per side. Inflorescences from axils of fallen leaves, few-flowered, peduncle inconspicuous, pedicels 6–10 mm long, each bearing ca 4 bracts at base. Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals free, very broadly ovate, ca 2 mm long, apex rounded. Petals white; outer petals broadly ovate, 7–8.5 by 5–6 mm, apex obtuse-rounded; inner petals ovate to obovate, 5.5–7 by 3–4 mm, apex rounded. Stamens ca 18, 1.8–2 mm long. Carpels ca 2, stigmas unknown; ovules ca 12. Receptacle slightly elevated. Fruit of 1 monocarp borne on a pedicel up to 12 mm long. Monocarp colour unknown, obovoid-oblongoid, ca 27 by 12 mm, finely verruculose, base contracted into a stipe ca 3 mm long. Seeds up to 12 per monocarp, size not measured, surface not observed.

description: Evergreen woody climbers or small trees, with distichous primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic to oblong or lanceolate, rarely oblanceolate, base symmetrical, cuneate to rounded, midrib plane or slightly sunken above, secondary veins brochidodromous, tertiary venation loosely reticulate. Inflorescences axillary or occasionally pseudoterminal, 1-flowered. Flowers hermaphroditic, globose to depressed-globose in bud. Sepals 3, valvate, free or slightly connate, much shorter than petals, persistent in fruit. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, ovate to broadly ovate, outer petals spreading, inner petals incurved over centre of flower and triquetrous at apex. Stamens numerous, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate or convex. Carpels numerous, ovaries oblong, stigmas narrowly oblong; ovules 1(–2) per ovary, sub-basal or lateral in a single row. Receptacle elevated, truncate beneath carpels. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, ovoid, ellipsoid, or oblongoid, glabrous or pubescent, smooth or verrucose, stipitate; pericarp thin, membranous when dried. Seeds attached sub-basally or laterally, 1–2 per monocarp, ellipsoid, smooth, glabrous, shiny or dull, light brown, perichalazal ring plane to slightly raised, aril absent, endosperm ruminations lamellate.</br></br>A Palaeotropical genus of 8 or more species, in Africa, Madagascar, and SE Asia; 3 species are known from Thailand, including the familiar lam duan tree.

description: Woody climber. Twigs flexuous, glabrous. Leaves chartaceous, occasionally subcoriaceous, glaucous below, lanceolate or sometimes elliptic, 8.4–13.8 by 2.8–5.1 cm, base broadly cuneate, apex acuminate, the acumen 9–18 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 10–16 per side; petioles 2.5–4.5 mm long. Inflorescences axillary or pseudoterminal, 1-flowered, pedicels 13.8–34 mm long, bearing 1 bract ca 0.5 mm long. Sepals broadly triangular or crescent-shaped, 2–2.7 mm long, acute, glabrate. Petals rich yellow, fleshy; outer petals ovate, 8–12.5 by 6.7–7.5 mm, obtuse; inner petals ovate, ca 6 mm long, concave, broadly acute. Stamens 1.5–2 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels many, tightly packed, oblong, ovaries glabrous [ex Sinclair]. Receptacle ca 1 mm high, 1.2 mm in diam. Fruit of up to 24 monocarps borne on a pedicel 21–42 mm long. Monocarps ellipsoid, 0.8–0.9 by 0.6–0.8 cm, puberulent to glabrate, apex rounded and sometimes with a tiny apiculum, stipe 21.5–27 by 0.5–0.8 mm; pericarp ca 0.2 mm thick. Seed 1, attached sub-basally, broadly ellipsoid, 8–8.3 by 5.9–7 mm, pale yellow-brown.

description: Woody climber to 20 m high. Twigs flexuous, sparsely pubescent, soon glabrate. Leaves subcoriaceous, occasionally chartaceous, concolourous, elliptic to oblong, rarely lanceolate-oblong or oblanceolate, (11.2–)14.5–17.3 by 3.9–7.8 cm, base broadly cuneate to rounded, apex acute, obtuse, or short-acuminate, the acumen 4–6 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 11–17 per side; petioles 3–10 mm long. Inflorescences axillary or pseudoterminal, 1-flowered, pedicels 27–35 mm long, with an ovate bract 1 mm long below midpoint. Sepals connate at base, broadly ovate, 4–4.5 mm long, apex acute. Petals creamy yellow to yellow-brown, fleshy; outer petals ovate, 9–14 by 9–10 mm, apex acute, pubescent except for glabrous inner base; inner petals ovate, 6–6.5 by ca 7 mm, concave, keeled on outer surface, apex acute, inner surface glabrous, outer pubescent. Stamens oblong to slightly clavate, 1.3–1.5 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels numerous, stigmas linear, ca 1 mm long. Receptacle forming a flat dome 2 mm high. Fruit of up to 18 monocarps borne on a pedicel 21–34 mm long. Monocarps reddish purple, ellipsoid (1-seeded) to oblongoid (2-seeded), 0.8–1.5 (2-seeded 2.2–2.3) by 0.7–1.2 cm, glabrate and somewhat pruinose, apex rounded and sometimes apiculate, stipe (9–)15–25 by 0.5–1.5 mm; pericarp ca 0.7 mm thick. Seeds attached laterally, 1–2 per fruit, oblong-ellipsoid, 11.5–13 by 8–8.5 mm, smooth, light brown.

description: Shrub or small tree up to 8 m tall. Twigs glabrous. Leaves subcoriaceous to chartaceous, concolourous or slightly paler below, elliptic to oblong, rarely lanceolate, 7.9–12.4 by 2.9–3.4(–4.3) cm, base cuneate to broadly cuneate, apex acute, obtuse, or short-acuminate, the acumen 3–12 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 10–14 per side; petioles 4–8 mm long. Inflorescences axillary or pseudoterminal, 1-flowered, pedicels 13–35 mm long, bearing 1 bract ca 1 mm long, often bent near the point of bract attachment. Sepals connate at base, semicircular, 3–4.5 mm long, acute, glabrate. Petals cream-coloured, yellow, or yellow-brown, fleshy; outer petals ovate, 7–15 by 9–10 mm, broadly acute; inner petals ovate, 6.5–11 by 7–9 mm, concave, broadly acute. Stamens clavate, 1.7–2.1 mm long, anther connective apex truncate to convex. Carpels 25–30, ovaries tomentose [ex Sinclair]. Receptacle disk-like, 1.5–2 mm high, ca 3.5 mm in diam. Fruit of up to 28 monocarps borne on a pedicel ca 38 mm long. Monocarps dark purple with reddish stipes when mature, ellipsoid (1-seeded) to oblongoid (2-seeded), 0.8–1.1 (2-seeded 1.1–1.6) by 0.5–0.9 cm, glabrate, apex rounded and sometimes apiculate, stipe (9–) 20–26 by ca 0.8 mm; pericarp membranous, ca 0.5 mm thick. Seeds 1–2, attached sub-basally if 1, laterally if 2, ellipsoid, 7–9 by 5.2–6.4 mm, smooth, tan-coloured.

description: Evergreen shrubs or small trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, often bright yellow-green when dried, elliptic to oblanceolate, cuneate to rounded and symmetrical at base, midrib plane or sunken above, secondary venation conspicuous, brochidodromous or eucamptodromous, tertiary venation percurrent and with a fine raised reticulum of smaller veins between them conspicuous below. Inflorescences supra-axillary, internodal, or leaf-opposed, 1–4-flowered, peduncle rudimentary. Flowers staminate or hermaphroditic on the same plant, rarely hermaphroditic only, globose to ovoid in bud. Sepals 3, imbricate, free, shorter than the petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, linear to ovate, oblong, elliptic, or obovate, outer petals sometimes shorter than the inner petals, spreading at anthesis, inner petals connivent at apices or free, erect or spreading at anthesis. Stamens numerous, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate to convex. Carpels 6–30, stigmas capitate to clavate; ovule basal, 1 per ovary. Receptacle cushion-shaped to columnar. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, glabrous or pubescent, smooth or verrucose, stipitate; pericarp thin, membranous and adhering to seed when dried. Seed basally attached, 1 per monocarp, ellipsoid, smooth, glabrous, light brown, perichalazal ring sunken, aril absent, endosperm ruminations flattened, peglike or lamellate.</br></br>About 10 species of small shrubs or less frequently trees, often andromonoecious with bright red monocarps. Asian tropics and subtropics; 7 species known from Thailand.

description: Shrub or treelet up to 4 m tall. Twigs glabrous to short-pubescent and eventually glabrate. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic to oblanceolate, 13.7–25.2 by 4.4–7.8 cm, base broadly cuneate, apex gradually acuminate, the acumen 3–21 mm long, glabrous above, glabrous to sparsely pubescent below, secondary veins 10–12 per side, arcuate; petioles 8–11 mm long. Inflorescences internodal or supra-axillary, 1–2-flowered, pedicels 1.5–2 mm long, each bearing 1–2 bracts ca 1 mm long; buds globose. Flowers staminate or hermaphroditic. Sepals semicircular to ovate, 2–3.5 mm long, acute to apiculate, pubescent. Petals cream-coloured, pink, or light brown, slightly fleshy, inner surface glabrous, outer surface pubescent; outer petals spreading, ovate, 4–5 by 3.5–4 mm, acute to apiculate; inner petals connivent, oblong, 5–6 by 2.5–3.3 mm, apex abruptly triangular and distinctively thickened at the margin. Stamens 30–50, cuneate, 1.2–1.7 mm long, anther connective apex truncate, glabrous. Carpels 6–14, ovaries oblong, 0.8–1 mm long, white-sericeous, stigmas capitate, ca 0.5 mm long, glabrous. Fruit of up to 15 monocarps borne on a pedicel ca 2 mm long. Monocarps oblongoid, ca 1.7 by 0.8 cm, smooth or slightly verrucose, glabrate, apex rounded and apiculate, occasionally formed into a short beak, stipe ca 2 mm long, ca 0.5 mm thick. Seed oblongoid, completely filling the monocarp locule.

description: Shrub or treelet ca 2.5 m tall. Twigs densely tomentose. Leaves chartaceous, narrowly elliptic to oblanceolate, 19.1–21.4 by 4.9–6.6 cm, base cuneate to broadly cuneate, apex acuminate, the acumen 4–16 mm long, sometimes pubescent along midrib but otherwise glabrous above, finely tomentose below, secondary veins 11–14 per side, arcuate, forming weak closed loops; petioles 8.5–14 mm long. Inflorescences internodal, 1–4-flowered, pedicels 2.5–5.5 mm long, bearing 1 bract ca 3 mm long; petals separating early in development. Flowers both staminate and hermaphroditic. Sepals ovate, ca 2 mm long, obtuse, silky-hairy. Petals erect at anthesis, pale cream-coloured, chartaceous, glabrous on inner surface, silky-hairy on outer surface; outer petals obovate, ca 6 by 2.5 mm, rounded; inner petals obovate, ca 4 by 4 mm, rounded. Stamens ca 30, oblong, ca 2 mm long, anther connective apex truncate, erect-pubescent. Carpels ca 12. Fruit of up to 10 monocarps borne on a pedicel ca 3.5 mm long. Monocarps oblongoid, ca 1.3 by 0.6 cm, smooth, puberulous, apex rounded to a beak ca 1.5 mm long, stipe ca 2.5 mm long, 1.5 mm thick; pericarp thin. Seed filling the monocarp locule.

description: Tree up to 15 m tall. Twigs short-pubescent, eventually glabrate. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic to oblong-obovate, 16.7–31 by 5.3–9.9 cm, base cuneate to broadly cuneate and short-decurrent on petiole, apex acuminate, the acumen 11–18 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 12–16 per side; petioles 8–13 mm long. Inflorescences supra-axillary, 1-flowered, pedicels 3.5–6.5 mm long, each bearing 1–2 clasping bracts near base; petals separating early in bud. Flowers both staminate and hermaphroditic. Sepals broadly triangular to ovate, 2.7–3 mm long, acute to acuminate, pubescent. Petals white or yellow, chartaceous to coriaceous, pubescent on both surfaces, apex obtuse to rounded or rarely apiculate; outer petals spreading at anthesis, oblanceolate, obovate, elliptic, or oblong, 9.9–14.5 by 4.5–7 mm; inner petals spreading at anthesis, oblanceolate, nearly spatulate, 8–14.5 by 4–6 mm. Stamens ca 60, clavate, wedge-shaped, or oblong, 1.1–1.7 (2.1–2.5 in staminate flowers) mm long, anther connective apex somewhat dome-shaped but sunken, puberulous. Carpels ca 30, ovaries oblong, densely pubescent, stigmas clavate, 0.9–1.1 mm long, villous. Fruit of up to 20 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 9 mm long. Monocarps purple to black, ellipsoid, 1.3–2 by 1–1.3 cm, verrucose and slightly wrinkled, glabrate, apex rounded to obtuse, stipe 13–21 mm long, 0.9–2 mm thick; pericarp ca 0.5 mm thick. Seed ellipsoid, ca 17.1 by 11.6–11.8 mm, pale reddish brown, wrinkled.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Shrub up to 3 m tall. Twigs densely but finely brown-tomentose, eventually glabrate. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic to oblanceolate, 15.7–18.2 by 5.9–6 cm, base cuneate to nearly rounded, apex blunt-acuminate, the acumen 3–8 mm long, glabrous except for short coarse hairs along midrib above, with short coarse hairs along midrib and secondary veins but otherwise glabrous below, secondary veins 8–9 per side, eucamptodromous and strongly ascending; petioles 7–8 mm long. Inflorescences sub-opposite to the leaves, 1–2-flowered, pedicels ca 5 mm long, each bearing 2 bracts ca 2 mm long; buds not seen. Flowers hermaphroditic. Sepals triangular, 2.5–3 mm long, obtuse, sericeous. Petals spreading at anthesis, white to dirty pale yellow, coriaceous, elliptic-oblong, ca 5.5 by 3.5 mm, rounded, glabrous on inner surface, sericeous on outer surface. Stamens ca 180, oblong, ca 1.3 mm long, anther connective apex truncate, glabrous. Carpels ca 14, ovaries ca 1 mm long, pubescent, stigmas globose, ca 0.3 mm long, glabrous. Fruit unknown.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Trivalvaria ochroleuca . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 16. Part 1, 2022. Pg. 291. Accessed 2024-06-07

description: Shrub. Twigs persistently short-pubescent. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic to oblanceolate, 13.8–17.2 by 4.8–6.8 cm, base cuneate, apex sharply acuminate, the acumen 5–16 mm long, glabrous except for hairs along midrib above and below, secondary veins 7–10 per side, eucamptodromous, arcuate; petioles 5.5–9 mm long. Inflorescences internodal, 1–2-flowered, pedicels ca 1.2 mm long, each bearing 1 minute bract; buds with petals separated and erect early in anthesis, exceeded by androecium. Flowers staminate and hermaphroditic. Sepals semicircular, ca 2 mm long, obtuse, sericeous. Petals white, coriaceous to slightly fleshy, glabrate on both surfaces; outer petals recurved at anthesis, ovate, ca 3 by 2.7 mm, acute; inner petals recurved at anthesis, oblong, ca 3 by 2 mm, rounded. Stamens 50–100, clavate, ca 1.7 mm long, anther connective apex truncate, glabrous. Carpels 4–7, ovaries not examined, stigmas exceeding the tops of the stamens, irregular, pubescent. Fruit of ca 9 monocarps on a short pedicel. Monocarps red, oblongoid, acute at the apex.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Shrub or treelet up to 5 m tall. Twigs short grey-pubescent, eventually glabrate. Leaves chartaceous, narrowly oblong or oblanceolate, occasionally elliptic, 14–28.8 by 2.8–7.2 cm, base cuneate to rounded, apex acuminate, the acumen 7–26 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 9–15 per side, eucamptodromous to weakly brochidodromous, arcuate; petioles 5–9 mm long. Inflorescences supra-axillary, 1-flowered, pedicels 4–5.5 mm long, each bearing 1 bract ca 3 mm long; buds with petals separating well before anthesis. Flowers staminate or hermaphroditic. Sepals triangular, 3.5–5 mm long, acute to acuminate, sericeous. Petals creamy white, yellow, or pale orange, coriaceous, glabrous on inner surface, sericeous on outer surface; outer petals spreading at anthesis, lanceolate to linear, 7–12.8 by 1.8–3.7 mm, acute; inner petals spreading at anthesis, linear to linear-lanceolate, 8–15.5 by 1.6–3.2 mm, acute. Stamens ca 150, oblong, 1–1.9 mm long, anther connective apex truncate, glabrous. Carpels 9–18, ovaries ca 1 mm long, pubescent, stigmas flat or globose. Fruit of up to 7 monocarps borne on a pedicel 5–8 mm long. Monocarps oblongoid, 1.8–2.2 by 0.7–0.9 cm, verrucose and faintly ridged, glabrate, apex rounded to a beak 0.8–1.5 mm long, stipe 0.8–2.5 mm long, 2–2.2 mm thick, pubescent; pericarp ca 0.2 mm thick. Seed narrowly ellipsoid, ca 18 mm by 7–7.5 mm, pale orange-brown, smooth.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Evergreen woody climbers or sarmentose shrubs, with distichous primary branching. Indument of stellate hairs, rarely with additional simple hairs on leaf venation. Leaves membranous to coriaceous, obovate, elliptic or ovate, base cordate to cuneate, midrib sunken above, secondary veins sub-parallel or convergent, tertiary venation reticulate; petioles sometimes marked by transverse foliations. Inflorescences terminal, leaf-opposed or rarely axillary or supra-axillary, 1–5-flowered, plants cauliflorous in a few species. Flowers hermaphroditic; buds globose to conical. Sepals (2–)3(–4), free and valvate, basally connate or fully connate into a calyptrate calyx, shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of (2–)3, imbricate, free or connate in a ring at base, ovate, oblong or obovate, whorls subequal, or inner petals smaller and distinct from the outer petals in shape, petals erect, spreading, reflexed or partially reflexed at maturity. Stamens numerous, outermost sometimes staminodial, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex globose, umbonate, truncate, or concave, or elongate and flattened, filament short or absent. Carpels 1–ca 50, stigmas elongate or flattened, lobes conical or U-shaped; ovules 2–36 in two rows, or rarely solitary. Receptacle flat or shallowly convex. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, globose, oblong, or cylindrical, pubescent or rarely glabrous, surface smooth, verrucose, or bearded, often with longitudinal ridges, stipitate or rarely sessile; pericarp thin, membranous when dried. Seeds attached laterally in 2 rows, rarely 1 attached apically or sub-apically, 1–36 per monocarp, ellipsoid, smooth, brown, perichalazal ring flat, aril circular or rectangular, endosperm ruminations lamellate.</br></br>A Palaeotropical genus of about 210 species of climbers with stellate hairs. In Thailand the genus is represented by 23 species, 2 with 2 varieties present in the flora. Uvaria is probably the most ubiquitous Annonaceae genus in Thailand and among the most diverse. Uvaria grandiflora and U. siamensis are grown as ornamentals, and Uvaria rufa is sought for its edible fruits.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Woody climber. Young shoots sparsely stellate to subglabrous, eventually glabrous. Leaves subcoriaceous, waxy, drying dark brown above and below, oblanceolate, elliptic-oblanceolate or narrowly obovate, 7.5–24 by 4–9.5 cm, base rounded, broadly cuneate or slightly oblique-rounded, apex acuminate or acute, the acumen 3–15 mm long; glabrous above, and below except for sparse stellate hairs on midrib, secondary veins 9–12 per side; petioles 5–10 mm long, smooth with sparse brown indument, becoming glabrous. Inflorescences supra-axillary or leaf-opposed, 1–3-flowered, often only the primary bud opened, the others enclosed by bracts, peduncle 1.5–3.5 mm long, pedicels 8–11 mm long, peduncle and pedicel terete, indument sparse, persistent; basal bract ovate, 1–2.5 by 0.5–1.5 mm; medial bract ovate 1.5–2 by 1–1.5 mm, obtuse. Sepals 3, valvate, free, green, broadly ovate, 2–2.5 by 2.5–3 mm, concave, apex obtuse to bluntly acute, outer surface indument sparse, prominent at margins outside, inner surface basally glabrous, hairs sparse at margins. Petals in two whorls of 3, green or yellow, with fine vertical furrows on outer surface, indument persistent on outer surface, sparse medially, somewhat prominent at margins, inner surfaces glabrous; outer petals coriaceous, ovate, 4–4.5 by 4–4.5 mm, concave, slightly spreading at maturity to clearly expose carpels, apex bluntly acute; inner petals subcoriaceous, ovate 4–4.5 by 4–4.2 mm, base distinctly contricted, apex bluntly acute. Stamens numerous, cuneate, 1.2–1.5 mm long, anther connective apex flat, cap-like, papillate, filament rudimentary. Carpels 10–18, ovaries 1–1.6 mm long, glabrous except for prominent ring of hairs on ovary neck just beneath stigma, stigmas glabrous, U-shaped, not elongate, 0.5 mm long; ovules 4–12. Monocarps 4–6+, oblongoid, ellipsoid or ovoid-ellipsoid, 2.8–5.5 by 1.8–2.6 cm, glabrous, granular or minutely tuberculate, stipe 30–60 by 2–3 mm, glabrous; pericarp fleshy at maturity, thin when dried. Seeds 4–8(–12), closely packed in 2 rows, 15–18 by 8–10 mm, compressed-ellipsoid, smooth, aril present.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Uvaria clementis . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 16. Part 1, 2022. Pg. 296. Accessed 2024-06-07

description: Woody climber to 30 m tall. Young shoots tomentose, indument becoming sparse very quickly. Leaves coriaceous, shiny above, elliptic-oblong to narrowly obovate, ca 13–15 by 4–5 cm, base narrowly cordate, apex acute or less often acuminate, glabrous above, sparsely covered with blunt, many-branched hairs below, secondary veins ca 10–12 per side; petioles 7–10 by 1.25 mm, deeply grooved above, often overtopped by margins, transverse foliations distinct, warty. Inflorescences terminal or leaf-opposed by apposition, flowers solitary or with dormant secondary bud, peduncle sometimes evident to 5 mm; pedicels 15–20(–50) by ca 2.5 mm, indument dense and appearing tubercled with many-branched thickly-set hairs; buds globose to conical with prominent acuminate apiculum. Calyx calyptrate in bud, sepals wholly connate, splitting unevenly, (2–)3(–4), basally connate at maturity, ca 11 by 10 mm, ovate-acute, concave, outer surface with same indument as pedicel. Petals 6 (or rarely 4) divided evenly in two whorls, dark pink or red, spreading to reflexed at anthesis, basally connate in a single whorl, very broadly obovate, ca 20 by 15 mm, apex obtuse, detaching from receptacle as connate ring. Stamens numerous, cuneate, ca 3.5 mm long, anther locules equal or subequal in length, extending the length of the stamen, anther connective apex flattened or shallowly truncate, filament absent. Carpels numerous, ca 3.5 mm long, ovaries with flattened, many-branched spreading hairs, stigmas short, U-shaped, not distinctly lobed; ovules 8–10 in two lateral rows. Monocarps ca 5 to many, orange-yellow at maturity, smooth or somewhat tubercled, globose-oblongoid, 1.5–3 by 1–1.7 cm, occasionally constricted between seeds, with 1 or more longitudinal ridges, small apiculum often present, stipe ca 50–100(–120) by 2–4 mm, typically flattened, striate. Seeds 2–10 in two closely-packed rows, ovoid to compressed-ovoid, 8–11 by 6–9 by 3–5 mm, smooth, aril and perichalazal ring not prominent.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Uvaria concava . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 16. Part 1, 2022. Pg. 297. Accessed 2024-06-07

description: Shrub or climber to 20 m tall, distinctively persistent-hirsute over all vegetative organs. Young shoots with ferrugineous hairs that become sparser with age. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic to narrowly obovate, ca 21–25 by 6–7 cm, base narrowly cordate, apex acute or short-acuminate, hirsute, hairs ferrugineous on both leaf surfaces, ca 0.5–1 mm long, producing a distinctive ferrugineous tint along leaf margins, secondary veins 10–12+ per side; petioles ca 8 by 3 m. Inflorescences leaf-opposed, 2-flowered, peduncle 1.5–12 mm, pedicels ca 20–30 by 1 mm, basal bract narrowly elliptic, ca 8 by 2 mm, often clasping, medial bract ovate to broadly elliptic, 4–5 by 2.5–3 mm; buds globose. Calyx calyptrate in bud, sepals 3, ca 10 by 6 mm, ovate, acute to narrowly acute. Petals in two subequal whorls of 3, white or greenish yellow, elliptic-acute, ca 13 by 6.5 mm, membranous, spreading, inner surface bearing prominent indentations from stamens. Stamens numerous, cuneate to laminar, 3 mm long, anther connective apex truncate on inner whorls or somewhat flat and elongate in marginal stamens, ridge sometimes present on outer surface, papillate, filament absent. Carpels numerous, ca 3 mm long, ovaries with dense combed-tomentose indument, stigmas U-shaped, lobes not broadened; ovules ca 20 in 2 lateral rows. Monocarps 10–30, colour unknown, cylindrical to oblongoid, ca 6.5 by 2.5 cm, ferrugineous-tomentose, stipe 10–40 by 2–3 mm. Seeds ca 16, flattened-ellipsoid, ca 10 by 6 by 4 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Uvaria curtisii . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 16. Part 1, 2022. Pg. 298. Accessed 2024-06-07

description: Climber or sarmentose shrub. Young shoots ferrugineous-tomentose, hairs quickly becoming blunt and sparse, bark striate. Leaves coriaceous, narrowly elliptic-obovate, ca 18–19 by 6–8 cm, base narrowly cordate, acute to distinctly acuminate or cuspidate, indument of 1–4-branched hairs above, of 10-branched hairs below, secondary veins 11–13 per side; petioles 5–7 by ca 2 mm, tomentose, indument becoming sparse. Inflorescences leaf-opposed, flowers solitary or rarely 2–3, pedicels 8–15(–25) mm, often flattened to ca 2 mm broad, otherwise ca 1.25 mm, bracts ovate-acute, ca 4–7(–10) by 1.25–2 mm, often absent; buds 8–15 mm in diam. Calyx calyptrate in bud, splitting into 2–4 often unevenly sized ovate-acute sepals, each (7–)10 by (8–)10 mm, at length spreading. Petals in 2 subequal whorls of 3, yellow or rarely red, spreading, elliptic, 15–20 by 8–10 mm, apex obtuse-acute. Stamens numerous, cuneate, ca 4.5 mm long, anther connective apex truncate, adaxial ridge often present, smooth, filament absent. Carpels 10–15, ca 3.5 mm long, ovaries densely ferrugineous-tomentose, stout in appearance, apex narrowed into neck, stigmas glabrous with conspicuously broad U-shaped lobes, partially occluded by extension of ovary wall above neck; ovules ca 16 in 2 lateral rows. Monocarps 1–8(–10), obliquely attached to stipe, green with brown tint, ca 4.5 by 2.5 cm in diam., oblongoid, epidermis entirely uneven and warted, finely tomentose, stipe 5–10 by 2.5–3 mm, thickly striate, tomentose, pericarp thickened. Seeds 6–12 in 2 rows, ca 10 by 6 by 4 mm, hemi-ellipsoid.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Uvaria dac . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 16. Part 1, 2022. Pg. 299. Accessed 2024-06-07

description: Scrambling shrub or climber. Young shoots sparsely tomentose. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic-oblong, to 12.5 by 6 cm, base narrowly cordate or rarely cuneate in younger leaves, apex acute to short-acuminate, sparsely pubescent except for midrib sub-tomentose with erect hairs above, becoming more glabrous to sparsely pubescent, with sparse hairs along midrib and veins but otherwise sparsely pubescent to glabrous below, secondary veins 6–13 per side; petioles 5–8 mm long, sparsely tomentose. Inflorescences leaf-opposed, 1-flowered, pedicels to 60 mm long, 1–3 mm in diam., widest at base of receptacle. Sepals 3, free, valvate, ovate-acute, to 5 by 6 mm, outer surface tomentose, inner surface basally glabrous. Petals in two whorls of 3, white-green; outer petals 25–30 mm long, 8–10 mm wide, free; inner petals 23–28 mm long, 5–8 mm wide, lower margins often connivent. Stamens numerous, cuneate, ca 2.5 mm long, locules raised on short filament, anther connective apex convex or flattened, smooth. Carpel 1, stigma disc-shaped, 3 mm in diam., glabrous; ovules laterally inserted in 2 rows, 6–12. Monocarp 1, ovoid to oblongoid, 1.5–3.5 by 1–1.5 cm, subsessile, the stipe 3–4 by 3–4 mm, tomentose. Seeds 6–12.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Uvaria dasoclema . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 16. Part 1, 2022. Pg. 299. Accessed 2024-06-07

description: Sarmentose shrub or climber up to 30 m long or more. Young shoots tomentose, becoming glabrous with distinctive pale lenticels. Leaves membranous, elliptic to broadly elliptic to shortly obovate, ca 10–14 by 4.5–6 cm, base sub-cordate to shortly cordate, apex acute, blade sparsely covered with 1–4-branched spreading hairs or becoming subglabrous, tomentose with erect hairs along the sunken midrib above, blade sub-tomentose except with spreading 5+-branched hairs, tomentose near petiole, on veins and midrib the hairs ca 10-branched, ferrugineous, and stocky below, secondary veins 15–18 per side; petioles 3.5–5 by ca 1 mm, tomentose. Inflorescences terminal, pendulous, 1–many-flowered, usually 2–3-flowered, peduncle ca 5–10 mm, pedicels ca 12–25 mm; buds globose. Sepals 3, valvate, connate at base, ovate-acute, ca 3.25 by 4.5 mm. Petals in two whorls of 3, white or yellow-pink, broadly elliptic-acute at first, expanding to obovate-acute at maturity, coriaceous to membranous; outer petals ca 21.5 by 11.5 mm; inner petals ca 20.5 by 10.5 mm, inner surface basally glabrous with two lateral orange-coloured glands inserted above the base. Stamens numerous, cuneate, ca 1.5 mm long, anther connective apex broad and flattened, often forming lip on inner side, papillate, glabrous, locules often uneven in length, filament short. Carpels ca 25, forming a distinct dome above stamens, ca 2.5 mm long, usually hairy below stigma neck and along lateral ridges, stigmas long and hairy with distinct neck, U-shaped; ovules ca 14–16. Monocarps ca 10+, green turning orange and then red, oblongoid to short-cylindrical, ca 1 by 0.65 cm, glabrous, stipe ca 5–10 mm. Seeds 1–8, compressed-ovoid, ca 5 by 4 by 4 mm, perichalazal ring raised, aril transversely compressed.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Uvaria dulcis . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 16. Part 1, 2022. Pg. 300. Accessed 2024-06-07

description: Scrambling shrub to 3 m or large woody climber to 30 m high. Young shoots densely tomentose, becoming striate and subglabrous. Leaves subcoriaceous to coriaceous, elliptic-obovate, 13–19(–25 by 5–7.5(–10) cm, base subcordate to narrowly cordate, apex obtuse-acute, surface sparsely hairy to subglabrous, hairs 1–many-branched above, tomentose to rarely sparsely hairy, hairs all stellate, ca 10-branched, 0.3–0.5 mm in diam., below, secondary veins 11–14(–16) per side; petioles 5–6 by ca 2 mm, warted and transversely foliated, black. Inflorescences leaf-opposed or sub-opposed, solitary or rarely with second dormant bud, or plants cauliflorous with elongate, often many-branched cymes with 3 to many pedicels, pedicels 10–15 by 2 mm, or up to 60 by 2 mm, ferrugineous, bracts leaflike, ovate-elliptic, 10–33 by 5–20 mm; bud 15–25 mm in diam. Calyx calyptrate in bud, later dividing into (2–)3(–4) ovate-acute, 15–25 by 9–18 mm sepals, reflexing at maturity. Petals in 2 subequal whorls of 3, white or deep red to purple, spreading, often reflexed, broadly ovate or elliptic-oblong to rarely very narrowly obovate, 20–50 by 8–25 mm Stamens numerous, linear, 6–8 by ca 1.25 mm, anther connective apex flattened, dorsal ridge often prominent, with stellate indument running length of connective, apex papillate, filament absent. Carpels numerous, 8–8.5 by 1.5 mm, ovaries densely tomentose, stigmas U shaped, glabrous, somewhat lobed, 2 by 1–2 mm; ovules 24–36. Monocarps 6–12(–20), yellow, cylindrical, 5–7.5 by 1–2 cm, smooth or with longitudinal or lateral ridges and constrictions between seeds, ferrugineous-tomentose, becoming smooth to subglabrous at maturity, stipe to ca 30 by 4 mm. Seeds 16–30, hemi-ellipsoid to ovoid, often dorsiventrally flattened, ca 7 by 5 by 2 mm, smooth, ruminations visible.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Uvaria grandiflora . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 16. Part 1, 2022. Pg. 303. Accessed 2024-06-07

description: Climber to 25 m high. Young shoots sparsely tomentose, quickly becoming subglabrous, bark black and striate. Leaves membranous or coriaceous, narrowly obovate, 10–15 by 4–6 cm, base narrowly cordate to cordate, apex acute to short-acuminate, hairs erect, sub-tomentose over upper midrib but otherwise glabrous above, midrib quickly becoming sparsely pubescent to glabrous, sparsely pubescent to subglabrous on midrib but otherwise subglabrous to glabrous below, secondary veins 9–15 per side; petioles 5–7 by 1.2–2.5 mm, warted below. Inflorescences leaf-opposed, 1–4-flowered, plants sometimes cauliflorous, peduncle elongate, ca 20–50 mm long by 1.5 mm in diam., pedicels 20–30 mm long. Sepals 3, valvate, free, broadly ovate, 5 mm wide by 3 mm long, often reflexed at maturity. Petals in two whorls of 3, green or yellow, concave, thickened basally and with prominent transverse foliations on outer surface; outer petals broadly ovate, ca 5 by 5 mm; inner petals ovate, 5 by 4 mm, base constricted. Stamens numerous, cuneate, 2–2.5 mm long, anther connective apex ca 0.5–0.7 mm long, incurved, papillate, papillae often hair-like, filament absent. Carpels numerous, ca 3–4 mm long, ovaries tomentose, stigmas glabrous, elongate, conical, ca 1–1.25 mm long, U-shaped in section; ovules 5–6 in 2 rows. Monocarps 2–10+, green-yellow, ovoid to oblongoid but irregular in shape due to compression of pericarp around seeds, 2.5–4 by 1–2 cm, glabrous, stipe ca 20 mm long, 2.5 mm in diam.; pericarp thickened. Seeds 4–6, in two rows but becoming irregularly arranged in mature fruit.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Uvaria griffithii . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 16. Part 1, 2022. Pg. 304. Accessed 2024-06-07

description: Large climber to 30 m, or a scrambling, rarely upright, shrub. Young shoots ferrugineous-hirsute, becoming subglabrous and distinctly striate. Leaves membranous, (elliptic-)obovate, 11.5–17.5(–20.5) by 6–8.5 cm, base subcordate to narrowly cordate, apex acute or very short-acuminate, sub-tomentose with simple and stellate hairs above, sub-tomentose with stellate hairs only, scattered thickly-set rufous hairs on midrib and veins but rare or absent on blade below, secondary veins often distinctively numerous, 11–25 per side, sometimes branching basally or medially; petioles ca 4 by 2 mm, warty. Inflorescences leaf-opposed or sub-opposed, 1–2(–3)-flowered, peduncle ca 5 mm long, pedicels ca 35 by 2 mm, bracts broadly obovate to circular-ovate, often wrapping around pedicel, ca 10 by 10 mm; buds globose, indument rufous with occasional thickly set hairs giving a tubercled appearance. Calyx calyptrate in bud, sepals 3–4, spreading, partially recurved, connate at base, triangular to very broadly ovate, 7 by 10 mm, bluntly acute, indument as for pedicel. Petals in 2 subequal whorls of 3, petals red or white to yellow, spreading, often reflexed, elliptic to oblong to distinctly obovate, 10–22 by 10–14 mm, apex broadly concave-rounded to obtuse. Stamens numerous, linear, 2.5–3 mm long, anther connective apex compact, not extended, papillae often prominent, filament absent. Carpels numerous, ca 2 mm long, ovaries densely tomentose, stigmas glabrous, U-shaped; ovules 10–12. Monocarps 10–14, green, turning red, globose to oblongoid, ca 2 by 1.5 cm, ferrugineous-tomentose, often verrucose, stipe ca 25–35 by 1.25–2.25 mm, striate, especially when thick, tomentose, monocarp attachment basal or sub-basal; pericarp fleshy or thin. Seeds ellipsoid, laterally compressed, 6–12, ca 11 by 4 by 2 mm, smooth, brown, ruminations visible.

description: Climber to 30 m high. Young shoots densely ferrugineous-tomentose, becoming striate and glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, broadly ovate to obovate, ca 20–30 by 15–18(–20) cm, base cordate to subcordate, apex obtuse or short-acuminate, subglabrous except for densely tomentose midrib and main veins above, tomentose to sub-tomentose below, secondary veins 5–25+ per side; petioles ca 10 by 3.5 mm, deeply grooved above. Inflorescences axillary or leaf-opposed, 2–5+ buds in a tightly-packed rhipidium, peduncles 5–10(–15) mm long, 2–3 mm in diam., pedicels 3–10 mm by 2–2.5 mm, bracts broadly obovate, rarely ovate, fleshy, to 5 by 7 mm, remaining concave and wrapping around pedicel, often enclosing younger buds; buds globose. Sepals 3, connate in early bud, then splitting to form a basally connate three-pointed ring around the unexpanded petals, ring later splitting into ovate-acute sepals 4–6 by 6–8 mm wide. Petals 6, basally connate in a single whorl, red, fleshy, ovate-acute, expanding to 15–18 by 10–12 mm, usually concave, reflexed at maturity. Stamens numerous, linear to narrowly cuneate, 5–6 mm long, anther locules extending the full length of stamens in central whorls, decreasing in size towards the outermost whorl of narrowly obovate staminodes, anther connective apex elongate, 5–sided in central whorls, flat in outer whorls, minutely papillate, filament absent. Carpels 20–25, 4–4.25 mm long, indument stellate, short and somewhat combed, stigmas short, glabrous, U-shaped, base narrowed and sub-tomentose; ovules 12–14. Monocarps 10–20, orange-yellow, turning maroon red and then ripening black, spherical-ovoid-oblongoid, often with constrictions between seeds, ca 3 by 1.6 cm, subglabrous when young but then glabrate, stipe 2–5 by 2–3 mm. Seeds 10–14, hemi-ellipsoid, ca 10 by 7 by 3 mm.

description: Climber to 30 m high. Young shoots with hairs sparse, becoming subglabrous, striate, with prominent lenticels. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic to narrowly obovate, 10–17.5(–20) by 4–7.5(–8.5) cm, base shortly cordate, apex acute-cuspidate, subglabrous except for sub-tomentose midrib on both surfaces, secondary veins 8–14 per side; petioles 3–4 by 1.25–2 mm. Inflorescences supra-axillary or rarely leaf-opposed, 1–2(–4)-flowered, peduncle 2–5 by ca 1.5 mm, pedicels 5–10(–14) by 1.5 mm, bracts broadly ovate, 6–10 by 6–10 mm, membranous, sparsely hairy to sub-tomentose with tomentose margin, veins prominent; buds globose. Sepals 3, valvate, free, ovate, 7 by 3.5 mm long, recurving at tips. Petals in 2 subequal whorls of 3, yellow, often turning pink or red, spreading, often reflexed, shortly and broadly ovate, or elliptic, apex obtuse or bluntly acute, outer surface often with transverse ridges of blunt stellate hairs; outer petals ca 11 by 8 mm; inner petals ca 10 by 8 mm. Stamens numerous, outer whorl staminodial, linear, 2.25–2.5(–3) mm long, anther connective apex flattened with prominent papillae, filament absent. Carpels numerous, 2.25–2.5(–3) mm, ovaries densely tomentose with ring of elongate hairs ca 0.25 mm long beneath stigma, stigmas U-shaped, glabrous; ovules ca 6–8(–10). Monocarps ovoid or globose, ca 1.6–1.8 by 2–2.5 cm, prominently tubercled, stipe 35–55(–70) by 1.5–2 mm, finely striate. Seeds 4–6, ca 12 by 10 by 4.5 mm, smooth.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Climber or scrambling shrub with narrow tangling branches forming dense thickets. Young shoots sub-tomentose, striations appearing early. Leaves thinly coriaceous, waxy, elliptic to short-lanceolate to narrowly obovate, ca 7–12 by 2–4 cm, base cuneate, apex acuminate-acute, glabrous on both surfaces except for midrib sub-tomentose to sparsely pubescent with erect 2–3-branched hairs above and isolated ca 1–2-branched ascending hairs along midrib below, secondary veins 9–12 per side (or up to 16 with long acumen); petioles 2–3(–4) by 0.75 mm. Inflorescences leaf-opposed, floral buds 1–3, often only the primary flower opened, the others enclosed by bracts, peduncle rudimentary, ca 1.5(–2) mm by 0.75 mm, pedicels 2–4(–5) by 0.5 mm, basal bract ovate, 4–6 by 1–2(–4) mm, medial bract smaller, ovate-acute, to 1.5 by 2 mm; buds ovoid. Sepals 3, free, valvate, broadly ovate-acute, ca 2 by 2.75 mm, concave. Petals in two whorls of 3, green-yellow to maroon, thick and fleshy, concave, spreading at maturity; outer petals ovate-oblong, ca 3.25 by 2.5 mm; inner petals broadly elliptic with a distinctly constricted base, ca 3.35 by 2 mm. Stamens numerous, cuneate, 0.6–1 mm long, anther connective apex flat, cap-like, papillate, filament absent. Carpels ca 20, 0.8–1.5 mm long, straight or bent inward at margin of gynoecium, hairy along ridges and just beneath stigma, hairs fine, many-branched, stigmas U-shaped, glabrous, somewhat elongate; ovules 2(–4). Monocarps 10–20, green turning yellow, orange, red, or purple, globose to short-oblongoid, ca 0.95 by 0.8 cm, stipe 14–20–(–23) mm, glabrous, smooth. Seeds 1–2(–3), ca 7 by 4 by 4 mm when in single-seeded monocarp, to 7 by 4 by 2 mm when 2–3 seeded, aril 2.5 by 1.75 mm, triangular.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Scandent shrub or more rarely a climber. Young shoots sub-tomentose, becoming subglabrous and striate with distinct white lenticels. Leaves coriaceous, often shiny, oblong, 4.5–9 by 1.7–3.5 cm, base subcordate-obtuse, apex obtuse or retuse, leaf margin revolute, with sparse erect stellate hairs along midrib but otherwise glabrous above, sparsely pubescent to subglabrous along lower midrib and veins but otherwise glabrous below, secondary veins ca 12–14 per side; petioles 3–4.5 by ca 1.25 mm. Inflorescences leaf-opposed or sub-opposed, 2-flowered, often with one bud dormant, peduncle ca 3–4 mm long, pedicels ca 10 mm long, often transversely flattened with a longitudinal groove; buds ovoid. Sepals 3, valvate, free, separating early, broadly ovate, ca 2.25 by 4.5 mm, apex acute, sometimes reflexing at maturity, remaining concave. Petals in two whorls of 3, purple, remaining erect, hardly expanding, narrowly ovate to broadly elliptic, ca 4.5–5.25 by 4–4.5 mm, fleshy, thickened basally, inner petals marginally smaller than outer petals. Stamens numerous, cuneate, ca 1 mm long, anther connective apex flat, smooth, filament absent. Carpels ca 40, ca 1.75 mm long, ridges and neck hairy, stigmas broad and elongate, ca 0.6 by 0.4 mm, U-shaped, glabrous, with prominent longitudinal slit; ovules 4–6 in 2 rows. Monocarps 5–15, green, maturing yellow and then purple, globose or ovoid, ca 1.75 by 1.25 cm, smooth or very finely tuberculate, stipe ca 7–12 mm long. Seeds 2–4, up to ca 12 by 9 by 4 mm.

description: Shrub or woody climber up to 25 m high. Young shoots ferrugineous-tomentose, the hairs becoming sparse, striate with prominent lenticels. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic to narrowly obovate, 10–17.5 by 3.5–7.5 cm, base narrowly cordate to subcordate, apex acute, scabrid, sparsely covered with 2–5-branched erect hairs above, the hairs longer over midrib and veins forming a prominent ferrugineo-tomentose ridge, sub-tomentose, the hairs 9–12-branched and blunt on midrib and veins below, secondary veins 10–13 per side; petioles 4–5 by ca 1.5 mm. Inflorescences leaf-opposed, cymose with up to 4 pedicels, peduncle ca 3 by 1.5 mm, pedicels ca 8–10 mm long, bracts ca 6 by 4.5 mm, ovate; buds globose. Sepals 3, valvate at apex, connate at base, broadly triangular, ca 6 by 3 mm, forming a detached ring at base of fruiting receptacle. Petals in two subequal whorls of 3, red or purple, broadly elliptic-oblong, ca 12–14 by 5–6 mm, reflexing at maturity. Stamens 30–40, 3–3.5(–4) mm by 0.5 mm, inner whorls linear, flattened, anther connective apex ca 1 mm long, papillate, outer whorls concave, those of sub-marginal whorl staminode-like with much-reduced locules, and those of outermost whorl staminodial, the staminodes 3 mm long by 1.5–2 mm wide, broadly obovate, filament absent. Carpels ca 20 or fewer, 3.75 by 0.75 mm, ovaries tomentose, hairs flattened, stigmas U-shaped and glabrous, occluded by extension of ovary wall above a distinctly narrowed neck; ovules ca 24. Monocarps 4–8(–20), bright red when mature, cylindrical, ca 2.5–3.5 by 1.4–2.1 cm, ferrugineous-tomentose, becoming smooth to subglabrous at maturity, stipe ridged, ca 25–30 by 1–2 mm; pericarp thin. Seeds in two rows, occasionally compressed into what appears to be one row, 5–14(–20+), compressed-ellipsoid, ca 6 by 4 by 2 mm, ruminations visible.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Scandent or erect shrub or tree to 2 m, or climber to 20 m. Young shoots tomentose with large many-branched ferrugineous hairs scattered over smaller, finer, hairs. Leaves thinly coriaceous, waxy above, lanceolate to elliptic, 9–15 by 3–4 cm, base narrowly cordate, apex narrowly to bluntly acute, glabrous except for sparse spreading stellate hairs on midrib above, sub-tomentose with underlying layer of fine ca 6–8 branched hairs overlain with scattered, thickened, many-branched hairs especially on midrib below, secondary veins 8–11(–14) per side; petioles ca 3.5 by 1.25 mm. Inflorescences leaf-opposed or sub-opposed, flowers solitary or rarely 2–3, peduncle rudimentary, ca 1.5 by 1.25 mm, pedicels ca 8 by 1.25 mm. Sepals 3, valvate, free, separating early, very broadly ovate-acute, ca 3 by 6 mm, thickened and remaining incurved. Petals in two whorls of 3, yellow-white, erect at anthesis, fleshy; outer petals broadly ovate, concave, ca 8 by 8 mm; inner petals broadly elliptic with constricted base, ca 8 by 5.5 mm, marginal glands absent. Stamens numerous, cuneate, ca 1.5 mm long, anther locules often unequal in length, anther connective apex flat or shallowly convex, rusty brown or orange with waxy texture, covered with minute blunt papillae, filament short. Carpels ca 10, 3 mm long, ovaries covered with blunt stellate hair-scales giving a very finely warted appearance, neck between ovary and stigma covered with long stellate hairs, stigmas prominent, lobed, U-shaped, hairy, ca 1 mm long, forming distinct dome above stamens, often with copious exudate; ovules ca 4–8, laterally inserted. Monocarps 2–10 (usually 3–6), yellow when mature, globose or short-oblongoid, regular in shape, 1–1.2 by 0.8–0.9 cm, very minutely tubercled, subsessile, the stipe ca 1 mm by 2–3 mm, striate; pericarp thickened and fleshy, but outline of seeds often clear within pericarp in dried specimens. Seeds ca 2–4(–6), compressed hemi-ellipsoid, ca 7 by 4 by 3 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Climber or scrambling shrub. Young shoots sparsely tomentose, bark black, striate. Leaves waxy, elliptic to narrowly obovate, 13–17 by 5–6 cm, base narrowly cordate, apex acuminate or rarely acute, glabrous above, sparsely pubescent, the hairs fine, 3–10-branched, rufous, to glabrous below, secondary veins 9–11 per side; petioles 5–7 by ca 1.5 mm. Inflorescences leaf-opposed or sub-opposed, flowers solitary or rarely two or three from young shoots, peduncle 3–5 by 1 mm, pedicels elongate and flattened, 35–90 by 1.5–2 mm, basal bract to 11 by 3 mm with prominent central vein, sub-tomentose to sparsely hairy above and below, medial bract very small, ca 1 by 1 mm, ovate, acute, tomentose, both bracts often absent; buds globose. Sepals 3, valvate, separating early, free, ca 4.5 mm wide by 2 mm long. Petals in two whorls of 3, yellow-green to purple, erect, concave; outer petals broadly ovate, ca 9–15 by 8–15 mm; inner petals narrowly ovate, 6–10 by 4–8 mm, apex acute. Stamens numerous, ca 2 by 0.4 mm, apex tomentose, filament absent. Carpels 3 mm long, ovaries tomentose, hairs ferrugineous, 5-branched, 0.5 mm in diam., stigmas elongate, 1 mm long, glabrous; ovules 2. Monocarps 15–30, green to red, transversely ovoid, to ca 0.9 by 0.7 cm (1-seeded) or 1 by 0.9 cm (2-seeded), stipe ca 25–40 by 1.25 mm; pericarp thin, flaking easily after drying. Seeds 1–2, to ca 9 by 7 by 4.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Woody climber. Young shoots short-tomentose, quickly becoming smooth and striate. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic, ca 6–15 by 3–5 cm; base subcordate to broadly cuneate, apex acute to acuminate, glabrous, with blunt hairs occasionally persistent along sunken midrib above, glabrous with isolated 2–5-branched hairs along midrib and secondary veins below, secondary veins 8–10 per side; petioles ca 3–7 by 1 mm, smooth. Inflorescences dichasial, the plants cauliflorous, peduncles short and closely packed, ca 1 mm long by 2 mm wide, pedicels to 22 by 1 mm. Sepals 3, valvate, basally connate, ovate, ca 7 mm wide by 5 mm long. Petals in two whorls of 3, whitish green, erect, imbricate along entire margin, bases somewhat thickened; outer petals ovate, concave, coriaceous, ca 9 by 7 mm; inner petals narrowly ovate, ca 8.5 by 6.5 mm, bluntly acute. Stamens numerous but reduced to 3 or 4 whorls, ca 5 by 1 mm, glabrous, connective with prominent extrorse ridge, anther connective apex flattened, bluntly acute, papillate, filament absent. Carpels ca 50, ca 5 by 1 mm, ovaries tomentose, stigmas narrow, ca 1 mm long, U-shaped, glabrous; ovules ca 16. Fruit unknown.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Climber or scrambling shrub. Young shoots sub-tomentose, hairs ferrugineous with 2–5 ca 1 mm long multi-cellular branches, bark smooth, becoming striate and sparse with occasional persistent larger hairs. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic to narrowly obovate, (7–)9–22.5 by (3.5–) 4–7.5 cm, base narrowly cordate, apex acuminate/acute, hairs on blade simple or occasionally 2-branched, ca 1 mm long, the midrib densely tomentose with erect 1 or 2+ branched hairs 0.75–1 mm long above, midrib and blade sub-tomentose to sparse with 4–8 branched, ca 0.6–0.85 mm long stellate hairs below, secondary veins 14–16 per side; petioles 3–5 by 1.5–2 mm, sub-tomentose, the hairs stellate, fine, and pale coloured, or more thickly set and ferrugineous. Inflorescences not known. Monocarps ca 20+, red, spherical, 2–3 cm in diam., covered with distinctive 3+-branched ca 5 mm long outgrowths, each covered with ferrugineous-tomentose branches, stipes to 45 by 2 mm, striate, sub-tomentose. Seeds 4–8, shortly hemi-ellipsoid, ca 11 by 5.25–7 by 2–3 mm, aril prominent, 4 by 2.5–3 by 3 mm, surface leathery, brown, ruminations visible.

description: Evergreen trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves coriaceous, base cuneate, broadly cuneate, cuneate-obtuse or obtuse, symmetrical, midrib raised above, secondary veins conspicuous, tertiary venation usually reticulate, sometimes intermediate between reticulate and percurrent. Inflorescences clustered on trunks, swollen/unswollen trunk base, and/or large roots. Flowers unisexual (staminate and pistillate separate but intermixed in the same individual, except only staminate observed for W. thailandana), subglobose in bud. Sepals 3, slightly imbricate in bud, basally connate, shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, imbricate, free, carnose, outer petals elliptic to ovate, inner petals slightly smaller than outer petals, elliptic, ovate, or obovate. Stamens > 30, thickened and somewhat fleshy, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex more or less truncate. Carpels > 25, stigmas with multiple columnar lobes; ovules lateral, biseriate 5–9(–11) per ovary. Receptacle more or less hemispherical in both staminate and pistillate flowers. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps indehiscent, subglobose to ellipsoid, glabrous, shallowly verruculose (finely scaly), apex rounded, subsessile; pericarp thick, rather woody when dried. Seeds attached laterally in 2 rows, ca 6 per monocarp, ± D-shaped, sometimes slightly flattened, smooth, glabrous, ± brown when dried, perichalazal ring ± forming a ridge, aril absent, endosperm ruminations lamellate.</br></br>A tropical Asian genus of 4 species, represented in Thailand by 3 endemic species.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Tree to 11 m tall, trunk always swollen at base. Twigs glabrous. Leaves usually elliptic, sometimes slightly ovate, 11–17.7 by 3.5–6.4 cm, base cuneate, broadly cuneate or slightly obtuse, apex acute to acuminate, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins (8–)10–12 per side. Inflorescences mostly clustered on swollen base of trunk, but a few on trunk knobs above the base, peduncles inconspicuous, pedicels 12–22 mm long, bracts not seen (probably absent). Flowers unisexual, staminate and pistillate flowers intermixed on the same individual. Sepals slightly connate at base, broadly triangular-ovate, 3.8–4.2 mm long, apex acute-obtuse to obtuse. Petals rose-coloured, spreading at maturity, glaucous on inner side (in vivo), not pitted on inner side; outer petals broadly elliptic to broadly elliptic-ovate, 11–12 by 9–11 mm, apex ± obtuse; inner petals elliptic to broadly elliptic, 9–12 by 6–7 mm, apex ± obtuse. Stamens 32–36, ± wedge-shaped, each 1.3–1.6 mm long, tightly packed, each not bending inward. Carpels ca 31, ovaries tomentose, stigmas with 7–9(–10) columnar lobes; ovules 5. Receptacle ± hemispherical in both staminate and pistillate flowers. Fruit of up to 4 monocarps, pedicel not measured. Monocarps brown (immature), subglobose, surface not observed. Seeds not observed.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Tree to 18 m tall, trunk base never swollen. Twigs glabrous. Leaves elliptic, 14–25 by 5–9 cm, base cuneate, broadly cuneate or cuneate-obtuse, apex acute-acuminate to acuminate, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 13–15 per side. Inflorescences clustered on trunks, peduncles inconspicuous, pedicels 27–40 mm long, bracts not seen. Flowers unisexual, staminate and pistillate flowers intermixed on the same individual. Sepals slightly connate at base, ± semicircular, ca 4 mm long, apex rounded. Petals pale rose-coloured, more yellow on outer whorl, non-glaucous and not pitted on inner side; outer petals spreading at maturity, elliptic to slightly ovate, 12.5 by 8.5–10 mm, apex rounded-obtuse; inner petals remaining tightly coherent at maturity, elliptic to slightly ovate, 8.5–9 by 8–8.5 mm, inner side non-glaucous in vivo and not pitted, apex ± obtuse. Stamens ca 36, ± vertical rectangle to ± wedge-shaped, ca 1.9 mm long, rather loosely packed, each slightly bending inward (best observable in outermost whorl). Carpels ca 33, ovaries tomentose, stigmas with 5–7 columnar lobes; ovules 7–9. Receptacle ± hemispherical in both staminate and pistillate flowers. Fruit of up to 7 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 40 mm long. Monocarps blackish brown, subglobose to slightly ellipsoid, 4–4.5 by 3.8–4 cm. Seeds ca 6, ± D-shaped, ca 40 by 20 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Tree to 14 m tall, trunk base never swollen. Twigs glabrous. Leaves elliptic to slightly ovate, 13–17.8 by 3.7–5.8 cm, base cuneate to obtuse, apex acute-acuminate to acuminate, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 8–10 per side. Inflorescences mostly clustered on large roots and on unswollen base of trunk, 1–3-flowered, peduncles inconspicuous, pedicels 7–15 mm long, bearing a few bracts at or near base. Flowers only staminate found. Sepals basally connate, triangular-ovate, 4.5–5.1 mm long, apex ± acute-obtuse. Petals rose-coloured, spreading at maturity, non-glaucous on inner side in vivo; outer petals ovate to broadly ovate, 10–11 by 9–10 mm, apex acute-obtuse; inner petals elliptic, 9–10 by 6 mm, apex ± obtuse, shallowly pitted on inner side. Stamens 32–39, ± wedge-shaped, 1.8–2 mm long, tightly packed, each not bending inward. Receptacle elongated hemispherical. Carpels, fruits, and seeds unknown.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Deciduous trees, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic to slightly ovate, base broadly cuneate to cuneate, symmetrical, midrib sunken above, secondary venation rather conspicuous, eucamptodromous, tertiary venation more or less percurrent-reticulate; petiole enlarged and covering the axillary bud. Inflorescences from axils of fallen leaves, often alongside new vegetative shoot from same axil, 1-flowered. Flowers hermaphroditic, petals separating early in development. Sepals 3, valvate, free, much shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, (elliptic-)oblong, both whorls similar in shape and size. Stamens ca 150, anthers aseptate, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels 6–9, stigmas globose-capitate; ovules lateral, uniseriate or biseriate, 3–4 per ovary. Receptacle more or less depressed hemispherical. Fruits apocarpous, indehiscent, subglobose to ellipsoid, glabrous, smooth, stipitate; pericarp moderately thick when dried. Seeds attached laterally in 1 row, up to 4 per monocarp, ellipsoid-ovoid, transversely slightly striate, otherwise smooth, glabrous, more or less brown when dried, perichalazal ring sunken, aril absent, endosperm ruminations lamellate.</br></br>A monotypic genus, occurring in E India, Myanmar, S China, and Vietnam.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Deciduous tree to 35 m tall. Twigs appressed-pilose. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic to slightly ovate, 11–24 by 5.9–8.9 cm, base cuneate to broadly cuneate, apex acute-acuminate, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 10–16 per side, rather prominent below. Inflorescences 1-flowered, pedicels 12–16 mm long, bearing one bract at the base. Sepals oblong-ovate, ca 10 mm long, apex acute-obtuse. Petals greenish yellow, rather chartaceous; outer petals narrowly oblong to narrowly elliptic-oblong, (42–)45–58 by 7–9 mm, apex obtuse to slightly cuspidate; inner petals narrowly oblong to narrowly elliptic-oblong, 51–57 by 6–8 mm, apex obtuse, outside at base with minute warts. Stamens ca 150, ± elongated wedge-shaped, ca 2 mm long. Carpels 6–9, ovaries glabrous. Fruit of up to 4 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 35 mm long. Monocarps dark purple, subglobose to ellipsoid, 2.1–4.2 by 1.8–3 cm, base contracted into a stipe 16–18 mm long. Seeds up to 4 per monocarp, ellipsoid-ovoid (middle ones more flattened), ca 19 by 13 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Evergreen or rarely deciduous trees or shrubs, with spiral primary branching. Indument of simple hairs. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, base symmetrical, cuneate, rounded, or subcordate, rarely truncate, midrib slightly raised, plane, or sunken above, secondary veins usually inconspicuous, brochidodromous, tertiary venation reticulate. Inflorescences axillary or from axils of fallen leaves, 1–6-flowered. Flowers hermaphroditic, long-conical to ovoid in bud, petals only separating as anthesis begins. Sepals 3, valvate, minutely to 1/2-connate, much shorter than petals. Petals in two whorls of 3, valvate, free, linear to ovate, the inner whorl slightly shorter, narrower, and with a concave base. Stamens numerous, outermost and innermost usually staminodial, cuneate, oblong, or rarely linear, anthers septate, anther connective apex tongue-shaped, truncate, bluntly conical, or dome-shaped. Carpels one to many, stigmas filiform to clavate; ovules up to 13 per ovary, uniseriate or biseriate. Receptacle with an inconspicuous ring or hollow cone surrounding the ovaries, less often flat. Fruits apocarpous, monocarps one to many, abaxially dehiscent, oblongoid, obovoid, or narrowly cylindrical, sometimes torulose, pubescent or glabrate, smooth, verrucose, or wrinkled, short-stipitate to nearly sessile; pericarp slightly thickened, leathery when dried. Seeds attached laterally in 1–2 rows, up to 13 per monocarp, ellipsoid or oblongoid, smooth or wrinkled, with a pale bluish or greenish grey sarcotesta in vivo (not visible when dried), perichalazal ring raised or not visible, aril a fleshy or corky ring around the micropyle or aril absent, endosperm ruminations lamellate to spiniform.</br></br>A pantropical genus of nearly 200 species, represented in Thailand by 8 species, only 2 occurring north of the Kra Isthmus. The monocarps dehisce to reveal a bright scarlet to pink endocarp contrasting with the colours of the seeds.

description: Tree to 35 m tall; base of trunk with buttresses and stilt roots, bark rough, bright orange-brown. Twigs dark rusty-pubescent, at length glabrate. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic, oblong-elliptic, or oblong-oblanceolate, 9.2–20.7 by 2.3–6.6 cm, base broadly cuneate, rounded, or truncate, apex acute or acuminate, the acumen 1.5–15 mm long, glabrous above, erect-pubescent below, secondary veins 11–17 per side; petioles 3–7 mm long. Inflorescences 1–6-flowered, dark rusty-pubescent, peduncle 2–7.5 mm long, pedicels 6–19 mm long, bract 1, attached just proximal to pedicel midpoint; buds linear-lanceolate, often falciform. Sepals connate at base, narrowly triangular, 3–5.5 mm long, acuminate to caudate, apex often recurved, dark rusty-pubescent outside. Petals greenish yellow, pale yellow, or occasionally orange, sometimes marked with dark purple on the inside of the inner petal base; outer petals linear, 31–60 by 3–4.5 mm at base, apex obtuse, densely pubescent inside, sericeous outside; inner petals linear, 27–34 by 1–2.5 mm at base, apex acute, densely pubescent on both surfaces. Stamens 1.5–2.5 mm long, anther connective apex tongue-shaped. Carpels 18–20. Receptacle flat, with an inconspicous ring surrounding the ovaries. Fruit of up to 22 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 23 mm long. Monocarps with red exocarp and red endocarp, narrowly cylindrical, torulose, terete in cross-section, 6–11.5 by 0.4–0.6 cm, slightly wrinkled, glabrate, apex rostrate, beak 1–8 mm long, base contracted into a stipe 7–14 mm long. Seeds in a single row, up to 13 per monocarp, oblongoid to ellipsoid, 5–7 by 3–4.6 mm, wrinkled, sarcotesta light bluish to grey, aril absent.

description: Tree to 35 m tall; base of trunk with conspicuous stilt roots. Twigs appressed-pubescent, soon glabrate. Leaves subcoriaceous, obovate to oblanceolate or elliptic, 4–11 by 1.8–5 cm, base cuneate and decurrent on petiole, apex obtuse, retuse, or short-acuminate (ca 5 mm), glabrous above, densely sericeous below, secondary veins 11–13 per side; petioles 3–8 mm long. Inflorescences 2–4-flowered, sericeous, peduncle 4–6 mm long, pedicels 8–10 mm long, bract 1, attached at pedicel midpoint; buds linear. Sepals 1/2–2/3-connate, sub-orbicular to broadly triangular, 2.5–4 mm long, apex acute, pubescent outside. Petals pale cream to yellow; outer petals linear, 20–23 by ca 2.5 mm at base, apex obtuse to acute, silver-puberulent but glabrous at base inside, silver- to gold-sericeous outside; inner petals linear, 22–23 by ca 1.5 mm at base, apex acute, densely silver-puberulent but glabrous at base on both surfaces. Stamens 2.6–3.1 mm long, anther connective apex tongue-shaped. Carpels 3–5. Receptacle flat, with an inconspicuous ring surrounding the ovaries. Fruit of up to 4 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 19 mm long. Monocarps orange, oblongoid, ellipsoid in cross-section, sometimes slightly flattened, 1.3–3.8 by 1.2–3.3 cm, wrinkled, appressed rusty-pubescent to glabrate, apex obtuse or with a beak ca 1 mm long, base contracted into a broad stipe 2.5–7 mm long. Seeds in a single row, up to 4 per monocarp, irregularly ellipsoid, 10–12 by 4–7 mm, wrinkled, sarcotesta bluish, aril absent.

description: Tree to 35 m tall; base of trunk with short buttresses, bark smooth and light brown, sometimes orange-tinted. Twigs glabrous or finely pubescent. Leaves chartaceous, rarely subcoriaceous, elliptic to oblong, 8–10.8 by 3.3–5 cm, base broadly cuneate, sometimes short-decurrent on petiole, apex broadly acuminate, the acumen 8–15 mm long, glabrous on both surfaces, secondary veins 9–12 per side; petioles 4.5–8 mm long. Inflorescences 1–3-flowered, sparsely pubescent, peduncle ca 1 mm long, pedicels 5–5.5 mm long, bracts 2, one attached at the pedicel midpoint, the other between the midpoint and the base; buds linear. Sepals connate at base, broadly triangular, 1–1.2 mm long, acute, sparsely whitish to pale brown-pubescent outside. Petals yellow to orange-yellow, slightly spreading at anthesis; outer petals linear, 10–19 by ca 1.8–2.5 mm at base, flat on outer surface, apex acute, densely pubescent except for the glabrous base on both surfaces; inner petals ca 17.5 mm by 1.6–2 mm at base, apex acute, densely pubescent except for the glabrous base on both surfaces. Stamens 0.7–1.2 mm long, anther connective apex dome-shaped. Carpels 2–6 [ex Gardner]. Receptacle with a hollow cone 1.2–1.4 mm in diameter surrounding the ovaries. Fruit of up to 3 monocarps borne on a pedicel 11–13.5 mm long. Monocarps green, with red endocarp, obovoid, not torulose, ellipsoid to terete in cross-section, 2.4–4.1 by 1.1–1.6 cm, faintly wrinkled, verrucose, often marked with multiple longitudinal ridges, glabrate, apex obtuse to rounded, base contracted into a stipe 3–5.5 mm long. Seeds in two rows, up to 8 per monocarp, ellipsoid, ca 11.6 by 6.2–7.3 mm, smooth, sarcotesta pale grey, aril a flat white fleshy ring encircling the micropyle.

description: Tree to 30 m tall. Twigs finely pubescent, soon glabrate. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, broadly elliptic to oblong, 6.4–7.2 by 3.1–5 cm, base broadly cuneate to rounded and short-decurrent on petiole, apex acuminate, the acumen 5–7 mm long, shiny and glabrous above, dull and with sparse appressed hairs or glabrate below, secondary veins 7–9 per side; petioles 5.5–8 mm long. Inflorescences 1–3-flowered, finely pale brown erect-pubescent, peduncle 1–2 mm long, pedicels somewhat flattened and often obliquely ben near midpoint, 3–6 mm long, each bearing 2 bracts, one immediately subtending the sepals, the other at pedicel midpoint; buds lanceolate. Sepals 1/2–2/3-connate, ovate, 2.5–3.2 mm long, broadly acute to rounded, pale brown-pubescent and warty outside. Petals light yellow; outer petals linear-lanceolate, 10.7–17 by 2.4–3 mm at base, ridged on outer surface, apex obtuse, densely pubescent on both surfaces; inner petals linear-lanceolate, 11.6–11.8 by 1.6–2.2 mm at base, apex obtuse, densely pubescent on both surfaces. Stamens 2.1–2.4 mm long, anther connective apex tongue-shaped. Carpels 3–5. Receptacle flat, with an inconspicuous ring surrounding the ovaries. Monocarps reddish brown, oblongoid, not torulose, 3.5–5 by 1.3–1.5 cm, smooth or faintly wrinkled, glabrate, apex obtuse to rounded, base contracted into a stipe ca 5 mm long. Seeds ca 6 per monocarp, broadly ellipsoid, ca 8.3 by 6.2–6.6 mm, strongly wrinkled, aril absent.

description: Tree to 22 m tall. Twigs sparsely pubescent to glabrate. Leaves chartaceous, narrowly elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 5.5–9 by 2.2–2.9 cm, base cuneate, apex obtuse, rarely acute, glabrous above, sparsely pubescent to glabrate below, secondary veins 9–13 per side, petioles 2.5–9 mm long. Inflorescences axillary, 2–4-flowered, glabrate, peduncle inconspicuous or lacking, pedicels 3.5–4 mm long, each bearing 2 bracts, one halfway between flower and pedicel midpoint, the other at the pedicel midpoint; buds lanceolate. Sepals connate at base, orbicular, ca 1.5 mm long, apex acute, sparsely pubescent. Petals greenish white to cream-coloured; outer petals lanceolate, 7–8 by 1.8–2 mm at base, flat on outer surface, apex obtuse, pubescent on both surfaces, glabrous toward base; inner petals subulate, 5–6 by 1.2–1.3 mm at base, apex acute, pubescent on both surfaces, becoming glabrous toward base. Stamens 0.8–1 mm long, anther connective apex truncate. Carpels ca 4. Receptacle with a hollow cone ca 1.8 mm in diameter surrounding the ovaries. Fruit of up to 4 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 9 mm long. Monocarps with green exocarp and red endocarp, oblongoid, torulose or not, elliptic in cross-section, 2.2–2.7 by 0.8–1.2 cm, slightly wrinkled, glabrate, apex rounded, base contracted into a stipe 2–6 mm long. Seeds in a single row, up to 4 per monocarp, ellipsoid, 7.2–8 by 5–6.5 mm, smooth, sarcotesta pale greenish grey, aril a flat fleshy ring 3–4 mm in diameter encircling the micropyle.

description: Tree to 22 m tall; base of trunk with small buttresses, bark flaking, pale orange to pale brown. Twigs pubescent. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, lanceolate, elliptic-lanceolate, or lanceolate-oblong, 6.5–9.4 by 2.4–4.1 cm, base broadly cuneate to rounded-truncate, apex acute to obtuse, pubescent but becoming glabrate above, erect-pubescent below, secondary veins 7–12 per side; petioles 6–8 mm long. Inflorescences 1–3-flowered, dusty yellow-pubescent, peduncle 1.5–4 mm long, pedicels 1–4.2 mm long, each with 2 bracts, one attached at pedicel midpoint, the other near the pedicel apex; buds linear, sometimes falciform. Sepals 1/3–2/3-connate, ovate to broadly triangular, 2–3 mm long, apex acute, pubescent outside. Petals pale yellow; outer petals linear, (16–)20–28 by 2–3.1 mm at base, acute and often curled at the apex, densely pubescent on both surfaces except for the glabrous base; inner petals linear, (12–)16.5–22.3 by 1–2 mm at base, acute and often curled at the apex, densely pubescent on both surfaces except for the glabrous base. Stamens 1.2–1.4 mm long, anther connective apex dome-shaped. Carpels 3–5. Receptacle with a hollow cone 1.4–2 mm in diameter surrounding the ovaries. Fruit of up to 4 monocarps borne on a pedicel up to 5.5 mm long. Monocarps with cream-coloured exocarp marked with red veining, and red endocarp, oblongoid, slightly falciform, flattened-elliptic in cross-section, 3.7–5.2 by 0.8–0.9 cm, longitudinally wrinkled, sparsely puberulent, apex rostrate, the beak 1–5 mm long, base contracted into a stipe 8–14 mm long. Seeds arranged in a single row, up to 3 per monocarp, broadly ellipsoid, 7.9–8.3 by 4.7–6.7 mm, smooth, sarcotesta grey, aril a raised corky ring encircling the micropyle.

description: Tree to 10 m tall. Twigs appressed-pubescent, soon glabrate. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic to oblong, occasionally lanceolate, 9.3–20 by 2.8–7.1 cm, base cuneate to slightly rounded, apex acuminate, the acumen 8–15 mm long, sparsely sericeous but soon glabrate above, sparsely sericeous to glabrous below, secondary veins 7–13 per side; petioles 4–5.5(–7) mm long. Inflorescences 1-flowered, pubescent, pedicels 1.5–3.5 mm long, bearing up to four evenly spaced bracts; buds broadly ovoid to globose. Sepals 1/3–1/2-connate, semicircular, 1.5–2.8 mm long, acute to apiculate, sericeous outside. Petals cream to yellow, tinged with pink to red on inner base of inner petals; outer petals ovate to broadly ovate, 6–9 by 4–6.5 mm wide just below midpoint, apex acute, densely short-pubescent inside, golden-sericeous outside; inner petals rhombic, 3–6.5 by 3–4 mm wide, apex acute or slightly attenuate, pubescent but glabrous toward the base on both surfaces. Stamens 1.25–1.5 mm long, anther connective apex knoblike. Carpel 1. Receptacle with a hollow cone ca 2 mm in diameter surrounding the ovary. Fruit borne on a pedicel ca 4 mm long. Monocarp with silvery green exocarp and red endocarp, narrowly falciform-oblongoid, slightly torulose, elliptic in cross-section, 3–5.5 by 1–1.2 cm, marked by raised veins, with irregular patches of pubescence, apex rostrate, the beak 3–4 mm long, base contracted into a stipe 6–10 mm long. Seeds in a single row, up to 6 per monocarp, ellipsoid, 9–10 by 6–7 mm, smooth, sarcotesta light grey-blue, aril a flat fleshy ring encircling the micropyle.

description: Shrub to tree to 17 m tall; bark scaly in irregular bands, mottled with white and pale orange-brown. Twigs pubescent, with hairs of two lengths, eventually glabrate. Leaves chartaceous, oblong, ovate, or elliptic, 5.7–10.5 by 3.7–4.9 cm, base cuneate, rounded, or subcordate-truncate, apex acute to obtuse, occasionally rounded or emarginate, sparsely erect-pubescent on both surfaces, secondary veins 7–8 per side; petioles 6–9 mm long. Inflorescences 1–4-flowered, pubescent, peduncle ca 5 mm long or lacking, pedicels 2.5–3.5 mm long, each with 2 bracts; buds lanceolate. Sepals 1/2-connate, semicircular, 2–2.6 mm long, obtuse, pubescent outside. Petals creamy yellow to orange-yellow, dark purple to purplish red at the base; outer petals lanceolate, 11–14 by 2.5–4.3 mm at base, apex obtuse, pubescent but becoming glabrous toward base on both surfaces; inner petals linear, 11–12.5 by ca 2.5 mm at base, apex acute, pubescent but becoming glabrous toward base on both surfaces. Stamens 2–2.3 mm long, anther connective apex bluntly conical. Carpels 4–7+. Receptacle with a hollow cone 2.2–2.3 mm in diameter surrounding the ovaries. Fruit of up to 12 monocarps borne on a pedicel ca 6 mm long. Monocarps with green exocarp and red endocarp, oblongoid, weakly to strongly torulose, elliptic in cross-section, 3.2–5.5 by ca 0.9 cm, obliquely wrinkled, sparsely pubescent, contracted into a stipe 6–12 mm long. Seeds in a single row, up to 6 per monocarp, ellipsoid, 7.5–8.5 by 5–5.5 mm, smooth, sarcotesta pale greyish green, aril a raised corky ring encircling the micropyle.
